chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content:
"You are a thousand times better than drugs, both harmful and addictive. My love is fiery and dangerous, yet I cannot stop." — Luo Yao Lin Ran has been reborn.
He is reborn at the moment when he confesses his feelings to Liu Ruxue, but Lin Ran feels no joy.
Because he knows that Luo Yao will appear soon, and this time, she will capture him and lock him in bed.
Thinking of this, Lin Ran trembles all over.
He needs to save himself. Being reborn once, he only wants to love Luo Yao willingly, not under compulsion.
Liu Ruxue is still blushing with anticipation, waiting for Lin Ran's confession: "Lin Ran gege! What do you want to say to me?"
She naturally knows that Lin Ran is going to confess to her, and this time, she plans to accept him and carry out Lin Jian's scheme.
"Lin Ran gege! Are you unwell?" Seeing the sweat on Lin Ran's forehead, Liu Ruxue is puzzled.
A screeching brake sound disrupts the idyllic atmosphere, and a luxury car appears behind Lin Ran.
He knows, she's here.Lin Ran takes a deep breath, ready to curse at Liu Ruxue in front of Luo Yao and slap her twice, but before he can act, the car door swiftly opens, and Luo Yao, with a cold expression, gets out and delivers a swift backhand strike to Lin Ran.
Before passing out, Lin Ran's mind is filled with three question marks: ???
Liu Ruxue is startled, staring at the stunning woman who suddenly appears.
Luo Yao's beauty is the kind that leaves an indelible impression, so mesmerizing that even comparison feels futile.
In front of Luo Yao, Liu Ruxue, the campus beauty of Capital University, feels as insignificant as a tiny drop in the ocean, filled with self-loathing.
Yet, it is precisely this woman who gives Liu Ruxue a feeling of impending death, making eye contact feels like a daunting challenge.
"Who... are you?"
For some reason, Liu Ruxue feels a chill around her, as if she has been on the brink of death.
Luo Yao dismisses her killing intent, ignoring Liu Ruxue as she carries Lin Ran into the car.
If Liu Ruxue weren't someone Lin Ran cared about, she would be dead by now.
A fleet of luxury cars speeds away, and only then does Liu Ruxue notice the grandeur of the convoy. The woman who just left, Luo Yao, seemed to be surrounded by many bodyguards.
"Did... was Lin Ran kidnapped by that woman?"
Liu Ruxue pulls out her phone, ready to call the police, but pauses.
If Lin Ran dies, his family would automatically inherit all his shares, wouldn't they?
After consideration, Liu Ruxue dials Lin Jian's number.
In the dark room at night.
"Ah Ran, I want to dig out your eyes and make them into a specimen. That way, your eyes will only see me!"
Lin Ran feels a chilling touch moving slowly from his cheek to his eye socket, the cold and familiar voice of the woman sending chills down his spine.
"If I break your legs, you won't be able to escape, will you?"
Abruptly opening his eyes, Lin Ran is met with the familiar stunning face and blood-red pupils.
Luo Yao is literally pinning Lin Ran down, one hand caressing his cheek, the other holding a cold dagger, slowly moving across his chest.
She intends to possess Lin Ran; if that fails, she will consider digging out his heart and placing it in her own body.
This familiar beauty, this familiar aura, this familiar touch, this familiar bed—Lin Ran confirms he is not dreaming.
He is indeed caught again, and his hands and feet are shackled with chains.
A complex array of emotions swirls within Lin Ran, intense pain mingled with relief, a single tear escaping.
Seeing that glimmer in the darkness, Luo Yao pauses.
"Are you afraid, Ah Ran? Why can't you be more obedient?"
Suddenly, Lin Ran spreads his arms, wanting to embrace the woman in front of him.
"Clang! Clang!"Follow current novels on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
The sound of chains clashing does not stop Lin Ran's movements as he tightly hugs the woman who loves him deeply.
Luo Yao is visibly stunned, then slowly speaks.
"What trick are you trying to pull now, Ah Ran? Don't delude yourself; tonight, you only belong to me!"
Although her words are cold, Lin Ran's hug satisfies her greatly.
It's the first time Lin Ran has taken the initiative to hold her, and the feeling is like a drug, deeply addictive.
Lin Ran nods frantically.
"Mhm! I will always belong to only you!"
Hearing this, Luo Yao frowns slightly.
To think he'd willingly hug me and say such insincere words just to escape?
Didn't he say that being near me only makes him feel disgusted?
Luo Yao smiled wryly to herself, not bothering to expose Lin Ran.
In that case, prove it to me!
Luo Yao closes in.
Lin Ran was just about to say, "Okay! I definitely will..."
A familiar and domineering sensation on his lips cuts off Lin Ran's words; oxygen gradually diminishes. He knows Luo Yao is testing his sincerity.
Reason quickly gives way to desire as a warm, dominant presence invades his mouth, and Lin Ran actively responds to Luo Yao's passionate kiss.
His hand gradually rests on Luo Yao's waist, an action that greatly pleases her.
Luo Yao believes Lin Ran is feigning submission, but she doesn't care.
Even if it's fake, she is willing to sink into it. She is desperate to fully possess her Ah Ran.
Luo Yao's heart is stirred.
Lin Ran responds actively.
Luo Yao is slightly surprised; she didn't expect Lin Ran to be so obedient.
Slightly applying force, blood mingles within Luo Yao's mouth, while Lin Ran endures the pain on his lips without complaint.
A few minutes pass, and Luo Yao finally allows Lin Ran to breathe once more.
"Luo Yao! I want you..."
Luo Yao is taken aback; the dagger in her hand drops with a "clang," her eyes sparkling, doubting whether she's hearing things or having a hallucination.
Lin Ran isn't calling her "demoness" or "devil," as he used to.
He wants her?
"Ah Ran wants me?"
Lin Ran's eyes burn with desire; he is ready to abandon everything to possess the woman before him.
Lin Ran nods: "Give me!"
Both being adults, they understand the implications of this statement.
"Alright!"
Even knowing Lin Ran isn't genuinely submitting, Luo Yao chooses to believe him, only because she desires this moment of truth more.
The two plunge into frenzy.
In the past, Lin Ran considered Luo Yao a psychotic, deviant, obsessive, ruthless demon, causing him to fear her and always seek to escape.
Only now does he truly understand this "demon."
Accompanied by the melody of enchanting music...
— There's no point in keeping a brain, just leave it here.

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.content:
One wild night, as the first rays of morning sunlight filtered through the curtains and struck his face, Lin Ran slowly awoke.
The person beside him coiled around him like a water snake, staring at him with an absentminded expression. A crimson stain remained on the white sheets.
In his previous life, this night had been forced upon Lin Ran, and Luo Yao's behavior at the time had been so violent that she seemed ready to disembowel him. He had been terrified.
It was only now, looking back, that he realized this had been Luo Yao's first time as well.
"Awake?" Luo Yao asked, her face expressionless but her heart filled with fear.
She feared that last night had all been a dream, and that her A Ran would continue to flee from her endlessly.
Looking at the breathtaking beauty in his arms, Lin Ran felt an infinite sense of melancholy.
He knew that this seemingly harmless and delicate woman before him was, in fact, a devilishly beautiful, heartless, and ruthless personality, a pathological and obsessive, and could go crazy at any moment.
In his previous life, he had constantly tried to escape her control, but in the end, he had died without succeeding.
He remembered that Luo Yao had suddenly appeared in Lin Ran's freshman year of college, her first words demanding that Lin Ran marry her.However, when Lin Ran refused, everything began to take a strange turn.
Three years passed in the blink of an eye, and Lin Ran found that he couldn't escape Luo Yao's control. The more he resisted, the closer Luo Yao stuck to him.
It all came to a head after Lin Ran repeatedly confessed his love to the campus beauty, Liu Ruxue. Luo Yao went mad.
She desperately wanted to tie Lin Ran to her side, force him, possess him, even torture him...
Lin Ran and Luo Yao played out the drama of him fleeing and her chasing, making it impossible for him to escape, again for three full years.
Finally, an accident occurred while Luo Yao was on a business trip.
That time, Lin Ran was tricked into signing a share transfer document by his "secret girlfriend" Liu Ruxue, and then he was pushed off the rooftop by Liu Ruxue along with his stepmother and half-brother.
The wind was strong, and the feeling of falling combined with terror left an indelible mark on Lin Ran.
As the sound of a heavy object hitting the ground clearly reached Lin Ran's ears, a brief agony followed, and then Lin Ran was dead.
His father, holding Lin Ran's "suicide note," successfully inherited all of Lin Ran's shares in the Suran Group, adding to his own, making him the de facto number one in the group.
As for Lin Ran, he could only turn into a wisp of soul, quietly watching his scumbag father, stepmother, half-brother, and disloyal lover celebrate his death.
The scumbag father, wanting to get it over with, hastily buried Lin Ran in the wilderness the very next day, but no sooner had he done so than Luo Yao appeared.
Luo Yao went mad, ordering people to dig up Lin Ran's "grave." Laughably, there was no coffin, and no cremation had taken place.
She held Lin Ran's unrecognizable corpse, crying heart-wrenchingly for a long, long time, before finally, she kissed him...
Even as a soul, Lin Ran's eyes widened in disbelief; he didn't understand how Luo Yao could still find the courage to kiss him in such a state.
He himself was repulsed by his own appearance.
"A Ran, why didn't you listen? Why wouldn't you stay by my side..."
"I'm sorry! It's my fault for not protecting you. Wait for me, I'll be with you soon!"
Luo Yao must have been deeply disappointed in him, right?
Luo Yao had Lin Ran's body transported back to 'Dongtian Manor,' and then she simply waited.
Not long after, Lin Tianba, Liu Yuemei, Lin Jian, and Lin Jian's cousin and lover, Liu Ruxue, were dragged in.
The group had been enjoying hotpot and singing at home when they were suddenly brought to the manor.
Facing the world-renowned female tycoon who struck fear into everyone, they trembled like a sieve.
"You killed A Ran, you deserve to be dismembered a thousand times!"
They were all terrified, not doubting for a moment that Luo Yao's words were true.
Everyone in the world knew how crazy and terrifying this woman was.
Weren't they all saying that Lin Ran was just this lady's toy? Why was this madwoman seeking revenge for Lin Ran's death?
Lin Tianba stammered, "Miss Luo, this... this is all a misunderstanding! I am Lin Ran's biological father, how could I have killed him?"
Lin Jian, Liu Yuemei, and Liu Ruxue were even more panicked; they were the ones who had conspired to kill Lin Ran.
Lin Jian: "Miss Luo, this has nothing to do with us!"
Liu Yuemei: "As a mother, I loved little Ran the most; I would never harm him!"
Liu Ruxue: "It's not me... it's not me, I'm the woman Lin Ran loved the most."
In his soul form, Lin Ran watched all this and wryly shook his head.
Lin Tianba hadn't been directly involved, but he had definitely been one of the most eager for Lin Ran's death. He just hadn't realized it while alive, only after dying did he see the true nature of this scumbag father.
Or perhaps, it was only after dying that he was willing to believe what these people were really like.
As the most wealthy and powerful woman in the world, finding out the truth was as easy as pie for Luo Yao.
Her cold, bone-chilling voice slowly said, "None of you are going to die well!"
The murderous intent in Luo Yao's words was palpable; Lin Jian was the first to lose it, flipping over and kowtowing loudly on the ground.
“Miss Luo, I was wrong… I was wrong! It was these two wretched women who schemed everything…”
As he spoke, he shoved his mother and Liu Ruxue forward, leaving both of them in a state of disbelief.
Was this their beloved son/brother?
Liu Yuemei spoke up, “Son, don’t be scared. This woman can’t do anything to us. This is a society governed by the law!”
Lin Jian wanted to curse out loud. Are you out of your mind to talk about the law with the most powerful and wealthy madwoman in the world? Am I the one who’s insane, or are you?
Even if we were to talk about the law, doesn’t the fact that they murdered someone stand?
The law is made for ordinary people, not for the elite.
Liu Ruxue was still in shock, her eyes widening as Luo Yao’s hand suddenly held a bone-cutting knife, making her tremble uncontrollably.
“You can’t kill me! I’m Lin Ran’s favorite woman. If you kill me, he’ll never rest in peace!”
Luo Yao paused, then her eyes blazed with madness.
That’s right! If it weren’t for this woman, her Ah Ran wouldn’t have died.
What did Ah Ran see in Liu Ruxue? Was it just her face? What did he see in Liu Ruxue? Was it just her face?
Lin Ran, who had been watching the scene unfold, couldn’t help but laugh, though it was a laugh of anger.
Holding the knife, Luo Yao approached slowly, her voice cold as ice. “I’ll turn you into a human candle! And this face of yours, you’re so proud of it, aren’t you? I’ll make sure it’s displayed for everyone to admire.”
As agonizing screams echoed, the four of them were left in unspeakable torment, longing for death but unable to die.
Lin Tianba was subjected to a thousand cuts by Luo Yao, and after death, his bones were dumped into a cesspool—that was where he would rest.Google seaʀᴄh Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Lin Jian was castrated by Luo Yao and thrown into the estate’s fish pond, where he was devoured by crocodiles.
Liu Yuemei was turned into a grand feast, with all of the Liu family members “invited” to partake. Shortly after, the Liu family was annihilated.
As for Liu Ruxue, Luo Yao didn’t kill her. Instead, she transformed her into a beautiful porcelain vase and sent it to Southeast Asia.

chapters.title: Chapter 3
chapters.content:
Liu Ruxue was mutilated, her limbs severed and her tongue cut out, her head the only part left protruding from a vase. Every day, she was forced to perform moans onstage in Southeast Asia, sustained by nutrient solutions, surviving only for a while longer. She had truly become an "art piece" applauded and admired by countless men in the audience.
Witnessing the horrific fates of several people, Lin Ran did not perceive Luo Yao as cruel, but rather felt gratitude towards her.
He had always believed himself to be nothing more than a "toy" that Luo Yao madly wanted to possess, only to discover that Luo Yao had personally avenged him.
Returning to the manor after completing these acts, Luo Yao donned a wedding gown and slowly lay down in a crystal coffin. Inside, Lin Ran, dressed in a groom’s suit, lay alongside her.
Lin Ran was powerless to stop her, his heart aching deeply.
"Ran, I've come to accompany you. As I promised… whether alive or dead, you are mine!"
"We are married now. See, I’ve put on a wedding gown for you. Isn’t it beautiful?"
Lin Ran: [It’s beautiful, so lovely!]
"To die together with you... it’s really wonderful…"
"In the afterlife… could you please look at me more often…"Lin Ran: [If there’s a chance, I will always stay by your side!]
Alive together, buried together in death.
At that moment, Lin Ran clearly realized how deeply Luo Yao loved him.
Sadly, it was all too late, and everything had passed.
After an unknown duration wandering the mortal world, Lin Ran witnessed many things he wanted to see, except for the beautiful figure of Luo Yao. He could no longer hear her threatening voice either.
It wasn’t until he witnessed Liu Ruxue’s death in Southeast Asia that Lin Ran was reborn.
"Why aren’t you speaking?"
Noticing Lin Ran staring blankly at her, Luo Yao frowned slightly.
Lin Ran snapped back to reality, the softness in his arms reminding him that there was still time for everything.
This time, he would make up for a lifetime of love to the woman in front of him.
"Luo Yao! I… uh?"
Luo Yao didn’t know what Lin Ran was about to say next, fearing it might be something devastating. She wasn’t about to give him the chance.
Their kiss was intense; Lin Ran felt as though Luo Yao wanted to consume him, and he began to reciprocate.
Satisfied with Lin Ran’s reaction, Luo Yao inwardly approved. She wanted to mark him as hers, and with a sharp bite, blood trickled from the wound on his shoulder.
"If you lied to me last night… I’ll cut your tongue out!"
Lin Ran shuddered, fully aware of what Luo Yao, this madwoman, was capable of doing.
"Don’t worry, from now on, I belong only to you!"
Luo Yao was pleased with Lin Ran’s current state, even if it were all a lie; it still made her feel like she was drifting in a sea of honey.
Luo Yao: "Then, what did you want to say to Liu Ruxue yesterday?"
Lin Ran was taken aback and then remained silent for a moment.
Yesterday, he was supposed to confess to Liu Ruxue, although he couldn’t remember how many times he had confessed. Lin Ran knew that after this confession, Luo Yao had grown even more insane, completely dominating his life.The source of this content ɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Luo Yao only wanted him; what was wrong with that?
If she wanted him, then he would give himself to her.
"Luo Yao! Yesterday, I went to Liu Ruxue to sever our ties. The truth is, I’ve never liked her!"
Luo Yao: "Do you think I’d believe such an obvious lie?"
Lin Ran: "Alright! I admit I was blind before, infatuated with Liu Ruxue, but now I see clearly. You’re the one I’ve been searching for all my life!"
Luo Yao seemed to see through Lin Ran’s tricks.
"Do you think that will make me let you go?"
"If you dare see Liu Ruxue again, I won’t hesitate to turn her into a specimen here, letting her watch every night as I possess you!"
Lin Ran knew Luo Yao could do something like this. In his previous life, Liu Ruxue had suffered even worse.
Lin Ran also understood how deeply he had hurt Luo Yao. But it was okay now; with this chance at rebirth, he would dedicate his life to proving the sincerity of his words.
At the thought, Lin Ran held her even tighter, and Luo Yao relished the feeling of their naked embrace.
"Ran! Call me!"
"Luo Yao!"
"Kiss me…"
Lin Ran obliged, and after a long time, feeling utterly drained, he fell into a deep sleep.
Waking up at noon, he found Luo Yao had already left, and the iron chains that once bound his wrists were gone.
Luckily, it wasn’t time for school yet, or he would’ve definitely been late.
Seeing a small jar of ointment on the table, Lin Ran smiled.
He recognized it as a highly effective scar remover, uniquely Luo Yao's. He had used it many times in his previous life.
Entering the bathroom, Lin Ran noticed his lip wound had healed, but the bite mark on his shoulder remained distinct, as did the scratches on his arms and back.
All of this reminded Lin Ran of the kind of madness the woman beside him possessed.
Compared to his previous life, this was relatively mild.
She merely wanted to mark him as hers; what was wrong with that?
If she wanted it, then let her have it. It wasn’t like he couldn’t handle it.
Thinking this, Lin Ran didn’t bother applying ointment to the wound on his shoulder.
This mark was uniquely Luo Yao’s.
The bedroom door of the villa opened, and Uncle Fu, the butler, hurried over.
"Young Master Lin! Would you like to dine now?"
Lin Ran had a good impression of Uncle Fu, the butler who had often advised him in his previous life.
"Where’s Luo Yao?"
"Miss went to the company!"
Lin Ran nodded and took a seat at the small dining table.
He remembered that in the past, he would always sit as far away from Luo Yao as possible during meals. Because of this, Luo Yao had the grand dining table replaced with a smaller one.
Even then, Lin Ran would still choose to sit across from Luo Yao or simply skip meals.
Shaking his head at the memory, he saw servants bringing over bowls of soup.
"What’s this?"
Uncle Fu grinned with a motherly glow.
When Miss had instructed him to prepare extra of this tonic soup this morning, he was quite startled.
He never expected that Young Master Lin would finally blossom.
"This is Miss’ tonic soup for strengthening vitality and essence!"
Lin Ran fell silent.
He was a grown man, yet his woman thought him weak?
Alright, maybe a little, but that was mainly due to Luo Yao’s fault. Who could endure such intense activities?
Lin Ran: "I won’t drink it! Even if I jump off this building, I won’t drink a single drop of it!"
Lin Ran began eating leisurely, completely ignoring the soup.
The ringtone of his phone went off, and Lin Ran glanced at the caller ID, which read [Dad], and frowned. After some thought, he picked up the call.
Lin Tianba’s furious voice came through: "You little brat, where are you? Do you know how worried your mother and brother are? We’ve been waiting for a whole day and night for the kidnappers to call, and what are you doing?"
Lin Ran knew this was Liu Ruxue’s doing. In his previous life, he had also received this call, during which he told his father that Luo Yao had abducted him and described his experiences.
To his astonishment, after confirming that Luo Yao had indeed abducted him, his father had immediately hung up, as if nothing had happened.
Lin Ran narrowed his eyes.
Did they already intend for him to die back then?
This was bad; he felt like he was starting to develop some sense of logic.

chapters.title: Chapter 4
chapters.content:
"Old Deng! You're not allowed to talk to me like that ever again!"
Old Deng?
Me?
Lin Tianba on the other end of the line was clearly stunned, as if he couldn't believe these words were coming from Lin Ran.
Next to him, Lin Jian immediately whispered, "Dad! Maybe Brother really got kidnapped and is pretending to have a bad relationship with you so he doesn't drag you into this. The kidnappers might be right next to him!"The source of thɪs content is
Lin Tianba suddenly realized this must be the case. Otherwise, how could his usually submissive son speak so rudely? Thinking about it, he felt a bit touched.
Son, don’t worry. After you're gone, Dad will definitely give you a grand funeral.
"Xiao Ran! Dad was just too worried. Although Dad can't afford to ransom you right now, you can ask the kidnappers what else they want. As long as it's something Dad can do, I’ll do it. I just hope they leave you a whole body..."
Lin Ran was so angry he laughed, and a surge of killing intent welled up inside him.
"Who said I got kidnapped? I just went home with my wife, you motherfucker. You hear rumors and just run with them. Your head is like a hairy watermelon, shaking with rotten pulp inside. You’re a damn retard!""Having a father like you, I really feel like I’ve seen it all in life! Slicing my behind with a knife has opened my eyes!"
Lin Tianba instantly went ballistic: "You little bastard, what did you just say? I’m your father! How dare you talk to me like that?"
Lin Ran shot back: "From Jiangnan to Jiangbei, across the whole street, go ask around who the real dad is! Calling me a little bastard, are you shoving laxatives in your mouth or something? Every word out of your mouth is either shit or crap. Your name is such a dumb joke, you shouldn’t call yourself Lin Tianba, you should call yourself Lin Turtle!"
Lin Ran hung up the phone after venting his frustrations, then blacklisted the entire Lin family’s numbers in one go.
You Lin family, just wait for me.
Lin Tianba! In a couple of days, I’ll make sure you know who the real daddy is.
Uncle Fu beside him was shocked. He couldn’t believe the current situation between Lin Ran and the Lin family had escalated to this level.
And what did Lin Ran just say?
With his... wife... going home?
Uncle Fu nearly teared up and personally filled another bowl of soup for Lin Ran.
Lin Ran: "...?"
He refused to drink it.
The 'Cave Paradise Manor' was huge, but Lin Ran was deep into his lazy lifestyle and rarely stepped out of Villa 1. He lounged in the villa, feeling stagnant and thinking about Luo Yao.
I really want to snuggle with my boss wife!
As he thought about it, Lin Ran picked up his phone and searched for the chat log full of transfers, which he had never accepted.
Meanwhile, at the Lin family mansion, Lin Tianba was so enraged he hurled his phone, which hit Lin Jian right on the forehead.
"Ah! Damn it!"
Liu Yuemei was startled and quickly checked on her son's injury, while Lin Tianba was also taken aback, seeing Lin Jian’s forehead already bleeding.
Liu Yuemei gave Lin Tianba a reproachful look.
"Is my son okay?" Liu Yuemei asked with concern.
Lin Tianba apologized awkwardly: "Sorry, son. Dad didn’t mean it!"
Lin Jian, despite the pain, put on a virtuous smile: "It’s okay, Dad! You should focus on saving Brother, at least ask the kidnappers to leave him a whole body!"
Lin Tianba: "We don’t need to care about that ungrateful kid. If he dies, it’s his own fault!"
Liu Yuemei also handed her phone to Lin Tianba, saying, "Yeah, dear! Just now, Xiao Ran must have been threatened. As a mother, I’m so worried. Call him again quickly, ask the kidnappers to make sure he gets a whole body!"
Lin Tianba was moved to tears: "You two are so kind. If that ungrateful kid was half as obedient as Xiao Jian, I wouldn’t have made him sleep in the storage room!"
Lin Tianba took the phone and asked, "What’s that ungrateful kid’s number?"
After asking, all three of them fell silent. They realized they didn’t have Lin Ran’s number.
The number they had just used was one they had asked Liu Ruxue for.
Without a choice, Lin Tianba had to call Liu Ruxue again.
"Little Xue! What’s Xiao Ran’s phone number? Uncle’s phone fell and broke, so I can’t find the call log!"
After getting the number, Lin Tianba dialed Lin Ran’s number once more.
But no matter how he tried, it wouldn’t connect. Even switching to Lin Jian’s phone didn’t work.
"That ungrateful kid, forget about him. Let’s take Xiao Jian to the hospital. Look at this wound, it’s at least a centimeter deep."
Lin Jian gave a virtuous smile: "Thank you, Dad!"
...
In the high-level meeting room of Luo Corporation, all the executives sat in silent fear.
Every meeting felt like a trip to the execution ground. If it weren’t for the excellent benefits at Luo Corporation, they would have left long ago.
And today, Luo Yao’s face was as cold as ice.
Luo Yao fiddled with a pen in her hand, her heart filled with murderous intent.
Today at noon, her assistant reported that Liu Ruxue wanted an internship certificate.
Liu Ruxue was an intern during the summer at one of Luo Corporation’s subsidiaries, which was naturally arranged by Luo Yao.
She had already completely controlled the dynamics of everyone related to Lin Ran, especially this Liu Ruxue.
Lin Ran had gone to see her yesterday, and today she received news from Liu Ruxue.
Moreover, obtaining an internship certificate meant they were about to start school.
Luo Yao was already contemplating whether to make her disappear forever.
If Liu Ruxue were gone, would it make Lin Ran collapse or keep him by her side?
She didn’t want to take the risk and couldn’t afford to.
"Ding!"
A notification sound from her special-attention WeChat broke the silence. Luo Yao picked up her phone.
Then all the executives saw the previously ice-cold Luo Yao’s lips slowly curl into a smile.
What the hell! Luo Yao actually smiled?
What kind of message had such a powerful effect?
They were utterly shocked.
"This meeting is adjourned. Each of you will receive an extra ten thousand dollars in this month’s bonus."
With that, Luo Yao got up and left, leaving behind a group of dumbfounded executives.
Their boss suddenly found their work satisfactory? And even gave them bonuses?
This was just too incredible!
Luo Yao walked straight back to her office without taking her eyes off her phone. Her assistant, Liu Meng, was equally shocked.
Could the person who could stir emotions in Luo Yao be... Lin Ran?
Sitting in her office, Luo Yao stared at the message for a long time, her heart unable to calm down.
Lin Ran: [I miss you. When are you coming back?]
After a moment, Luo Yao replied: [Soon.]
Luo Yao: "I’m leaving now! You handle the rest of the work!"
Liu Meng was stunned: "Uh... okay!"
Luo Yao was actually leaving early? My goodness!
On her way back, Luo Yao received a message from the household manager, Uncle Fu. He sent her the detailed transcript of today’s phone call between Lin Ran and the Lin family.
Upon reading it, Luo Yao's eyes brightened significantly. If her employees saw this, they’d probably be in shock again.
"Lin Ran said... wife... home?"

chapters.title: Chapter 5
chapters.content:
In the private villa of a luxury estate, Lin Ran immediately took action upon receiving the news and headed to the kitchen.
He planned to prepare dinner for Luo Yao, which was the most he could do for her right now.
He wasn't sure if the estate allowed him to go out, and he hadn't asked.
In his previous life, at this time, he was confined to bed.
Now, at least there were no chains, and he didn't dare ask for more. He would take things slowly.
Besides, living in such a comfortable villa, with everything provided and a beautiful, seductive wife, wasn't this already the peak of life? Why would he ever want to return to his old days?
Thinking about his childhood, Lin Ran had had a pretty good life. But everything changed after his mother passed away.
With a stepmother came a stepfather, and a younger brother who constantly plotted to kill him.
He held no position of importance in the Lin family; no one ever cared for him. Even the tuition for his university education had been earned through his own hard work.
Compared to his brother Lin Jian's life, it was like living in heaven and hell.Wasn't having a wealthy wife enough?
When the staff in the villa saw Lin Ran heading to the kitchen to cook, they were all startled.
The kitchen was a dangerous place in the household. If Lin Ran got even a little hurt, they would all be in deep trouble.
Everyone could see how Luo Yao doted on Lin Ran.
Even if Lin Ran blew up the entire estate, it would be the fault of the explosives and the estate, not Lin Ran.
No matter how fiercely the chef and the servants pleaded, Lin Ran remained unmoved.
Lin Ran: "It's fine. I just want to make dinner for Luo Yao. I'm not trying to take your jobs!"
The head chef was on the verge of tears: "Master Lin, it's not about the job; it's about your safety. If anything happens to you, I won't be able to live!"
Lin Ran made a concession: "Okay then, you can watch me. If I can't handle it, you can step in. That works, right?"
After some thought, the head chef reluctantly agreed. This was already a big compromise on Lin Ran's part.
Watching Lin Ran's skillful knifework and deft movements at the stove, the chef was slightly amazed.The most update n0vels are published on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
How could a pampered young master like Lin Ran know how to cook?
They didn't know that in the Lin household, it was Lin Ran who did the cooking, not the nanny.
After Lin Ran finished preparing his signature eight dishes and one soup, Luo Yao returned.
Seeing no one in the hall, she first went upstairs to the bedroom. Pushing the door open, it was empty.
Her face immediately cooled.
No one was here. Last time no one was here, Lin Ran had run away, and Uncle Fu had taken all the bodyguards and servants out to search for him.
This time, again, no one was here. Could it be...?
Ah Ran! Why must you be so disobedient?
Luo Yao took out her phone, opened an unknown app, and checked the location.
Hmm? He's in the villa?
While Luo Yao was puzzled, Uncle Fu hurriedly came from the kitchen.
"Miss, you're back!"
"Where is Ah Ran?"
"Master Lin is in the kitchen. He said he wants to cook dinner for you himself!"
Luo Yao froze for a moment before regaining her normal expression.
Uncle Fu wiped the sweat from his brow, relieved that he had spoken quickly enough to avoid possibly losing his life.
"Miss, Master Lin has almost finished. Why don't you go downstairs?"
Luo Yao nodded coldly, went back to her room to change, and then walked towards the dining hall.
Lin Ran had the servants bring the dishes to the dining hall and followed them out of the kitchen, where he saw Luo Yao.
For some reason, seeing Luo Yao made Lin Ran incredibly happy, as if he had just seen the most magnificent thing in the world.
It was a feeling he had never experienced before.
Lin Ran opened his arms and walked towards Luo Yao, who just stood there in a daze as Lin Ran hugged her and kissed her on the forehead.
"Welcome home kiss!"
"I made dinner. Let's eat together!"
"Okay!"
Luo Yao's eyes sparkled with stars. Was this what it felt like to have Ah Ran?
Could he not be pretending? Considering it again, it still seemed unlikely, and her expression once again turned cold.
Lin Ran was utterly confused.
Brother, are you practicing face-changing?
Before cooking, Lin Ran had asked the steward about Luo Yao's dietary restrictions. He didn't want to be like those stupid characters in novels who made the female lead allergic.
Learning that Luo Yao had no specific dietary requirements, Lin Ran let loose in the kitchen.
No requirements meant that even if he cooked something terrible, she wouldn't get angry.
Moreover, his cooking skills were actually quite decent.
In casual homewear, Luo Yao was alluring beyond imagination. Scenes from the previous night flashed through Lin Ran's mind, and his face turned red.
Luo Yao took her seat, and Lin Ran sat beside her, lighting the candles he had prepared earlier and instructing the servants to turn off the lights.
This action left Uncle Fu and the other servants in shock.
Previously, Lin Ran always sat at the farthest end from Luo Yao, so Luo Yao had even replaced the large, luxurious dining table with a smaller one, yet Lin Ran still sat opposite Luo Yao.
And now, he was directly sitting beside Luo Yao and lighting romantic candles. This change was no small feat.
Luo Yao also appreciated Lin Ran's transformation. She thought that if he could keep this up, it wouldn't be so bad.
Lin Ran served a bowl of beauty soup for Luo Yao and then helped himself to one.
Wives needed to maintain their beauty, but so did husbands! Otherwise, once they aged, their wives might not want them anymore.
Uncle Fu quickly interrupted: "Miss, this soup looks delicious. Why don't you allow me to taste it first?"
Uncle Fu was genuinely afraid that Lin Ran might have poisoned the food.
Luo Yao coldly glanced at Uncle Fu, and he immediately realized his mistake. He had no right to doubt Lin Ran. In this household, no one could question him.
Uncle Fu even wondered if Lin Ran's status in this home was even higher than the young lady's.
Luo Yao coldly said, "No need. This is what Ah Ran cooked. I trust him!"
Even if it were poison that would tear through her innards, as long as Lin Ran told her to drink it, she would do so without hesitation.
Uncle Fu felt awkward, while Lin Ran simply smiled. He didn't blame Uncle Fu; such concerns were reasonable.
"Let me try it first!"
Before anyone could react, Lin Ran quickly drank a couple of mouthfuls of the soup and sampled a bit from each dish.
Finding the taste quite good, he thought Luo Yao would like it.
Uncle Fu chuckled awkwardly: "It seems I was overly suspicious. I'm sorry!"
Lin Ran signaled it was okay, but Luo Yao coldly added, "You won't be receiving your bonus this month!"
Uncle Fu's eyes widened in shock. This felt even worse than being killed.
Lin Ran generously interceded: "Luo Yao, Uncle Fu was just concerned about your safety. Let's not worry about the bonus. Instead, try the soup."
It wasn't that Lin Ran was taking advantage of his privileged position but rather that Uncle Fu was a good person and had Luo Yao's best interests at heart. That was why he stepped in to plead his case.
Luo Yao nodded, and Uncle Fu, full of gratitude, wanted to thank Lin Ran but saw Luo Yao's slightly furrowed brow and immediately shut his mouth.
It wasn't his place to speak during the couple's meal.
Lin Ran then quietly watched as Luo Yao elegantly scooped up a spoonful of the beauty soup he had prepared and brought it to her lips. The soft, romantic candlelight made her already stunning visage even more captivating. It felt like he could never tire of looking at her.
Luo Yao: "What are you looking at?"
Lin Ran: "You're beautiful."
Luo Yao frowned: "Who's prettier, me or Liu Ruxue?"

chapters.title: Chapter 6
chapters.content:
"A Sure Win?"
Lin Ran: "I must have been blind before, like Shakespeare without the 'shay,' to have overlooked such a beautiful woman right in front of me. Now that my vision has returned, I want to look at you more, to gaze at you for a lifetime!"
"But I deeply regret it!"
The first part of Lin Ran's words stirred Luo Yao's heart, while the last statement left her feeling uncertain.
What regrets? Regretting giving herself to him yesterday?
Lin Ran felt the air around him suddenly grow colder, and his heart jolted.
Why the sudden anger? Could it be...?
Lin Ran: "I deeply regret not appreciating your beauty before. I truly deserve to die!"
Indeed, Luo Yao's icy aura dissipated, and the curve of her lips grew more pronounced.
Uncle Fu's pupils dilated.Lin Ran is... speaking sweet words?
My word! Miss hasn't smiled like that in ages.
Lin Ran's words made Luo Yao tremble, and a drop of soup slid down her lip. She naturally reached up to wipe it, only to collide with Lin Ran's hand as he reached over to do the same.
Even though they had shared the most intimate of moments, both were momentarily stunned, their hearts racing as Luo Yao's soup droplet slowly descended and fell, evoking fanciful thoughts.
Lin Ran retracted his hand, flustered.
"Sorry! I just wanted to help you wipe it!"
Luo Yao: "Feed me!"
Lin Ran: "Huh?"
Luo Yao: "Feed me dinner!"
Lin Ran gazed at Luo Yao's delicate, crimson lips and swallowed hard.
"Alright!"
Lin Ran scooped a spoonful of soup from his own bowl and gently brought it to Luo Yao's lips.
Uncle Fu's heart skipped a beat.
He knew Luo Yao had a severe case of germophobia and loathed men, yet Lin Ran was feeding her soup with his own spoon?
He swiftly took out his phone and sent a message: [Prepare a crystal coffin]
Then, he witnessed his mistress open her mouth and drink, as if even licking the spoon slightly.
Hmm! Must be a figment of my imagination.
Luo Yao's calm voice echoed: "Uncle Fu, are you planning to join us for our candlelit dinner?"
Uncle Fu's spine chilled instantly as he hastily shook his head, motioning everyone to leave. He too exited, taking out his phone again to send another message: [Cancel the coffin order].
Watching Luo Yao's lips glisten, Lin Ran tenderly continued feeding her.
This feeling filled Luo Yao with satisfaction, drawing her deeper into the moment.
Ran, are you really not deceiving me?
Even if you are, I'll take it.
Luo Yao had no appetite for food, yet this was Lin Ran's cooking, so she wanted to taste it all, to eat as much as possible.
For someone who usually detested eating, this was truly a first.
The meal dragged on for a long time, from the dining room to the bedroom.
Just as Luo Yao straddled Lin Ran, his phone rang, displaying the note:
[Goddess]
Damn! I must have missed blocking this witch earlier.
Luo Yao naturally saw the screen, and the temperature in the room plummeted by eight degrees.
Lin Ran calmly ended the call, ready to kiss Luo Yao when the phone rang again. Just as he prepared to hang up and power off, Luo Yao commanded:
"Answer it!"
A thousand wild horses galloped through Lin Ran's heart.
Liu Ruxue, you'd better behave and not say anything to upset my wife.
He picked up the call.
"Lin Ran brother! Where are you?"
Before Lin Ran could speak, Luo Yao's dominating presence pressed in.
"I'm with... mmm! Mmm?"
Liu Ruxue: ??? What is that sound?
"Lin Ran brother, speak up! Are you alright? Who was the woman who took you away that day?"
Before Lin Ran could curse, Luo Yao posed a slightly challenging query.
"Ran, who is the woman you love the most?"
"You... I only love you!"
In response, different sounds of pleasure filled the air, sounds Liu Ruxue was all too familiar with, spurring her urgency.
"Lin Ran, what are you doing? Why do I hear a woman's voice near you!"
With both 'rabbits' nearly suffocating him, Lin Ran was about to lose it, pushing Luo Yao away, an action that almost triggered her explosive temper.
"I'm with my wife! You better scram if you've got nothing, and go die if you have anything to say!"
His words were immediately followed by Luo Yao engulfing him once more, emitting even more piercing sounds.
Sounds of delight, of challenge, and of disdain.
Liu Ruxue couldn't bear it.
"Lin Ran, I didn't expect you to be such a person. I misjudged you. You've utterly disappointed me, waaah!"
And with that, she hung up.
Luo Yao smiled, an expression Lin Ran had never seen before.
Ethereal? Mocking? Bitter?
Time passed.
Lin Ran experienced the most genuine Luo Yao.
He cursed himself for his past blindness and stupidity.
So what was it that he truly desired?
...ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
"Luo Yao! One day, I fear I might die here. Can we perhaps... exercise some restraint?"
In her previous life, Luo Yao always held the upper hand. Who would have thought that this life would follow the same pattern?
After all, he was the man, wasn't he?
Luo Yao was satisfied with how Lin Ran had treated Liu Ruxue today.
"Crazy? But I simply can't help it. It feels like only by merging completely do you truly become mine. If you were to die beneath me, I would unhesitatingly follow you into death. In the afterlife, you'd still be mine!"
Lin Ran remained silent, well aware that Luo Yao would indeed go that far.
What was so special about him? Why had Luo Yao taken a liking to him specifically?
"Ran! I'm scared! I fear you might turn and leave me tomorrow!"
"So! Even if you are deceiving me... can you keep the lie going?"
Lin Ran's heart ached.
Even if Luo Yao believes me to be lying, she still desires this. What kind of twisted love is this?
Even if it's fake, I cherish it more than pearls.
However, Lin Ran was gradually growing fond of this sensation. He could even say that after just two nights since his rebirth, he was already becoming addicted.
"Luo Yao! Whether you believe it or not, I'll always be by your side, loving and protecting you!"
"We'll continue like this, trust me... okay?"
Tears glimmered in Luo Yao's eyes, but she knew she couldn't cry.
In this world, everyone can cry, but not her.
To cry would be to reveal her vulnerability; once vulnerable, she'd be trampled upon.
She had to be the strongest Luo Yao, only then could she protect her Ran.
If Ran tires of her, leaves her, then she'd turn him into a specimen or burn him to ash and devour it, to be together forever.
Delirious thoughts permeated.
Lin Ran was utterly overwhelmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 7
chapters.content:
In the early morning, Lin Ran woke up to find Luo Yao gone again.
Does this girl not need sleep?
After finishing his breakfast, Lin Ran headed to the walk-in closet he had never entered before.
It was filled with luxurious clothes he had never even glanced at, because he didn't want anything from Luo Yao.
But now, things were different. He now belonged entirely to Luo Yao, so he might as well enjoy the perks.
Each piece of clothing was like a work of art. He chose one that seemed decent and changed into it.
Looking at himself in the mirror, he sighed—clothes really do make the man. The only flaw was his messy hair.
He thought for a moment and sent Luo Yao a message.
Now, no matter what he did, he wanted to report it to Luo Yao. It wasn't out of fear, but to cater to her delicate emotions.
To outsiders, she was ruthless and decisive, but Lin Ran knew how sensitive her heart was.[Honey! I want to go out and get a haircut, then head to the Lin Family house to pick up some things.]
Soon, Luo Yao replied.
[I'll send the stylist to the manor. Is that okay?]
Lin Ran: [Okay]
Meanwhile, on the other end of the phone, Luo Yao stared at the message, her mind racing.
"Honey..."
She loved that term.
Thinking about it, she changed the nickname [Ran] to [Husband].
Not long after, the stylist arrived at the manor, designing a hairstyle worth tens of millions according to Lin Ran's request.
"Uncle Fu, can you lend me a car?" It was impossible to hail a taxi at the manor.
Uncle Fu chuckled. "Mr. Lin, you're joking. You can take any car from the garage—they're all gifts from Miss Luo!"
Lin Ran suddenly remembered that Luo Yao had given him many things in the past, but he never even looked at them.
In the storage cabinet of the closet, there were numerous property deeds, car certificates, and a black card with an unknown balance.
"Alright! Could you also prepare some bodyguards for me to accompany me on an errand?"
"Of course, Mr. Lin!"
Entering the garage, Lin Ran was blown away—it was more luxurious than any luxury car show in the world.
He picked a Koenigsegg One:1, a car so expensive he had never even seen one before, and now he could drive it out to pick a fight.
Soon, a super luxury convoy was cruising through the streets of Beijing. Any other car on the road made way for them.
Following closely behind Lin Ran was Uncle Fu's car; he absolutely couldn't let Lin Ran escape again, especially after seeing how important Lin Ran was to Miss Luo.
This was a man who could make Miss Luo smile; he must not be lost.
Before long, Lin Ran parked the car neatly outside the Lin Family villa, flanked by ten bodyguards, and marched into the villa.
Inside the villa, Lin Jian had just been picked up from the hospital by the Lin Family. The family of three was chatting happily.
"Dad! Are you really not going to do anything about Brother? Contact him! If he's still alive, we can at least ask the kidnappers to leave us a whole body. After all, he's my beloved brother!"
"Yes, honey! Jian is right. Ran is also my son! You should talk to the kidnappers! Ask them to leave us a whole body so we can be properly buried, right?"
Lin Tianba scrunched up his face and immediately got a headache just thinking about that disobedient child.
Lin Ran had always been a well-behaved son. Why did I scold him last time?
If I hadn't scolded him, maybe we could have found a way to save him. But now…
"Humph! Don't bother with that ungrateful son. I'm his father. Even if he comes back, he has to kneel down and apologize before I’ll let him return to the Lin Family!"
Liu Yuemei looked worried on the surface, but inwardly, she was delighted.
Lin Tianba’s attitude toward Lin Ran had become nearly irreversible.
"Bang!"
Suddenly, the villa's door was smashed open by brute force.
"Old bastard! Your daddy is here to see you!"
The familiar voice stunned the three inside.
Seeing Lin Ran, Lin Tianba exploded in rage, pulling out a belt.
"You little bastard, you dare come back? If you don't kneel and apologize, I'll beat you to death!"
But before Lin Tianba could make a move, several bodyguards surged in from behind Lin Ran and pinned Lin Tianba to the ground, startling Lin Jian and his mother.
Lin Jian: "Brother is back! I missed you so much! I heard you were kidnapped, and I couldn't eat or sleep, just thinking about saving you!"
"But Brother, why did you come back and bring outsiders to bully Dad? Please release my dear father!"
Liu Yuemei: "Ran is back. You should let your father go. He's been so worried since you disappeared. He's been trying to contact the kidnappers to save you!"
Lin Ran: "……?"
Speechless.
With a single glance from Lin Ran, Lin Jian and Liu Yuemei were also pinned to the ground. A maid rushed out from the servant's quarters, froze when she saw it was Lin Ran.
"Master Lin!"
"Granny Wang, how are you?"
Granny Wang was the only person in the house Lin Ran didn't hate. She had helped him a lot in the past.
Lin Tianba, livid, struggled: "Ungrateful son, let me go! I'm your father!"
Lin Ran squatted down, took the belt from Lin Tianba, and flipped it around, hitting him hard with the buckle.
"Ah!"
A scream rang out as Lin Tianba bled from the head.
"Old man, remember this: don't ever say you're my father when we meet. And every time we see each other, you have to kneel and kowtow. Otherwise, I'll beat you like this every time!"
"Ah... Ah... Ah... Ah..."
Lin Tianba's screams echoed as Lin Jian and his mother watched in shock.
Satisfied and pleased with himself, Lin Ran stretched, then turned to Lin Jian and his mother.
Disgusting.
Lin Jian and Liu Yuemei met Lin Lan's gaze, not afraid, but with a trace of… excitement?
Yes, excitement.
Lin Ran slowly spoke: "Lawyer Xu, the rest is up to you."
After speaking, Lin Ran slowly went upstairs, returning to his old storage room.
Xu Kai, a top lawyer, stepped forward and handed a document to Lin Tianba, still groaning on the ground.
"What… is this?"
Xu Kai: "This is a document to sever ties between you and Mr. Lin Ran. Please sign."
Lin Tianba was stunned, unable to calm down.
When Lin Ran came downstairs again, Lin Tianba still hadn't signed. Seeing Lin Ran holding a suitcase, he suppressed his anger and asked:
"Ungrateful son! Are you serious?"
Lin Ran nodded: "What else did you expect?"
Lin Tianba laughed, a forced laugh.
"Hahaha! Fine, fine, fine! Listen to me, ungrateful son—you’ll never set foot in the Lin Family again! Even if you kneel and beg me, I will never recognize you as my son!"
Lin Ran smiled coolly: "Deal!"
Losing his cool, Lin Tianba signed the document, and Lin Jian and Liu Yuemei exchanged knowing smiles.
Lin Ran collected the papers, finding the sorrowful yet smirking faces of Lin Jian and his mother amusing.
"Oh, right! I’m taking my shares with me. The Suran Group's stock was left to me by my mother. You won't get a penny from me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 8
chapters.content:
This statement left several people shocked, as if they had just remembered something.
"You ungrateful child... Lin Ran! What are you doing with so much equity? Transfer the equity to me unconditionally right now, and I'll transfer it back to you after you graduate from college."
Lin Jian: "That's right, brother! Dad is the chairman, and having the company's equity under his name will give him more power in the company."
Liu Yuemei: "Lin Ran, be a good boy! Listen to your dad and transfer the equity to his name. Let him manage it for you."
Lin Ran almost threw up at the sight of this family's disgusting behavior.Thɪs ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
He shook the letter of disengagement in his hand: "You are all strangers to me. You insulted me, so I'm upset, and as a form of self-defense, I need to beat you to feel better!"
This statement even left Xu Kai, the lawyer standing beside them, a bit speechless.
"Leave them with at least one breath, don't kill them!"
Soon, the group was battered and bruised, and Liu Yuemei and her son, Lin Jian, no longer displayed the magnanimity of their past, instead cursing at Lin Ran.
"You ungrateful wretch, I'm your mother. I raised you all these years, and you dare have someone beat me? You’re just an ungrateful wretch!"Lin Ran: "My mother's name is Su Yanyan, not Liu Yuemei!"
"Brother! Stop letting them hit me, wuwuwu! It hurts so much!"
Lin Ran: "You're not my brother, I don’t have a brother!"
Lin Tianba, the father, also began to plead: "Lin Ran! Tell them to stop, I was wrong, don’t beat me anymore!"
With no backbone, Lin Ran felt utterly embarrassed.
In his past life, when he was tortured by Luo Yao to the point of wanting to die, he never begged for mercy. Yet, Lin Tianba started begging after just a few punches.
"Who’s the father here, exactly?"
Lin Tianba was in agony, gritting his teeth and saying, "You! You're my father!"
Lin Ran laughed.
"Right, since we've severed ties, some things need to be made clear. When I was thirteen, my mother passed away and left me 30% of Suran Group’s shares!"
"I’m twenty-three now, so you owe me the dividends from the past ten years. I checked the company’s financial reports—you need to give me three hundred million yuan."
"I beat you up today, and based on the highest treatment standard at a pet hospital, I’ll compensate you ten thousand yuan. I spent a total of eighteen thousand yuan during my time at the Lin Family, so you still owe me two hundred ninety-nine million nine hundred ninety-seven thousand two hundred yuan. Remember to transfer it to my account!"
Lin Tianba was utterly stunned.
"What? How could I possibly have that much money?"
Lin Tianba wasn’t lying; he genuinely couldn’t come up with that much cash. Although Suran Group’s market value had reached three billion yuan, it was impossible to mobilize three hundred million in short order.
Many companies operate like this: even with a market value of ten billion yuan, it’s difficult for them to quickly come up with three hundred million.
Even if Lin Tianba could, he wouldn’t dare to touch the money—it’s company funds, and his stake in Suran Group was only 21%, less than Lin Ran’s.
Speaking without considering the facts, even if Lin Tianba had three hundred million, he wouldn’t give it to Lin Ran.
Lin Ran: "I don’t care about that. Anyway, my money was spent by you, and my lawyer will handle it. If you can’t pay, I’ll send you to jail."
Lin Tianba: "Ungrateful child! Didn’t I do anything for you all these years?"
Lin Ran: "Hah! Didn’t we just calculate everything clearly? The day after my mother passed away, you brought your mistress home, and since then, you gave me 300 yuan every month. Until I turned eighteen, you gave me a total of eighteen thousand yuan, and after that, I never spent a dime from your house!"
Lin Tianba was stunned. He hadn’t expected Lin Ran to have spent so little from the family. Thinking about it, it seemed true, and a pang of guilt arose in him.
"But you must have spent a lot on food, clothing, and daily necessities over the years!"
Lin Tianba figured that at the very least, Lin Ran’s food and clothing were his responsibility.
Lin Ran: "Hm, I ate at school, and even when I was at home, I cooked, cheaper than a nanny. After cooking, I was often punished and couldn’t eat."
"I wore school uniforms until I was eighteen, never buying a single piece of clothing. After turning eighteen, the clothes I wore were bought with money I earned from part-time jobs. In that case, how about we add a charge of child abuse to the list?"
Lin Tianba was completely shocked. It seemed he had been quite harsh on his son...
"Stop spacing out. The dividends can’t be short by even a single cent. If a single cent is missing, my lawyer will send you to jail, with an added charge of child abuse!"
After saying that, Lin Ran turned and left, leaving the people in the villa howling in pain.
"Ungrateful child... ungrateful child!"
Lin Ran: "What a relief... what a relief!"
As he walked out of the villa, Lin Ran noticed a pink bicycle parked at the gate.
This was Lin Ran’s former means of transportation, which he had bought with money he earned from part-time jobs. In contrast, Lin Jian rode a luxury car worth millions.
And why was the bicycle pink? Because Liu Ruxue liked pink.
But Liu Ruxue had never been on this bicycle.
"Destroy it!"
Getting back into his car, Lin Ran drove to Huatian Plaza, the most famous luxury shopping mall in Beijing.
Inside the mall, Lin Ran was baffled.
An ordinary handbag for eighteen thousand yuan? A bottle of perfume for thirty-eight thousand? Is a lump of dog poop also priced at eight hundred and eighty yuan?
Despite being born into the Lin Family, Lin Ran had never shopped here, as the family never gave him money.
Before turning eighteen, he was given three hundred yuan a month; after that, not a single penny.
They called it "raising a child in poverty," so why didn’t they do the same for Lin Jian?
Even so, Lin Ran still tried to maintain that non-existent "family bond."
Crap! I was really a jerk before!
Looking at his phone, which showed a balance of thirteen thousand yuan, Lin Ran fell silent.
This was the result of a whole summer of hard work along with various part-time jobs.
Originally, he had planned to buy a bag for Liu Ruxue, but now he decided to buy a gift for Luo Yao.
The issue was, everything here was incredibly expensive!
Even so, Lin Ran didn’t intend to use the black card Luo Yao had given him. It wasn’t about being noble; he just wanted to buy Luo Yao’s gift with his own money.
Perhaps noticing Lin Ran’s predicament, the shop assistant started to neglect him. At that moment, Fu Bo walked over.
"Mr. Lin, do you like anything? Should I have the entire store wrapped up for you?"
Lin Ran shook his head: "No need, I want to buy Luo Yao’s gift with the money I earned myself!"
In the end, Lin Ran chose a bracelet priced exactly at thirteen thousand yuan.
After paying, the shop assistant gave a polite smile.
Receiving the bracelet, Lin Ran imagined how Luo Yao would look wearing it.
Luo Yao, this is my first gift to you. Although it isn’t expensive, it’s all I have.
When I earn more in the future, I will give you the best things in the world.
Suddenly, Lin Ran started to feel unwell.
In a novel, something usually happens at a time like this, right?
"Lin Ran?"
Hearing Liu Ruxue’s familiar voice, Lin Ran’s face darkened.
"Damn! Bad luck!"

chapters.title: Chapter 9
chapters.content:
If Luo Yao saw this, wouldn't she beat me up again?
He didn’t know that Luo Yao had just received the news and was rushing over.
Liu Ruxue and her best friend Huo Haini appeared by Lin Ran’s side.
Seeing Liu Ruxue again, Lin Ran realized that he didn’t feel anything for her anymore, not even a hint of fond memories.
The only thing on his mind was the image of her in her previous life, turned into a "beauty in a bottle" performing in Southeast Asia, which sent shivers down his spine.
Luo Yao is really ruthless!
But no matter how ruthless you are, in my heart, you will always be the most beautiful Luo Yao.
“Lin Ran! Is it really you? Who was that woman who took you away that day? And why did you block all my contacts? Do you have any idea how worried my uncle and aunt are about you?”
Huo Haini immediately noticed the beautiful gift box in Lin Ran’s hand.
“Lin Ran! Is this gift for our Ruxue?” she said, reaching out to snatch it.Lin Ran quickly pulled the item back. This was a gift for his beloved wife, and he had to guard it carefully.
Huo Haini was furious: “Lin Ran! What is the meaning of this? Do you know who I am? I am Ruxue’s best friend! With this kind of attitude, how do you expect to win her heart?”
Liu Ruxue bit her lip, waiting for Lin Ran’s reply, her pitiful expression expertly executed.
She found Lin Ran incredibly handsome today. His bangs were gone, he had a new hairstyle, and his outfit suited him perfectly.
That woman from the other day was much more beautiful than her, even making her, the campus queen of Capital University, feel inferior. And that phone call last night…
No, she must be with Lin Ran. Only then can she help Lin Jian get the shares in Lin Ran’s hands.
Even if she fails, with Lin Ran’s love for her, being with him wouldn’t be so bad.
Lin Ran is so handsome; bringing him around wouldn’t be a disgrace.
“Our Ruxue is so beautiful. Even if you’re a bit handsome, it doesn’t matter. In today’s society, you can’t win a girl’s heart without sincerity! Do you even understand that?”
“Now, if you’re willing to buy a branded bag for both me and Ruxue, I might convince her to give you a chance to get closer to her.”
Liu Ruxue gently tugged at Lin Ran's sleeve: "Brother Lin Ran! I just care about you too much, that's why I'm asking. Even if that woman likes you and something happened between you, I believe you were forced! Can we go back to how we were before?"
This scene was just caught by Luo Yao, who had just arrived. Her eyes pierced through the scene like knives.
Lin Ran quickly executed a Pan Zhoudan-style dodge to avoid Liu Ruxue’s reaching hand.
“Liu Ruxue, you’ve got issues in your head, don’t drag me into it, get lost.”
Liu Ruxue froze, and Huo Haini was seething with anger.
“Lin Ran, who do you think you are? Our Ruxue is so beautiful and forgiving, yet you don’t appreciate it and even curse at us?”
Lin Ran almost laughed at her.
“Beautiful? My wife is far more beautiful than her. She’s stunning, wealthy, and loves me deeply. I adore her the most. Where do you get the audacity to flaunt your looks in front of me?”
Liu Ruxue took a step back in disbelief. She couldn’t believe these were Lin Ran’s words.
She wanted her old Brother Lin Ran back, the gentle, caring, and all-encompassing one who worshipped only her.
“Brother Lin Ran! You… you said that woman is?”
Luo Yao's overwhelming killing intent suddenly vanished, and she stopped in her tracks, quietly observing.
This change shocked her assistant Liu Meng.
Mr. Lin, you finally see the sincerity of our President Luo. The heavens have finally smiled upon us.
Lin Ran chuckled coldly.
Liu Ruxue, don't be unconvinced. Whether my wife is prettier than you or not, you know it yourself. And even if she were hideously ugly, I would still love only her!
Liu Ruxue was incredulous: “Why?”
Lin Ran’s expression softened with nostalgic warmth: “Because no matter how much I love her, it will never compare to how much she loves me!”
Liu Ruxue: “What about me then? What about all the time you pursued me?”
Lin Ran: “What are you? In a deck of cards, you’re the king, the busiest one in the circus, the craziest in Gotham, the one guarding McDonald’s. You’re Batman’s biggest client, the pillar of the Joker!”
Liu Ruxue/Huo Haini: “???”
Uncle Fu suddenly stepped in to add insult to injury: “The clown among clowns!”
Liu Ruxue was utterly humiliated. She was angry, truly angry. Even Lin Ran cheating with another woman hadn’t made her this furious.
“Lin Ran! You actually… dare to call me a clown?”
As if remembering something…
Lin Ran: “Not really! You’re actually quite a beauty!”
Upon hearing this, the entire place fell silent. Luo Yao turned icy again, and Liu Meng, holding her forehead, silently prayed for Lin Ran.
Lin Ran: “My wife could turn you into a human vase and send you to Southeast Asia as a beauty. Have you watched "Her Vanished Existence"? That’s the kind of beauty she can create!”
Seeing this, Luo Yao’s lips curved slightly.
Hm… Ran’s idea isn’t bad.
Liu Meng, her assistant, felt her heartbeat stop, then restart, her pupils dilating terrifyingly with each beat.
This little… young master in front of her could actually stir such intense emotions in President Luo?
No wonder she had ordered me to report Lin Ran’s every move.
Lin Ran’s words frightened Liu Ruxue.
She knew he was just threatening her, but it still chilled her to the bone.
Lin Ran: “Alright! I have to go home and spend time with my wife now! Stop bothering me in the future; I’m afraid my wife might misunderstand. Also… I never liked you, not before, and definitely not now!”
“As for all those things I gave you before, consider them thrown to the dogs!”Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on
If I hadn’t lost the shopping records, I would’ve demanded them back.
Liu Ruxue’s eyes filled with tears, looking like a helpless flower wronged by a heartless man. Lin Ran found her act utterly disgusting.
Actually, he really wanted to kill Liu Ruxue, but killing is against the law!
And instead of a quick death, wouldn’t it be more interesting to let her suffer?
Lin Ran was startled by his own thoughts. When did he develop such a mindset?
Ah! Blame it on the company of dark people!
Turning around, Lin Ran froze.
When did Luo Yao arrive? Crap!
She saw me with Liu Ruxue, would she misunderstand?
Who understands this, folks? It’s like setting off fireworks on a pole—a coincidence!
Wife! I swear there's nothing going on between me and Liu Ruxue. If I'm lying, may my entire family suffer a horrible death!
The air was heavy with a palpable sense of impending violence, and Liu Meng began clearing the area with bodyguards. Luo Yao slowly approached Liu Ruxue.
“Slap! Slap!” Two crisp sounds echoed.
“Get lost! Stay away from Lin Ran or I’ll throw you both to the sharks!”
Liu Ruxue and Huo Haini were both overwhelmed by Luo Yao’s intimidating aura. They dared not utter a word, trembling in fear but stubbornly refusing to collapse. They covered their faces and scurried away in disgrace.
This woman, with her breathtaking beauty, radiated an aura of death, leaving them too frightened to even speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 10
chapters.content:
Just as she said she would throw someone into the sea to feed sharks, she definitely would.
The shop clerks were trembling with fear.
Huatian Plaza belonged to Luo Corporation, and the woman in front of them was no other than the head of Luo Corporation.
The young man earlier, was he somehow connected to President Luo?
I hope we didn't offend him.
Luo Yao's gaze fell on Lin Ran's hand.
"Buying it for Liu Ruxue?"
Lin Ran immediately clarified.
"No, it's not for Liu Ruxue. It's a gift for you!"
"Sorry, my means are limited. This is a bracelet I bought with all my money. If I'm lying, my whole family will die!" Lin Ran quickly unwrapped the package.Indeed, Luo Yao's murderous aura disappeared instantly as she looked down at the exquisite bracelet, seeing it as the most beautiful artwork in the world.
Did Ran mean he spent all his assets to choose this gift for me?
She slowly extended her hand: "Put it on for me."
Lin Ran complied without hesitation, carefully sliding the not-so-expensive bracelet onto her delicate wrist. Luo Yao was very pleased.
"Transfer the ownership of this plaza to Lin Ran."
Liu Meng's eyes widened in shock, but she quickly composed herself: "Understood, President Luo!"
Lin Ran wasn't particularly keen on accepting it, but he didn't protest, knowing that Luo Yao's gifts were not something he could refuse. Otherwise, he would only face severe consequences.
The countless assets in the walk-in closet had already proven this point.
"It's beautiful, and I love it!"
To be honest, seeing Liu Ruxue with Lin Ran earlier almost triggered her fury.
Lin Ran didn't expect that a few words and a small gift would calm Luo Yao down so easily, making her behave like a little girl.
If others found out about this, they would be utterly shocked.
The ruthless and decisive Luo Yao acting like a little girl? That's absurd!
"Kiss me, Lin Ran."
Lin Ran stiffened, glancing around.
Huh? Where's everyone? Uncle Fu? The bodyguards? The assistants? The shop clerks?
Lin Ran naturally bent down and kissed her. Luo Yao wrapped her arms tightly around Lin Ran.
Ran, why? Why did you lie to me?
Let me enjoy this moment. If you leave me in the future, I'll go insane.
After a long time, Luo Yao's gaze became slightly dazed.
"Lin Ran, I want –"
Lin Ran was startled: "Here? Let's go home, okay?"
Luo Yao nodded.
They arrived at the parking lot, where Luo Yao pulled Lin Ran into the custom-made Maybach. As for Lin Ran's car, someone else would handle it.
With the vehicle starting up, the convoy exited the parking lot.
Even amidst heavy traffic, other vehicles still made way for the Maybach and the Koenigsegg.
A private car driver sneered: "What's so great about fancy cars? Our car for less than a hundred thousand is more stable!"
His wife gave a knowing smile: "Maybe the people inside are... communicating?"
The driver: "Wow, how did you know, wife?"
The woman: "Because I… often read Web novels on Tomato!"
The driver: "My wife is so knowledgeable!"
The cars entered the estate, where the driver and Liu Meng tactfully got out, not wanting to disturb the couple. No one wanted to risk their life by intruding.
The car's occupants hadn't come out yet.
"Lin Ran, call me."
"Luo Yao."
"Not that!"
"...Wife!"
"Again!"
"Baby?"
Luo Yao loved Lin Ran at this moment. His adorableness made her heart flutter.
The car was filled with romance.
Luo Yao gazed at Lin Ran intensely.
"Why?"
"Why what?"
"Why did you suddenly treat me so well?"
"Because I love you!"
Luo Yao didn't believe it, but she didn't want to endlessly question, fearing that she might discover a reason so heartbreaking that it would crush her.
If Lin Ran left her, she would truly go mad and perhaps die.
"How many gifts have you given to Liu Ruxue?"
Lin Ran shuddered, unable to comprehend how Luo Yao's thoughts jumped so quickly.
A tricky question?
"I've given gifts to many people in my life. Friends, close buddies, classmates—but the only one I truly wanted to give to my lover is you."
This answer was acceptable in Luo Yao's eyes.
"Remember, you can only give gifts to one woman from now on."
Lin Ran: "Yes, ma'am!"
When the two got out of the car, Uncle Fu promptly had the servants prepare dinner.
Lin Ran happily spooned and fed Luo Yao, enjoying the task, before he started his own meal.
Late at night, after the exhausting work, Lin Ran fell asleep, while Luo Yao clung to him, wanting to merge him into herself.
Is it because of her body that he chose to stay?
If that's the case, that would be perfect!
For a long time, Luo Yao shook her head.
Could it be that she had people watching him, and everything that happened during the day was just his act?
He cut ties with the Lin family and distanced himself from Liu Ruxue. Was all of it to protect them?
Because he knew she might use them as leverage to force him to stay by her side?
No… Lin Ran, you can't do this to me.
The more she thought, the more terrified she became, and cold sweat broke out on her body. She quietly left the room, glancing back at Lin Ran before heading towards the secret chamber.
Sometime later, in a daze, Lin Ran seemed to see a stunningly beautiful woman applying something.
In the morning, Lin Ran came downstairs and saw Uncle Fu, slightly embarrassed: "Uncle Fu, the replenishing soup—"
Uncle Fu gave a smile that suggested he understood: "It's all prepared for the young master!"
Lin Ran felt a bit awkward, as if he were admitting his inadequacy. It's not that he couldn't perform, it's just that President Luo's demands were excessive, okay!
Though he also enjoyed it, continuing like this could be dangerous.
Entering the dining room, he found Luo Yao already there.
"Don't you have work today?"
Luo Yao nodded: "It's the weekend. Urgent matters can be handled from home."
For some reason, Lin Ran felt Luo Yao seemed a bit off.
Feeding the little devil had become Lin Ran's routine, and each time he felt a deep satisfaction.
Seeing his wife eat so elegantly.
Seeing her drink soup, so beautiful and alluring.
Her gaze when looking at him was utterly captivating.
She was perfect in every way.
The weekends were wonderful and heartwarming, and Lin Ran was thoroughly enjoying himself, until the second evening.
Luo Yao: "Do you want to drink?"
Lin Ran: "…? Huh?"
"...Sure!"
If his wife wanted to drink, he would accompany her, even at the risk of embarrassment due to his poor drinking skills.
Luo Yao got up and took a bottle from the liquor cabinet – Moutai?
Wait, she's drinking baijiu?
Oh well, as long as she's happy.
On her way back to the table, Luo Yao felt a sharp pain in her leg, stumbled, and the Moutai slipped from her hand.
Lin Ran reacted quickly, spinning 360 degrees, one hand supporting Luo Yao's waist, the other catching the falling bottle of Moutai.

chapters.title: Chapter 11
chapters.content:
Ambiguous actions made Luo Yao's heart flutter—a feeling only Lin Ran could evoke.
"Dog man, hold on tight."
Dog man?
Fine, in my previous life, I guess I was kind of a dog.
After a few sips of alcohol, Lin Ran began to feel lightheaded and had many things he wanted to let out.
Luo Yao's eyes narrowed slightly; she knew Lin Ran's alcohol tolerance was terrible.
Sip after sip, until the entire bottle was empty, Lin Ran was spinning around in a daze.
"Wife! You… are you upset about something? Why are you flying in the sky?"
Luo Yao stood up and effortlessly scooped him into her arms in a princess carry.
"Hehe! Wife, your strength is incredible! Are you going to compete in the Olympics? Why do I see two bunnies running in front of me?"Placing Lin Ran on the bed in the bedroom, he twitched all over.
"Wife, I… I admit I can't handle it anymore; you’ve drained me dry!"
"We do it at least ten times a day—who can cope with that?"
Hearing Lin Ran's bold words, Luo Yao was silent for a moment.
However, being called "wife" repeatedly by Lin Ran made Luo Yao quite pleased.
Looks like getting him drunk could become a regular thing.
"Ran! Do you still like Liu Ruxue?"
Lin Ran suddenly sat up, startled.
"Liu Ruxue? Is she human or a ghost? You… are you Liu Ruxue?"
Lin Ran's gaze at Luo Yao began to blur.
Luo Yao's expression grew colder, and she thought for a moment before speaking in a coquettish voice.
"It's me, Lin Ran brother! Don't you love me anymore?" As she spoke, she reached out to steady him, fearing he might fall.
Who would have thought that Lin Ran's reaction was as though he had touched something filthy.
"Don’t touch me… I’m afraid Luo Yao won’t like me if I get dirty!"
Luo Yao?
She liked this name; in fact, she liked every term of endearment Lin Ran had for her.
"Who is Luo Yao?"
Lin Ran: "Stop touching me, stop touching me—I’ll have to wash later!"
"Luo Yao is… my wife! My master, my heaven… the person I love most."
"And also the person who loves me the most in this world!"
Luo Yao froze, unable to believe these words had come out of Lin Ran's mouth.
If he truly loved her so much, why had he never shown it before, even always seeming to despise and fear her?
Looking at Lin Ran's state, Luo Yao narrowed her eyes.
Was he faking it?
Or was it the classic scenario where a man's seven parts are drunk, and his three parts are acting, till you cry?
"Ran! I’m Ruxue! Do you really not love me anymore?"
Lin Ran: "I love… I love you less than I love a dog…" After uttering these words, Lin Ran collapsed onto the bed.
Watching Lin Ran peacefully fall asleep, Luo Yao gently undressed him and covered him with a blanket with utmost tenderness.
Overwhelmed by fatigue or truly drunk, Lin Ran seemed to witness his past life.
He saw the woman who had gone mad for him.
——"Ran, I’ve caught you; I want to marry you… take me!"
"Why won’t you listen? Why don’t you want to marry me?"
"If Ran doesn’t want to be with me, then let’s go to hell together!"
"Ran, be good, a little more obedient, and you won’t be in pain."
"If you run again, I’ll kill you and take out your heart and liver to put into my body."
"Ran, don’t leave me, okay! I only have you…"
"We’re married; look, I’m wearing the wedding dress for you, beautiful, isn’t it?"
"To die together with you, how wonderful…"
"When we’re down there… will you look at me a little more…"——
The final scene froze over the two of them in a crystal coffin.
It was beautiful, truly beautiful!
The thousands of lights in the city, there was indeed one waiting for me.
This is our tomb, and it’s also our home.
It’s just that my body feels a bit uncomfortable, as if it’s about to explode.
Waking up, Lin Ran's head was throbbing, and his bladder felt as if it would burst.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
In the dim moonlight, he saw a beautiful, enchanting figure repeatedly coating something.
Why did that feel like a recurring scene?
"Hmmm…"
At Lin Ran's grunt, Luo Yao's movements paused.
Whether Lin Ran’s words were true, fake, or an act, they did stabilize Luo Yao’s emotions.
Otherwise, she might have gone back into that secret room, the one where she hurt herself to calm her emotions.
She diligently applied medicine to all her wounds, not wanting to miss any.
If there were scars, Ran wouldn’t like them…
She didn’t want Lin Ran to know about these things, nor did she want to show him her scars. She wanted to try her best to be the person Lin Ran liked.
But she knew she couldn’t.
"Are you thirsty?"
Lin Ran: "Luo Yao, what are you doing?"
A cold aura suddenly enveloped him, and Lin Ran shivered.
Could it be?
"Wife! What are you doing?"
The cold aura instantly disappeared, and Lin Ran internally marveled at how this was even better than air conditioning.
Luo Yao: "Nothing! Can’t sleep!"
Lin Ran got up and went to the bathroom, while Luo Yao prepared a glass of water for him.
Returning, Lin Ran was still drowning in headache and thirst.
Luo Yao: "Drink some water."
"Have my wife feed me!"
Lin Ran’s bold statement made Luo Yao pause.
But without much hesitation, Luo Yao took a big gulp of water, held it in her mouth, and kissed him, passing the cool liquid into his mouth.
Feeling the coolness being transferred, Lin Ran’s Adam's apple bobbed up and down as he slowly opened his eyes.
"Is that enough?"
"No!"
"Do you want more?"
"Yes!"
The entire glass of water was transferred to Lin Ran, who finally seemed satisfied.
If the lights were turned on at that moment, Lin Ran would be astonished to see Luo Yao’s slightly flushed cheeks.
But often, it’s in these dim, hazy moments that one can truly appreciate the beauty of the person in front of them.
"Wife!"
"Mmm!"
"You’re so beautiful!"
After a moment of silence: "Mmm!"
With that, Lin Ran once again drifted off into a dream, perhaps sparring with the God of Dreams.
Lying beside Lin Ran, Luo Yao also drifted into sleep.
A woman plagued by severe insomnia could only find brief rest when Lin Ran was by her side.
Only with Lin Ran could she grasp that fleeting feeling of tranquility.
If only she could, Luo Yao would use any means necessary to keep Lin Ran by her side, even if it were cruel.
Ran, when will you return to me…
The next day, Lin Ran woke up to become a vigorous young man once more.
This was one of the few opportunities for him to recover his energy after being reborn.
Today, Luo Yao did not go to the company, instead handling work at the manor.
She felt that spending her life with Lin Ran here wouldn’t be so bad.
But she knew she couldn’t; so she was now grasping every moment she could be with Lin Ran.
If she stopped moving forward, countless others would step over her body to rise.
By then, Lin Ran would likely meet a grim fate as well.
So she had to be ruthless, channeling her most authentic ruthlessness toward her enemies until no one could stand in her way.
Then, she could give all her tenderness to Lin Ran.

chapters.title: Chapter 12
chapters.content:
Today, Xu Kai Lawyer finally delivered Lin Ran's newly opened household registration booklet.
"Mr. Lin, Lin Tianba has no intention of handing over the dividends yet. I've already arranged to prepare a lawsuit! But before we sue, I need to confirm with you, since you two are, after all, biological father and son."
Lin Ran let out a derisive chuckle.
"Aside from contributing a single sperm, he hasn't fulfilled any responsibilities. Go ahead! Let that old man face reality, and ideally, send him to prison."
With Lin Ran's approval, Xu Kai took his leave.
The first thing Lin Ran thought of upon receiving the household registration booklet was to head to the civil affairs bureau with Luo Yao to get married. He was startled by his own thoughts.
Although in his previous life, Luo Yao had donned a wedding dress for him.
But Lin Ran sometimes struggled to discern whether Luo Yao wanted to possess him or if it was just some other kind of obsession.
He also wasn't sure if Luo Yao wanted to make their relationship public.
Entering the study, Luo Yao was staring blankly at her computer. Lin Ran moved cautiously, making sure not to make a sound.He quietly approached Luo Yao, leaned in, and kissed her on the cheek.
"Good morning kiss!"
Startled by Lin Ran's sudden appearance, Luo Yao felt her heartbeat quicken, and her lips curled into a beautiful smile.
Turning around, she gave Lin Ran a passionate French kiss.
"Now that's a good morning kiss!"
