Lin Ran scratched his head, thinking to himself, *My wife's still the bold one.*
Luo Yao: "How did it feel?"
Lin Ran: "It felt great! Even better if it lasted longer!"
Luo Yao: "I meant, how's your body?"
Lin Ran: "A bit dizzy in the head, but I'm far from weak. We could go another three hundred rounds!"
Luo Yao narrowed her eyes: "Didn't you say you wanted to be more temperate?"
Lin Ran patted his chest: "Well, I did rest all night, didn't I? Also, I wanted to discuss something with you, something…"
As he spoke, he glanced at Luo Yao's computer.
What he saw was a group of people with their jaws dropped, staring in shock…
Lin Ran froze, and the words "Let's go get our marriage certificate" stuck in his throat.
He had only wanted to see what Luo Yao was doing, but he never expected her to be in a video conference.
Luo Yao, the president, was holding a meeting at home!
Luo Yao showed no signs of embarrassment, simply gently closing her laptop.
As the boss's video feed in the conference room went dark, the executives couldn't hold back.
"Did I see that right? Who’s that young man? Our boss actually likes men? I thought she was repulsed by men!"
"That guy is really handsome though. He and the CEO look so perfect together!"
"Maybe he's the CEO's brother."
"Would your brother play like that? In that case, I can only say, awesome!"
"Or maybe he's the CEO’s kept boy toy. But I think it's the first time I've seen the CEO smile. She actually smiles?"
"Why not keep me? I can be a pet too!"
"You’re too ugly!"
"Anyway, it’s clear the CEO likes men. Sometimes I’m really afraid she’ll make a move on me. My sexual orientation is straight, although I admit the CEO is very much my type… cough… but I like men, not my own kind."
"Even if the CEO likes women, she wouldn’t like you. You don’t have what it takes to be a kept boy toy!"
"I’m curious, when the CEO’s with that handsome guy, who’s on top?"
"It’s obviously the CEO! What kind of question is that?"
"This is good. Hopefully, the man can soften the CEO’s heart a bit, making her a little gentler. Otherwise, every time I see her, it feels like I’m going to the guillotine. She’s terrifying!"
Liu Meng: "Are you guys serious? Talking about the boss during a meeting? If you don’t want to live, don’t drag me down. I’m logging off!"
Everyone: "???" "Don’t you want to finish the meeting??"
"Liu Meng’s already gone. Let’s log off too! If the sky falls, Liu Meng will take the blame!"
…
Back at the villa, Lin Ran was a bit bewildered, not out of embarrassment, but because he felt shy and worried about causing trouble for Luo Yao.
Luo Yao: "What did you want to discuss with me?"
Lin Ran, no longer having the courage to bring up the marriage certificate, stammered.
"Um… didn't I cause you trouble, did I?"
Luo Yao, finding Lin Ran's awkwardness amusing, shook her head.
"No."
"You agreed to what?"
Could it be that she knew he got the household registration booklet and wanted to get married with her? That was too magical!
"I agreed to let you freely enter and leave the manor, but on the condition that you don’t run away."
"And you must report to me at all times, come home every night to accompany me, and definitely not go see Liu Ruxue."
"If you don’t follow these rules, I’ll capture Liu Ruxue and your family and torture them!"
Lin Ran: ??? "Is that even possible?"
"Actually, I wasn’t talking about that! I wanted to say… I just got my household registration booklet, and I wanted to get our marriage certificate with you!"
Luo Yao stared at Lin Ran intently, remaining silent for a long time.
To Luo Yao, whether or not they got married didn’t matter. What truly mattered was whether Lin Ran was by her side.
As long as he stayed with her, remaining unmarried for life was fine.
But she understood the significance of marriage for ordinary people.
Was Lin Ran considering going public with their relationship? Or was he trying to reassure her, only to plan an escape later?
If they got married, would Lin Ran acknowledge her as his wife in public?
Various thoughts raced through Luo Yao’s mind.
Seeing that Luo Yao didn’t speak for a long time, Lin Ran felt a bit disappointed.
She… seemed reluctant, or perhaps didn’t want their relationship to go public.
"If you’re not willing, that’s fine. I wasn’t implying anything…"
Before he could finish, Lin Ran was suddenly grabbed by the collar and dragged outside by Luo Yao. Feeling the strength in Luo Yao’s hands, Lin Ran was dumbfounded.
Wait, Luo Yao, with her seemingly delicate frame, where did such power come from?
In his previous life, to resist Luo Yao, Lin Ran had trained a lot, but in the end, he still couldn’t escape her grasp. He thought it was because Luo Yao’s subordinates were too strong.
Now it seemed that Luo Yao herself was extraordinarily powerful.
Once outside, Luo Yao threw Lin Ran into the car and then got in herself. Without a word, she drove straight to their destination.
Luo Yao: "I’m not going with you to get a marriage certificate…"
When they next appeared, both of them held a certificate in their hands.
Luo Yao: "I’m just fulfilling a small request of yours."
And just like that, it was done?
It felt a bit like a dream.
"Luo Yao! I… owe you a wedding and a ring!"
Luo Yao: "I don’t want your ring. I just want you for myself… You can choose a ring you like."
Lin Ran: "When I make money, I’ll definitely buy you the most beautiful ring!"
Luo Yao shook her head: "Everything of mine is yours. The black card I gave you has a 100 billion yuan limit. If that’s not enough, just tell me, and I’ll give you all my money. You can buy whatever ring you want!"
Lin Ran: ???
How much is the limit?

chapters.title: Chapter 13
chapters.content:
Black Card?
Lin Ran knew about that card, it was in the storage cabinet of the villa's walk-in closet, but he had never used it.
Inside, there were also numerous documents, including luxury cars, property, gold bars, and bank cards.
A wife who is both rich and beautiful, and willing to spend on you—where can you find such a great wife?
Was I possessed in my previous life? That’s why I couldn’t see how great my wife was?
I really need to die!
"No! I want to earn my own money to buy."
Feeling Luo Yao's face gradually cooling down, Lin Ran reached out and cupped her face.
"Luo Yao, look at me. I am your man, and this family can't only have you putting in efforts. I need to earn money too."
"If it's money for myself, I’ll spend it without hesitation. Spending my wife's money isn’t embarrassing.""But for you, I want to earn it myself."
Only after saying this did Luo Yao regain her composure.
"Alright, I got it. From now on, you’re not allowed to call my name!"
"Then what should I call you? Wife? Yao Yao? My dear little sweetheart?"
"Whatever you want."
"Then I’ll switch it up. As long as it’s you, I’ll keep calling you whatever."
In fact, Luo Yao wanted to tell Lin Ran that he didn’t need to work so hard, because her wealth was so vast that even if he started a business, it would last him several lifetimes.
But she didn’t want to dampen his spirit, so she suppressed her thoughts.
If Lin Ran wanted to earn money, then let him. Perhaps it was just a matter of the little pride men had.
Lin Ran was now accepting and even trying to spend her money, which meant he might be gradually accepting her. That was progress.
Running her fingers over the relatively inexpensive bracelet on her wrist, Luo Yao felt that this was what happiness was.
Lin Ran: "Luo Yao, can I post on WeChat Moments?"
Luo Yao frowned, and Lin Ran cursed himself for being foolish.
"Yao Yao! Wife! Baby! Can I post on WeChat Moments?"
Luo Yao nodded. "Of course, A Ran! You can do whatever you want!"
Lin Ran snapped a photo of both hands holding their marriage certificate and posted it on his Moments with the caption:
【Taken. Loving my wife!】
This post immediately caused a huge stir.
First were his classmates, then his advisor, many of his former coworkers from part-time jobs, and his best friend Wu Zhishang.
All the comments were just a series of question marks:【???】
Only Wu Zhishang asked: 【Is this with Liu Ruxue?】Follow current novels on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
As for Liu Ruxue and the Lin family, since they had been blocked, they couldn’t see Lin Ran’s post.
Soon after, Wu Zhishang called, and as soon as the call connected, he started asking:
"Dude! What’s going on? Did you and Liu Ruxue get married?"
Lin Ran replied, "No, not Liu Ruxue. I’m completely over her."
"Then who is it? Bro, we can’t just marry anyone because we couldn’t get Liu Ruxue!"
"It’s not just anyone—it’s true love. She’s beautiful, sweet-voiced, and guess what? She’s a little rich girl!"
Wu Zhishang was stunned.
After a long silence, he blurted out, "Holy sh*t! Your momxxxxxxx!!!"
Lin Ran: "Alright! Don’t be jealous. We’ll talk in person tomorrow!"
Wu Zhishang: "Your momxxxxxxx!!!"
Lin Ran: "Tomorrow at the dorm, I’ll take you on a big mission!"
Wu Zhishang: "Your momxxxxxxx!!!"
Lin Ran: "I’ll give you my gaming account!"
Wu Zhishang: "Alright, brother!"
That night, Lin Ran’s mark became even more distinct.
Seeing the clear tooth marks on his shoulder, Luo Yao furrowed her beautiful brows.
"This mark?"
"I don’t want to use scar cream. This is something Yao Yao left for me. I want to keep it here forever."
"I want to tell the world that I belong to you."
Luo Yao lifted her eyes to gaze at Lin Ran, her eyes sparkling like stars. "Is that what you think?"
Lin Ran nodded. "Only this way can I feel your presence at all times..."
Lin Ran smirked internally. Talking to you in your own tone, would that leave you speechless?
The next day, Lin Ran felt the mark had become even more profound.
Was this girl part dog or part wolf?
At breakfast, Lin Ran suddenly looked up at the wall clock and smiled. This action made Uncle Fu, the butler, panic inwardly.
Lin Ran didn’t say anything and continued eating breakfast, then casually mentioned,
"Uncle Fu, you don’t need to follow me when I go out. I’m not used to it."
Just as Uncle Fu was about to speak, Lin ran added,
"You can ask Luo Yao if you want."
"Don’t worry, I won’t run away again."
Uncle Fu shook his head and went to call Luo Yao.
After a while, he came back.
"The lady said it’s fine."
Lin Ran didn’t mind being monitored by Luo Yao, but considering he would still be attending school in the future, having bodyguards following him everywhere would be too conspicuous.
After breakfast, Lin Ran drove out of the manor in a Koenigsegg, and through the rearview mirror, he noticed a business van following at a distance.
This confirmed his guess—telling Uncle Fu not to follow was just a superficial gesture.
Now he had gained significant freedom, able to leave the manor at will.
Of course, he understood that no matter where he went, someone would always be watching him—this was unavoidable.
After all, Luo Yao’s love for him came with a strong possessive streak, but he didn’t mind this feeling.
The reason he disliked it before was because he didn’t like Luo Yao’s dominance.
But now that he had decided to accept and love Luo Yao, he naturally had to accept her flaws.
Including that obsessive need to possess him.
This was fine as long as it wasn’t too conspicuous, and hidden surveillance was acceptable.
This would also help ease Luo Yao’s mind, and Lin Ran didn’t object nor planned to expose it.
At that moment, Luo Yao, who had already arrived at her office, was staring blankly at her phone screen.
She had just seen Lin Ran’s smile towards the camera and felt a chill run through her.
But seeing that Lin Ran seemed to have noticed nothing, she calmed down a bit.
Capital University, with the semester not yet starting, many students were still staying in the dorms, including Lin Ran’s best friend Wu Zhishang.
Lin Ran parked his car in the outdoor parking lot on the school grounds and returned to his former dorm, where he found his buddy Wu Zhishang.
In his previous life, after learning about Lin Ran’s death, the one who cried the hardest was this friend, sobbing as if he were a grandson at his grandfather’s funeral.
Often, only death could reveal who genuinely cared about you.
For this reason alone, Lin Ran was determined to secure his prosperity and save him, ensuring he wouldn’t meet the same fate as before.
Lin Ran clearly remembered that Wu Zhishang was soon to face a series of misfortunes.
The first was that the chairman of his father’s company absconded with funds, and as a manager, Wu’s Father was used as a scapegoat, ending up in jail.
Wu’s Mother struggled to keep the shattered family together, her hair turning white in just one year.
Due to the sudden family crisis, Wu Zhishang was also hurt by a heartless woman, descending into a state of depression.
All this happened while Lin Ran was preoccupied with his own drama of fleeing and being pursued by Luo Yao, unable to help his best friend.

chapters.title: Chapter 14
chapters.content:
Until his own death, Wu Zhishang got drunk and got into a car accident, which broke his legs and left him wheelchair-bound thereafter.
This would be considered tragic in any story.
Now, speaking of Wu Zhishang at this moment, he liked to squat on the toilet seat to relieve himself, but at a crucial moment, his phone slipped out of his hand.
After thinking about it, he actually went and grabbed a pair of chopsticks, enduring the disgust, to pick it up.
Not because the phone was too important, but because it contained important data.
“Lao Wu, what’s on your mind? Why would you… eat that?”
Wu Zhishang turned his head in a daze and saw his good friend Lin Ran arriving for their appointment. Immediately, his hand trembled, and the phone he had just picked up fell back down again.
Lin Ran naturally noticed Wu Zhishang’s awkwardness and burst into laughter that echoed throughout the dorm.
“Lin Ge, it’s not what you think! My phone fell down!”
Lin Ran: “Right, right, that’s exactly what happened!”“You’re really misunderstanding! I was just picking up my phone!”
“Right, right! Picking up a phone… and well, while you’re at it!”
Damn it!
Wu Zhishang wanted to curse.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
When the phone finally returned to his hands, he washed it over and over, wiping it clean. Lin Ran nearly threw up from the sight, keeping his distance the entire time.
“Lao Wu, you’re really something! No matter how down on your luck, you shouldn’t be eating that stuff! I’m in awe… ugh!”
With the phone “recovered,” Wu Zhishang wasn’t as upset anymore and decided to ask.
“Come on, what’s really going on with you, old man?”
Lin Ran asked something totally unrelated: “Did you get your internship certificate?”
Wu Zhishang shook his head: “I’ve been working odd jobs all summer; I didn’t go for an internship at all!”
Lin Ran: “Well, I’m planning to start a media company, and I want you to be a blogger.”
Wu Zhishang couldn’t believe it: “Are you kidding? Me being a blogger or just an investor?”
Lin Ran nodded: “Blogging.”
Wu Zhishang’s eyes widened: “C’mon, bro! Are you crazy? You’re not doing any better than me as a regular student at the Lin family. Where are you getting money to start a company?”
“My wife has money!”
“Even if your wife does… by the way, who exactly is your wife?”
It seemed like Wu Zhishang just remembered why he had invited Lin Ran today. He was too curious.
Lin Ran: “That’s a secret!”
Wu Zhishang: “So I figured you were lying! I mean, I know you’re kinda handsome, but you couldn’t even get Liu Ruxue, so how could you…”
Lin Ran pulled out his phone and shoved a photo of their marriage certificate in Wu Zhishang’s face.
“My wife’s a rich beauty, three years older than me, and hey, there’s an old saying: a woman three years older is like holding a gold brick. For me, it’s more like a gold mountain…”
After Lin Ran explained for a few minutes, Wu Zhishang was fuming.
“You should die! This is worse than killing me, aaaaaahhhh!”
After crying for a while, he finally asked: “Fine! Even if you’re starting a company, why would you pick me to be a blogger?”
Lin Ran glanced at Wu Zhishang: “Because you’re dumb enough to attract traffic, and, uh, can you stop waving that filthy phone in front of me… ugh!”
Wu Zhishang: Damn it!
“Is there no justice? No law?!”
However, Wu Zhishang was genuinely happy for Lin Ran. First, Lin Ran had gotten over Liu Ruxue.
Second, Lin Ran had found what he called “true love,” and as a buddy, he was overjoyed.
“Lin Ge! Now that you’re married, take good care of your wife’s life! Liu Ruxue doesn’t deserve you; if it weren’t for fearing how angry you’d get, I would’ve already persuaded you!”
“Also, I don’t want to be a blogger. I want to be a manager.”
In fact, Wu Zhishang had tried to persuade Lin Ran before, but after one failure, he stopped.
If Lin Ran got hurt by Liu Ruxue, Wu Zhishang would be there with him, drinking, eating, and playing around; if Liu Ruxue ever changed, he would send sincere blessings.
These were bros who had grown up together, wearing the same pants from childhood. They had fought together, skipped classes, been punished, and went to college together…
“What are you saying? I of course have to live well with my wife!”
“When it comes to being a manager, I’ll consider it, but can you take that phone away from me first… damn it!”
“You agree, and I’ll take it away.”
“I’m defeated by you… of course, you’ll be the manager, how could I… ugh!”
In the end, Lin Ran reluctantly gave in to Wu Zhishang’s phone attack.
Having settled the matter, the two headed downstairs to rent an office directly.
On the way to the parking lot, Lin Ran also told Wu Zhishang about cutting ties with the Lin family, which caused another outburst from Wu Zhishang, who praised Lin Ran’s guts.
At this time, in the parking lot, a group of people surrounded a car.
“I just found out, this is a Koenigsegg One:1, only six units were ever made, and the price has been skyrocketing to over 100 million yuan!”
“Whose car is this? Is there a billionaire of this level at our school?”
“If this were my car, I’d be happy living in luxury and even taking eight wives!”
“I’m taking a photo. Everyone, move aside! Ruxue, hurry up, let’s take one together!”
With the semester about to start, Liu Ruxue, as the school flower, was selected to participate in the orientation gala performance. Today, she was coming to report her program, something she thoroughly enjoyed, and Huo Haini accompanied her.
Seeing Huo Haini calling her, Liu Ruxue slightly shyly moved with an elegant gait.
“Would this be a bit inappropriate?”
Huo Haini pulled Liu Ruxue over: “What’s the problem? We’re just taking a photo to post on Moments!”
Seeing Liu Ruxue and Huo Haini posing by the car, some classmates kindly reminded them.
“That’s a 100 million yuan hypercar. Be careful.”
“Exactly! If you break it, even if you’re the school flower, you won’t make enough to pay for it!”
“I’m staying here and waiting. I want to see who is driving this Koenigsegg to school.”
“Look at how Liu Ruxue and Huo Haini are posing–they look like a pair of chickens!”
Of course, not all students liked Liu Ruxue, especially some girls who secretly despised her seemingly pure white lotus act.
They looked down on Huo Haini even more–someone who lived off of Liu Ruxue’s fame.
Huo Haini: “What’s there to be afraid of? Even if the owner shows up, he’ll be captivated by our looks, alright!”
“Besides, we’re just taking a couple of photos. What could happen?”
Saying that, she pulled Liu Ruxue and both of them leaned halfway onto the silver-gray engine hood for some nice selfies.
This scene was just spotted by Lin Ran as he arrived.
“Who allowed you to take photos?”
Hearing this familiar voice, Liu Ruxue’s hand trembled, and her phone “clang” fell onto the hood.
“Damn it!”
Lin Ran was furious. That was one of the gifts that Luo Yao had given him, and this bitch had just smashed her phone into it?
Lin Ran quickly went to check the hood, and sure enough, there was a tiny dent, about the size of a grain of rice.
Liu Ruxue also spotted the tiny dent but didn’t think much of it.
Huo Haini, on the other hand, wasn’t going to humor Lin Ran; she still remembered how he had humiliated them last time.
“Lin Ran? What are you doing here? And don’t touch that car. Do you even know what it is? If you break it, could you even afford it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 15
chapters.content:
Liu Ruxue saw Lin Ran again and felt that he had become even more handsome. What was going on? She actually felt a slight flutter in her heart.
Lin Ran looked down at the scratch on the car, his heart aching. He pointed at the phone on the hood and asked, "Whose phone is this?"
Liu Ruxue replied, "It's mine."
Lin Ran nodded, "Then it's settled. Pay up."
Huo Haini and Liu Ruxue: ???
"Brother Lin Ran! School hasn't even started yet. Why are you here? Did you come to see me?"
Lin Ran nodded, "Yes, I came to see you. You damaged my car, so pay up."
Huo Haini laughed, "Lin Ran, are you delusional? Do you even know what kind of car this is? Why don't you just say you're a tycoon or something?"
Lin Ran thought to himself: I'm not, but my wife is.
Without saying another word, he took out the car key and pressed it. The Koenigsegg responded immediately.Everyone around was completely stunned.Google seaʀᴄh
This supercar, worth over a hundred million, actually belonged to Lin Ran?
Lin Ran was quite famous at Capital University. In fact, he was practically a household name on campus, and there were three main reasons for his fame.
First, he was ridiculously good-looking. He was the undisputed heartthrob of Capital University, with countless admirers, all of whom Lin Ran had rejected.
Second, he was shamelessly devoted. Despite being such a handsome guy, he had no qualms about simping for Liu Ruxue.
Although Liu Ruxue was also beautiful and the campus belle, many people believed Lin Ran could have done better.
Like, for example, the countless girls who had desperately pursued him only to be coldly rejected.
Third, he was exceptionally talented. To win Liu Ruxue's heart, Lin Ran had worked hard to make himself outstanding.
He had won scholarships left and right, excelled academically, and was skilled in singing, dancing, and even rap. On top of that, he was the campus heartthrob.
The only downside was that all of this was for Liu Ruxue. It was said that every scholarship he earned was spent on her.
Because of his fame, everyone knew him well.
Lin Ran wasn't wealthy—that was common knowledge on campus.
If he were rich, why would he be working part-time every day?
Now, this campus heartthrob, known for his devotion, was claiming to own a Koenigsegg worth over a hundred million. Could anyone believe it?
"Holy crap! That car belongs to Senior Lin? This is beyond unbelievable!"
"Liu Ruxue damaged the car, but Lin Ran definitely won't make her pay for it."
"Not so sure about that. Didn't you hear what Lin Ran said? He asked for compensation, and he looks really angry."
"Wouldn't you be mad if your car got scratched?"
"If only Senior Lin could be my boyfriend."
"I never knew Senior Lin was this rich—and so handsome too. I'd be willing to sit in the passenger seat of his car, even if he teased me or married me!"
"Hey, aren't you being a bit greedy?"
"Knowing Senior Lin, this whole thing will probably just blow over."
Wu Zhishang, standing nearby, was also shocked.
Lin Ran had only mentioned that he drove here, but he hadn't said what kind of car it was. Who would have thought it was such an impressive supercar? And from what people were saying, it was worth a hundred million?
Damn, a hundred million!
Lin Ran's rich wife must be insanely wealthy!!
Ah... just kill him already! This was too much to handle.
He was worried about Lin Ran struggling, but now he was driving a supercar. At this point, he couldn't even feel jealous anymore.
The gap was just too big.
After calming himself down, Wu Zhishang walked over to Lin Ran and looked at the stunned Liu Ruxue and Huo Haini.
"Brother Lin, don't be too harsh. They only caused a tiny scratch. As classmates, just let them pay a million or so and call it a day."
Pfft!
Huo Haini almost spat out blood, but then she realized something was off.
"Did you rent this car?"
Lin Ran replied, "A supercar worth over a hundred million? Go ahead and rent one for me to see."
Huo Haini was speechless. What Lin Ran said made sense.
But wait! She knew Lin Ran's situation well. Where did he get such an expensive car?
Even Liu Ruxue was completely baffled. She lightly tapped her head, wondering if she was still dreaming.
"Lin Ran, is this... really your car? Where did you get the money to buy it? Or did you borrow it from someone?"
Lin Ran didn't bother explaining, "No point in talking. Just pay up. As Wu Zhishang said, a million. If you can't pay, I'll have to take legal action."
Huo Haini immediately lost her temper.
"Lin Ran, don't push your luck. A million? Are you out of your mind?"
"Right now! Immediately! Hand over the car keys and let Ruxue drive this car. Then I might consider convincing her to give you a chance to get closer to her."
Liu Ruxue started fidgeting shyly, waiting for Lin Ran's response.
Lin Ran scoffed, "Are you an idiot? If you don't want to pay, then I'll just call the police."
With that, he took out his phone and dialed the police, "Hello, I'd like to report a case... Yes, that's right. They're also threatening me to hand over the car. I feel like I'm being coerced... Yes, at Capital University..."
As Lin Ran spoke clearly on the phone, both Liu Ruxue and the onlookers realized one thing:
Lin Ran was dead serious.
After hanging up, Lin Ran asked, "So, are you ready to pay now? The police will be here soon."
He then called his insurance company to report the incident.
Liu Ruxue certainly didn’t have that much money. Her family only had a small amount of assets thanks to the care of the Lin family, and she herself was far from wealthy. Her seemingly comfortable life was maintained solely through Lin Jian’s generosity and Lin Ran’s hard work.
Huo Haini stammered, “I… we don’t have that much money. How do we know if your broken car wasn’t already damaged?”
“No money? No problem! You can always sell yourselves!”
Huo Haini retorted, “You… how vulgar.”
Lin Ran then turned to Liu Ruxue, “Or you could beg your dear brother Lin Jian! Aren’t you two *very* close?”
He emphasized the words “very close” with biting clarity, causing Liu Ruxue to panic as if some hidden secret had been exposed.
“I… Lin Jian is just a student. Where would he get that kind of money?”
“Your cousin? Oh, right, right! Your cousin! Since you’re unwilling, then pay up!”
Lin Ran wasn’t ready to expose Liu Ruxue just yet. He planned to gather definitive evidence to make both Liu Ruxue and Lin Jian face the consequences in public.
To destroy someone, you must first let them grow complacent.
The feeling of falling from the highest peak is what truly captivates the heart.
Liu Ruxue put on a pitiful expression and said, “Alright, I admit I was wrong. How about this? I’ll give you the chance to have dinner with me, and we’ll consider this matter settled.”
Lin Ran was utterly disgusted.
“Liu Ruxue, could you stop being so repulsive? Right now, you’re like a pile of dung—soft, stinky, and meeting you feels like a curse I brought upon myself.”
Liu Ruxue whimpered, “Lin Ran, why… why are you treating me like this? Wuwuwu!”
Lin Ran felt a chill run down his spine, almost vomiting on the spot.
At this moment, Liu Ruxue’s level of repulsiveness had surpassed even Wu Zhishang’s phone.

chapters.title: Chapter 16
chapters.content:
Soon, the police and the insurance company arrived.
For the police, this was a case of property damage involving a significant amount.
For the insurance company, it was a massive claim.
Quickly, the insurance company staff breathed a sigh of relief, as it turned out the issue wasn’t the car owner’s fault.
They then prepared a preliminary compensation estimate for Lin Ran: 1.2 million yuan.
Hearing this number, everyone gasped in shock. Liu Ruxue stopped crying, and both she and Huo Haini turned pale.
“It’s just a small scratch. How could it cost so much?” Huo Haini naturally questioned.
The staff explained, “Although the scratch is small, it’s not something that can be easily repaired. At the very least, the hood needs to be custom-made by the original manufacturer.”
“Moreover, this car is a limited edition globally, making repairs even more difficult. Even if the hood is replaced, the car’s value will depreciate significantly. 1.2 million yuan really isn’t that much. Mr. Lin is being generous by only asking you two to pay 1 million.”
The staff naturally sided with Lin Ran, though he didn’t think such a small scratch warranted such a fuss.But if Lin Ran was determined to have the car repaired, someone would have to foot the bill.
Huo Haini still refused to give up and asked, “Are you sure this is Lin Ran’s car?”
The staff replied, “Of course. This car arrived in the capital three months ago. The previous owner reluctantly auctioned it off for 110 million yuan, and it was registered under Mr. Lin’s name. It was quite a sensational news story at the time.”
“I personally handled Mr. Lin’s insurance. Although I didn’t get to meet him in person, the documents clearly state that the owner is Mr. Lin.”
At this point, Huo Haini’s last shred of hope was crushed. She never dreamed that Lin Ran could be so wealthy.
In her eyes, Lin Ran had always been an outcast of the Lin family—a somewhat handsome but ultimately insignificant figure. After all, good looks don’t pay the bills.
But now, not only was Lin Ran strikingly handsome, he was also incredibly wealthy, though it was unclear where his money came from.
Coupled with Lin Ran’s tendency to go all out for the women in his life, he suddenly became an ideal candidate for marriage.
Thinking this, Huo Haini’s gaze shifted from disdain to burning desire.
If Lin Ran no longer liked Liu Ruxue, maybe she could give it a try?
Liu Ruxue, on the other hand, was utterly shocked. She knew Lin Ran better, so her astonishment was even greater than Huo Haini’s.
The straightforward officer had already finished his inquiries. With so many witnesses, Liu Ruxue and Huo Haini couldn’t deny their involvement.
After a brief investigation, the officer offered his advice.
“Given the large sum involved, I recommend you settle this privately. Of course, you could also take it to court!”
The officer clearly didn’t want to deal with this mess. If there were no disputes, he wouldn’t even bother taking them back to the station for statements.
Rich kids with luxury cars—he didn’t want to provoke them.
Liu Ruxue and Huo Haini were also scared, especially Huo Haini, who looked at Lin Ran with a pleading expression.
“Lin Ran, even if it’s our Ruxue’s fault, setting aside the facts, aren’t you also to blame? Why did you park your car in such an obvious spot?”
Lin Ran really didn’t want to argue with this woman. Her logic was absolutely ridiculous.
“Can you just stop talking? I have megalophobia. Let’s just settle on the compensation!”
Huo Haini/Liu Ruxue: ???
Wu Zhishang added, “Bro Lin is afraid of big idiots.”
The two of them were so angry they were about to explode. Huo Haini decided to throw caution to the wind.
“Our Ruxue didn’t do it on purpose.”
Lin Ran: “Whether it was on purpose or not, you’re paying. Since you’re such close sisters, how about 500,000 yuan each?”
Huo Haini: “I didn’t touch the car. It was Liu Ruxue’s phone that hit it. Take it up with her.”
With that, she turned and left without looking back. Liu Ruxue was left dumbfounded, her face filled with disbelief.
In the end, to avoid further trouble, Liu Ruxue wrote an IOU for 1 million yuan, and only then did Lin Ran let her go.
Liu Ruxue: “Lin Ran, I never thought you were this kind of person. You’re so rich, yet you kept it from me. I hate you… sob sob!”
After saying this, she ran off, utterly humiliated.
The incident was quickly posted on the campus forum by the gossip-loving students, instantly becoming the talk of the school.
“Bro! My dear bro!”
Lin Ran saw Wu Zhishang staring dreamily at the Koenigsegg and tossed him the keys.
“I can’t fulfill your wish, but your dad can.”
Wu Zhishang: “Got it! Father!”
This was Wu Zhishang’s first time driving a luxury car, and he started it with extreme caution, much to the envy of the onlookers.
“Bro Lin, I’m so jealous of you. How big of a sugar bowl did you eat from to have a Koenigsegg registered under your name?”
Lin Ran: “Not that big. Just a few dozen properties, a few dozen luxury cars, and a few billion in pocket money.”
Wu Zhishang: “You’re really good at blowing your own horn with your eyes closed.”
“Don’t believe me? Fine.”
After a day, the two finally rented an office space, right across from Luo Corporation.
This time, Lin Ran used the black card Luo Yao had given him to pay for the rent.
After dropping Wu Zhishang off at Capital University, Lin Ran gave him one last instruction.
He told him not to tell his girlfriend about the company for now.
“Wouldn’t it be better to surprise her once the company takes off?”
Although Wu Zhishang didn’t fully understand, he agreed.
After all, the company was only possible because of Lin Ran. He was just riding on his friend’s coattails.
Meanwhile, in the Luo Corporation office, Luo Yao was on the verge of losing control of her emotions after learning that Lin Ran had run into Liu Ruxue again. But when she found out Lin Ran had used the black card, her anger subsided.
Lin Ran spending her money felt even better than spending it herself.
The Lin family had always raised Lin Ran with frugality, but as his wife, she was determined to give him the most luxurious life possible.
However, the thought of Lin Ran meeting Liu Ruxue on campus made her icy cold once more.
Liu Meng, who was handling work nearby, could feel Luo Yao’s mood swings and couldn’t help but sigh internally.
Young Master Lin! Please stop causing trouble. On the surface, you’re tormenting CEO Luo, but in reality, it’s us workers who suffer!
Why make life hard for the working class?
After a busy day, Lin Ran returned to the manor and immediately saw the person he had missed so much, even though they had only been apart for a few hours.
Luo Yao, however, wasn’t as gentle as he had imagined. Instead, she glared at him with murderous eyes.
Lin Ran had seen Liu Ruxue again today. Why couldn’t he just behave?
Although her subordinates had reported everything that happened, all Luo Yao could think about was that Lin Ran had met Liu Ruxue.
No matter what was said or what happened, the fact remained that they had met.
Lin Ran couldn’t believe that even after humiliating Liu Ruxue, Luo Yao would still be jealous.
So, a confused Lin Ran ended up injured—this time in his kidney, feeling utterly drained.
“A-Ran, do you still dare to meet Liu Ruxue?”
Damn! So that’s what this was about.
Liu Ruxue, why don’t you just die already? You keep causing misunderstandings between me and my wife.
“Ah… damn it!”
This time, Luo Yao showed no mercy. She bit Lin Ran’s shoulder until it bled profusely before finally letting go.
“A small lesson. If there’s a next time, I won’t go easy on you!”The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Lin Ran felt like crying.
“Wife, it’s really not my fault. It was just a coincidence. I can’t avoid her forever, can I? Maybe you should just kill her!”

chapters.title: Chapter 17
chapters.content:
Luo Yao seemed to see through Lin Ran's little trick
"Are you really willing?"
"Of course, I am! I can't wait for you to get rid of her and make her disappear from my sight."
Hearing this, Luo Yao finally felt a bit of comfort and began to ponder the sincerity of Lin Ran's words.
Lin Ran gently caressed every inch of Luo Yao's skin, trying to soothe her with his touch, when suddenly he frowned.
"Did you hurt your leg?"
Luo Yao panicked and quickly pulled her leg back. "Yeah... I accidentally bumped it!"
Lin Ran suddenly remembered that Luo Yao had been applying something while he was asleep. Was it scar cream?
How could he not have noticed that his wife was injured?
For some reason, Lin Ran felt a sharp pain in his heart.Upon closer inspection, he saw that the injury was almost healed, barely visible to the naked eye, only detectable by touch.
Lin Ran didn't feel relieved; instead, he blamed himself for being so careless.
"I'm sorry, it was my negligence. I deserve to be punished. Go ahead, punish me."
Luo Yao's eyes lit up immediately.
"Then I'll punish you by making you take me out to look at the stars."
"Deal."
Under the starry sky, Lin Ran held Luo Yao's hand as they walked to the rooftop garden.
He wanted to have a heart-to-heart with Luo Yao, but before he could say anything, Luo Yao covered his mouth, as if she didn't want him to continue.
She was afraid. Afraid that her vulnerability would be discovered by her beloved, afraid that Lin Ran would worry about her.
The stars are always beautiful because they inspire endless fantasies and dreams.
In the rooftop garden of the villa, Luo Yao was unusually wild that night, until both of them were exhausted and lay together, quietly gazing at the stars.
Lin Ran: "I knew this stargazing wasn't going to be innocent."
Luo Yao: "Do you like stargazing?"
Lin Ran: "I like the stars, but I like you more."
Luo Yao stared at the stars, lost in thought.
"You know, when I was a kid, a big brother once told me that stars aren't beautiful because when dreams shatter, people feel despair."
Lin Ran: "Well, that big brother definitely wasn't me, because I'm younger than you!"
Honestly, why did he feel a little disappointed?
Luo Yao ignored Lin Ran's feelings and continued, "I used to think he was right, but now I might change my mind."
She turned to look at Lin Ran seriously. "Because you are my star. Even if one day you disappear, you'll still be beautiful to me."
"Just promise me, if the dream ever shatters, lie to me for as long as possible, okay?"
Lin Ran: "Then I'll be the brightest star in your sky, one that never fades."
Luo Yao nodded, choosing to believe in this moment.
She extended her hand, adorned with a bracelet, and intertwined her fingers with Lin Ran's, declaring her happiness to the starry sky.
The temperature in the rooftop garden was perfectly comfortable, and even as they fell asleep in each other's arms, it felt just right.
"Darling, if you ever have something on your mind, you have to tell me."
"Okay."
"Otherwise, I'll worry."
"I know."
...
Meow!
A cat's cry woke Lin Ran. He looked around and saw a black cat with blue eyes quietly staring at him.
Lin Ran turned to look at Luo Yao, who was already asleep.
"Shh! Keep it down, don't disturb her rest."
The black cat obediently ran away, leaving Lin Ran puzzled.
Was there a cat in this estate?
The next morning, Lin Ran received news that was neither good nor bad.
Luo Yao was on her period.
"I'll let you off the hook for the next few days. Take it easy and rest."
Lin Ran didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
"Are you fattening me up to slaughter me later?"
After breakfast, Luo Yao left without hesitation, showing no signs of reluctance. Lin Ran even began to wonder if he had become useless.
Was she just using him and then discarding him?
Woman, you've successfully ignited my anger...
Lin Ran and Wu Zhishang continued working on the company. They spent the morning completing the company registration.
The company was named **Warm Yao Media**.
Its business scope included not only short video production but also live streaming, original music, and TV drama creation.
Lin Ran didn't want to work for others; he wanted a higher starting point.
From hosts to actors, including the operations team and PR team, everyone would be his own people.
After all, having lived a second life, he had an advantage with information—knowing which TV dramas, short videos, and rising influencers would become popular later.
The two of them discussed their next steps, though "discussed" was more like Wu Zhishang being exploited.
Wu Zhishang was in charge of renovations and hiring, while Lin Ran was responsible for slacking off.
Lin Ran: "I'm still in my honeymoon phase with my wife. How can I have time to deal with company matters?"
Wu Zhishang: "How long is your honeymoon phase?"
Lin Ran: "A lifetime."
Wu Zhishang: "Damn it! Just kill me! Why do you get to enjoy your honeymoon while I have to work tirelessly?"
Lin Ran: "Because I'm the boss. If you don't want a salary, you can slack off too."
Wu Zhishang: "Never mind."
Lin Ran's offer to Wu Zhishang was straightforward: a base salary at industry standards, with bonuses tied to performance.
Even between brothers, accounts had to be settled clearly, and Wu Zhishang had no objections to this.
In addition, Lin Ran gave Wu Zhishang 5% of the company's shares. Wu Zhishang didn't want it, but Lin Ran insisted.
Why? Because Wu Zhishang had once cried at Lin Ran's grave.
During lunch, Lin Ran received a call from Xu Kai, the lawyer.
"Mr. Lin, Lin Tianba wants to meet with you in person to discuss the profit-sharing."
Lin Ran could imagine Lin Tianba's current state—angry but helpless, forced to seek reconciliation with Lin Ran.
He could even guess most of what Lin Tianba would say during the meeting.
After completely letting go of familial ties, Lin Ran felt his mind was unusually clear.
"There's no need for a meeting. Just relay my message: have the money ready, and that's all. No further discussion is necessary."
There was no point in meeting; it would only be nauseating.
After hanging up, Wu Zhishang looked at Lin Ran with admiration and gave him a thumbs-up.
"Bro Lin! You've finally stood up."
"What do you mean 'finally'? It's not like I was kneeling before."
"Weren't you kneeling and losing your dignity before?"
"Well... I guess you're right."
A man's dignity isn't earned by kneeling; it's earned by standing tall.
Wu Zhishang: "Let's not talk about the past."
Lin Ran nodded: "You're right. Let's focus on the present. Like how my wife is stunning and even supports the family financially..."
Wu Zhishang: "Damn it!"
Lin Ran: "It's not a plant, you know."
Wu Zhishang was speechless.
"Just wait. When school starts, I'm going to tie my girlfriend to my waist and show off to you every day."
Lin Ran frowned: "You haven't told your girlfriend about the company, have you?"
Wu Zhishang patted his chest: "Don't worry, I haven't forgotten what I promised you. I want to surprise her with our success first. Then I'll buy her whatever she wants."
Lin Ran thought to himself, *Finally, you're the one spreading the dog food.*
I just wonder how many more times you'll be able to do that. Sigh!
After lunch, the two parted ways.
Wu Zhishang never wanted to stay with Lin Ran again; the guy kept feeding him dog food.
Lin Ran didn't want to stay with Wu Zhishang either. What could two grown men even do together?

chapters.title: Chapter 18
chapters.content:
It's still more comfortable to stick close to my wife.
School is about to start, and he wants to spend all his time with Luo Yao.
Love isn't just about physical intimacy; it also needs a lot of seasoning, like companionship.
Of course, physical intimacy can't be neglected either.
Before returning to the manor, Lin Ran specifically picked out a gift.
For some reason, he always felt like someone was watching him.
This Luo Yao, she really doesn't trust him at all.
Shaking his head, he returned to the manor alone.
Every time Lin Ran came back, the old butler would heave a sigh of relief.
Ever since Lin Ran stopped letting him follow, he had been even more cautious.After all, if this young master went missing, the young lady could turn the entire city of Kyoto upside down.
Of course, the young lady wasn't foolish either. She had never relaxed her protection—or rather, her surveillance—of Lin Ran.
When Luo Yao returned to the manor, Lin Ran naturally greeted her with a hug, a kiss, and then presented the prepared gift.
Luo Yao opened the gift box curiously, finding a beautifully crafted thermos inside.
"What's this?"
Lin Ran had known Luo Yao for quite some time, and he was well aware that she suffered from menstrual pain.
He had known about it in his past life but had never paid it any attention. In this life, he didn't want to miss any opportunity to be good to Luo Yao.
"Didn't your period just start? I was worried you'd be in pain, so I thought of giving you this thermos."
"I also prepared a warm stomach pack for you, with brown sugar and red dates. Make sure to take it with you when you leave tomorrow."
"That way, when you drink water from the thermos I gave you during work, you'll think of me, right?"
"Plus, the thermos has a great meaning—it symbolizes a lifetime, our lifetime together."
A hint of emotion flickered in Luo Yao's eyes, though she tried hard to conceal it.
In the past, it had always been her who gave, while Lin Ran had never given her anything.
Recently, he had given her a bracelet and now this thermos. It would be a lie to say she wasn't happy, though she didn't show it openly.
Luo Yao had been holding back, not wanting to be swayed by Lin Ran's current behavior.
After all, all this might just be an act.
"Thank you! How did you know I get menstrual pain?"
The old butler, standing nearby, was moved to tears.
Young Master Lin was treating the young lady better and better, even taking the initiative to care about her health. This was what a real family looked like.
"Wife! Saying 'thank you' is too formal, isn't it?"
"We're legally married, so it's only natural, reasonable, and logical for me to do something for my wife."
"As for how I knew about your menstrual pain, it's because I'm observant! Did you really think your husband knew nothing?"
"And one more thing..." Lin Ran leaned closer to Luo Yao's ear.Follow current novels on
"The sooner your period ends, the sooner we can get back to making love, right?"
A glimmer of light appeared in Luo Yao's eyes.
Could it be that Lin Ran was with her just because he wanted her body?
If that was the case...
"Well, it's not like we can't do it now."
Lin Ran was stunned. "Wife, are you asking me to fight through blood? No way."
"That's not good for your health, and I absolutely cannot agree to such a request."
"Even if I die, even if I jump off this building, I won't do it."
The butler, who had been standing nearby and listening with a flushed face, felt extremely awkward and quietly began to step out of their sight.
But when he heard Lin Ran say, "Even if I die, even if I jump off this building," he couldn't help but pause.
Why did that sound so familiar?
In the afternoon, Lin Ran had some free time and stayed at the villa, so he prepared ingredients in advance to cook dinner for Luo Yao.
This time, he made Western cuisine, which he was quite skilled at, and the taste was no worse than that of a restaurant.
The skills he had honed in the Lin family had unexpectedly ended up being used for his wife.
"We have a chef at home. You don't need to go through all this trouble."
Luo Yao genuinely didn't want Lin Ran to overwork himself, even though she found the food delicious.
Lin Ran replied, "Cooking for my wife isn't trouble; it's a pleasure!"
Lin Ran wasn't lying.
He actually didn't enjoy cooking. Back in the Lin family, he had pretended to like it just to please his relatives.
But cooking for Luo Yao—just the thought of her coming home to a meal he had prepared—filled him with an inexplicable sense of happiness.
It turned out that whether someone enjoyed doing something really depended on who they were doing it for.
"Just seeing you eat the food I made makes me so happy."
Luo Yao inwardly sighed. Was she really going to let Lin Ran deceive her to the point of no return?
Hmph! It's not like she actually liked the food this man made.
"Feed me."
Lin Ran cut a small piece of steak and brought it to Luo Yao's mouth with a fork.
"Feed me with your mouth."
Lin Ran was taken aback. "Huh?"
After a moment of realization, even a grown man like Lin Ran blushed.
Luo Yao felt satisfied seeing Lin Ran's shy expression, her heart secretly screaming with happiness.
Lin Ran, suppressing his embarrassment, slowly fed the steak to Luo Yao.
The imported steak tasted excellent, and Luo Yao decided to reward Lin Ran for it.
Bite by bite, the worries disappeared, leaving only happiness.
After dinner, Luo Yao got up and went to the study to finish some important work she hadn't completed during the day.
Lin Ran didn't follow her and instead returned to the bedroom alone.
He still remembered the awkward scene from the last time Luo Yao was in a video meeting and he accidentally appeared on camera.
So he swore to himself that unless absolutely necessary, he would never disturb Luo Yao while she was working in the study.
He showered alone, got into bed alone, and scrolled through his phone, looking at small streamers who were popular in his past life but hadn't gained fame yet in this one.
By the time his eyes were too heavy to keep open, Luo Yao still hadn't returned to the room, so he reluctantly turned off his phone and fell into a deep sleep alone.
After what felt like an eternity, Lin Ran slowly opened his eyes.
Holy crap!
He almost screamed out loud.
...
After a long pause, Lin Ran's pupils trembled with shock.
"You actually..."
"Do you not like it, A-Ran?"
Lin Ran quickly shook his head, then nodded.
"Do you like it or not?"
Lin Ran took a deep breath and exhaled slowly.
"Wife, I... I think it's great, but... forget it! I don't want to say."
It was too awkward, too hard to put into words.
Lin Ran himself didn't understand why, even though she was his wife, he still felt his face burning when facing her like this.
"Is A-Ran shy? You still haven't answered me."
Lin Ran was on the verge of breaking down. Did she really have to have an answer?
"I like it, I like it so much."
Luo Yao was indeed Luo Yao. Her boldness and craziness never failed to shock people.
Satisfied with the answer, Luo Yao's lips curved into a smile.
"Consider this your reward. Now, sleep!"
But how could Lin Ran possibly sleep now? All he felt was shock... and delight.
Lin Ran realized that Luo Yao might just be a bit of a treasure.
You never knew when she would surprise you.
So this is what my wife is really like.

chapters.title: Chapter 19
chapters.content:
As the heart of China, the capital city of Kyoto is a bustling metropolis of unparalleled prosperity.
Yet, behind this prosperity lies the struggle of countless ordinary people, barely scraping by.
At this moment, Zhang Xiaolong collapses onto the bed of his cheap basement apartment, utterly exhausted.
Every day, he spends his mornings delivering food, his evenings live-streaming songs, and the early hours of the morning writing articles to post online, earning a meager income.
Only a brief window of four or five hours in the morning is reserved for rest.
But he dares not stop.
His gambling-addicted father, his drug-dependent mother, and his sickly younger sister all depend on him, this broken man, to keep their lives afloat.
He resents his parents, despises his own inadequacy, but his sister is his only solace.
His sister has just come of age and is about to start university.
If Zhang Xiaolong doesn’t continue to work tirelessly to support his family, $2e fears what his parents might do to his sister.For money, they might even sell her.
He needs to earn more, enough to one day bring his sister under his protection and keep her safe.
Staring at the balance on his phone, Zhang Xiaolong calculates how much more he needs for his sister’s tuition.
*Knock, knock, knock!*
The sound of knocking interrupts his thoughts. Dragging his weary body to the door, he opens it to find a face so handsome it could bring the world to its knees.
“Who are you?”
“You’re Zhang Xiaolong, right? I’m Lin Ran. Let’s talk.”
Zhang Xiaolong eyes the young man warily.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
He can’t deny that this man radiates an aura of wealth, the kind that makes him feel utterly inadequate. Clearly, he’s some rich heir.
“What do you want from me?”
The fact that the stranger knows his name suggests he’s done his homework.
Zhang Xiaolong fears this might be one of his father’s creditors, coming to collect debts. It wouldn’t be the first time.
Lin Ran notices the young man’s tension.
“Relax. I just want to be friends. If you want to escape your current situation, come with me.”
This is Lin Ran’s final invitation, his last offer to Zhang Xiaolong.
If Zhang Xiaolong refuses, Lin Ran will leave without hesitation.
After all, Zhang Xiaolong is merely a future cash cow, a streaming sensation with millions of fans, but he’s not the only one.
Lin Ran has three reasons for seeking him out.
First, Zhang Xiaolong is destined to become wildly popular, a platform phenomenon with millions of followers.
Second, he’s close by—this rising star just happens to be from Kyoto.
Third, he’s currently at rock bottom. In a past life, Lin Ran had been struck by the tragic story of Zhang Xiaolong’s family.
Back then, he had wondered what kind of cruel fate could saddle someone with such a family.
Now, looking back, it almost feels laughable. After all, Lin Ran’s own life isn’t much better.
At least Zhang Xiaolong has a sister who cares for him.
Lin Ran’s own brother only dreams of killing him.
Perhaps there’s a bit of empathy in his decision as well.
Zhang Xiaolong’s rise to fame wasn’t accidental. It was built on his relentless work ethic and determination.
In an interview, Zhang Xiaolong once revealed that all his motivation came from his sister.
After achieving some success, he brought her to live with him, and the siblings eventually became internet sensations, achieving fame together.
This time, while Zhang Xiaolong is still struggling, Lin Ran plans to make his move.
After all, if you’re going to work for someone, why not work for yourself?
And Lin Ran’s offer is far better than anything else out there.
As Lin Ran’s thoughts race, Zhang Xiaolong finally speaks.
“Alright. I’ll go with you.”
At a nearby café, Lin Ran extends a sincere offer.
Receiving Lin Ran’s invitation, Zhang Xiaolong is taken aback.
He’s just an independent streamer with a small following. Why would anyone want to sign him?
Skeptical, he carefully reviews the contract, only to be even more shocked.
Lin Ran’s terms are among the best in the industry, the kind usually reserved for top-tier streamers.
And here he is, a small-time streamer with barely 10,000 followers. Does he even deserve this?
Zhang Xiaolong is a cautious person. Even though the contract seems fair, he knows these deals can often feel like selling your soul.
Of course, selling his soul isn’t the main issue. If it means earning money, he’s willing to do it.
But his complicated family situation weighs on him, and he doesn’t want to deceive anyone.
“Mr. Lin, you might not know this, but my family situation is… complicated.”
Lin Ran: “I know.”
Zhang Xiaolong: “You know?”
Lin Ran nods.
“Your father is a gambling addict, drowning in over a million in debt. Your mother is a drug addict. But none of this has broken you.”
“You probably realize that, on your own, you’ll never escape your parents’ grip.”
“No matter how much you earn, it’ll never be enough to cover their excesses.”
“Yet you keep working to support your sister’s education and hold onto hope for a better life. That’s the kind of spirit I admire. That’s why I sought you out.”
“Even though you only have 10,000 followers now, I believe that with your attitude, your hard work, and the company’s backing, your future is limitless.”
Lin Ran emphasizes the words “company’s backing.”
Zhang Xiaolong bites his lip, hesitating over whether to accept Lin Ran’s offer.
“Your sister is about to start university, right?”
“Surely, you don’t want her to drop out because of a lack of funds?”
“Alright. I accept.”
After signing the contract, Lin Ran takes him to the company.
As they step out of the elevator, Zhang Xiaolong frowns at the sight of the floor, which looks like it’s been ransacked.
Is this company even legit?
“Sorry, we’re still renovating. It should be ready in a couple of days!”
The two proceed to the office area, which is nearly finished. Wu Zhishang is directing workers as they install a projector.
Across the street stands the headquarters of Luo Corporation, a prime location by any standard.
Seeing Lin Ran arrive with someone, Wu Zhishang quickly greets them.
“Boss Lin, is this the streamer you mentioned?”
Zhang Xiaolong has already been briefed about Wu Zhishang, so he greets him warmly.
“Hello, Mr. Wu. I’m Zhang Xiaolong…”
After introductions and some small talk, Zhang Xiaolong realizes something.
Wait, the company is just the three of them?
And he’s the only employee?
Are you two serious?
Lin Ran doesn’t bother explaining further. After giving Wu Zhishang a few instructions, he leaves.
Wu Zhishang proceeds to outline the company’s future plans to Zhang Xiaolong, who listens in stunned silence.
So, with just three people, you’re planning to build the biggest media and even film production company?
And you’re going to turn me into a streaming sensation with millions of followers, maybe even the top streamer?
Are you two out of your minds?

chapters.title: Chapter 20
chapters.content:
Wu Zhishang wasn’t surprised by Zhang Xiaolong’s stunned reaction. When Lin Ran had first told him about these things, he too had thought Lin Ran was insane.
He patiently explained to Zhang Xiaolong the plans and ideas about how he could become a top-tier streamer with millions of followers, which finally made Zhang Xiaolong somewhat believe in the company’s potential.
However, deep down, Zhang Xiaolong still didn’t feel optimistic about it, but he would follow through with the plan. After all, he was just a streamer under the company’s banner. His job was to listen and do as he was told. As for whether he could really become a million-follower streamer?
Who knows what the future holds?
To him, all of this was just empty promises. Wu Zhishang wasn’t much different from those bosses who painted grand visions.
As long as he could make money, that was all that mattered.
If the money was good, even a pie as big as the sky could be eaten.
What he didn’t know at the time was that many great things often started with grand promises…
After leaving the company, Lin Ran planned to meet Luo Yao but didn’t directly enter the Luo Corporation building.
He wasn’t sure if Luo Yao wanted him to appear in public.After some thought, he sent her a message.
[Where are you? I miss you.]
Luo Yao’s reply came quickly.
[Just finished a meeting. I miss you too.]
Lin Ran smiled, just because of Luo Yao’s simple “I miss you.”
[Inviting my princess to lunch.]
There was a brief silence before Luo Yao replied.
[Sure. Find a place, and I’ll come over.]
Lin Ran found a well-rated Western restaurant nearby and sent her the location.
Ten minutes earlier…
Luo Yao’s office was divided into two areas: one for work and one for rest.
But very few people knew that behind the bookshelf in her office was a hidden room.
Inside this hidden room were photos and detailed information about one person, including their habits and preferences.
Today, this hidden room welcomed a man with a sinister appearance, dragged in by bodyguards.
The man trembled like a leaf upon seeing Luo Yao, as if he already knew his fate.
The bodyguards remained silent, watching quietly.
Luo Yao held a steel knife and slowly, almost tenderly, severed the man’s tendons in his hands and feet.
“Ah…”
The man’s screams were heart-wrenching, enough to make anyone who heard them weep.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
“Who sent you?”
Even with his tendons severed, the man clenched his teeth and refused to speak.
Luo Yao seemed to be in the mood to play. She methodically cut off his fingers, one by one, then his toes.
“Since you won’t talk, you’ve lost your chance.”
After the man passed out, the bodyguards revived him with saltwater, and Luo Yao continued her slow, deliberate torture, no longer asking questions.
Everything felt so natural, as ordinary as eating or drinking.
Finally, the man couldn’t take it anymore and twisted in agony, crying out, “I’ll talk! I’ll talk!”
Luo Yao shook her head.
“No need. You’ve already lost your chance.”
“And I can guess—it was the old man who sent you to follow Lin Ran, wasn’t it?”
“He really doesn’t learn, does he? Breaking his legs was too lenient.”
“I’ll have to go back and give him a little punishment. Hmm… since he likes spying so much, I’ll pluck out his eyeballs and keep them with me. No need for middlemen.”
The man’s eyes widened in shock. He hadn’t expected Luo Yao to figure it out so quickly.
Remembering the crazy things Luo Yao had done in the past, the man was terrified and began begging for mercy.
“Kill me! Please, just kill me!”
Luo Yao smiled, a devilish grin that seemed to come straight from hell.
“Hehe… daring to target Lin Ran? Your fate will be quite… delightful.”
She then slowly cut off the man’s nose and gouged out one of his eyes.
Holding the eyeball on the tip of her knife, Luo Yao seemed lost in thought.
“Lin Ran has been overworking himself lately. This eyeball could be used to make wine to nourish him.”
But then she shook her head. “This one’s too dirty. Lin Ran wouldn’t like it.”
With that, she tossed the eyeball to the ground and crushed it under her foot.
“Kill… kill me… please…”
The man, now on the verge of losing consciousness from the pain, only wanted a quick death.
Just as Luo Yao was about to start on the man’s other eye, Lin Ran’s message arrived.
Husband: [Where are you? I miss you.]
Seeing the message, Luo Yao’s lips curled into a smile. But when she read the second message, her brows furrowed.
Opening her phone’s location app, she panicked when she saw Lin Ran was near her office building.
She was covered in blood. How could she let Lin Ran see her like this?
Lin Ran would be scared, horrified, and might even run away.
She couldn’t let him see her in this state. No, absolutely not.
After a moment of thought, she replied.
[Sure. Find a place, and I’ll come over.]
After sending the message, she ignored the bodyguards and the mutilated man on the floor, focusing only on cleaning herself up quickly.
“Miss! What should we do with him?”
Luo Yao glanced at the man writhing in agony on the floor, her expression cold and emotionless.
“Pack him up and send him to the manor. Lock him in the basement and throw in some rats to keep him company.”
She took a few photos with her phone and then left.
The bodyguards followed her orders, cleaning the hidden room spotlessly, leaving no trace of blood.
After cleaning up in the restroom and disposing of her bloodstained clothes, Luo Yao happily walked out of her office.
Lin Ran had come to see her. He said he missed her and wanted to have lunch together.
As she stepped into the elevator, she sent another message.
[Photos. Photos. Old man, clean your neck. I’ll be back to deal with you.]
The recipient of the message, however, remained silent.
…
At the Luo Family Old Mansion, Old Master Luo sat in his wheelchair, his face dark.
“That crazy girl dares to threaten me?”
“If she really wanted to deal with me, she would have done it years ago. Breaking my legs was as far as she’d go.”
A soft-spoken man beside Old Master Luo spoke up.
“Old Master, Monkey probably won’t survive. What should we do next?”
Old Master Luo was silent for a moment before speaking slowly.
“That useless fool.”
“I didn’t expect that girl to have someone skilled enough to catch Monkey.”
“But it doesn’t matter. She won’t really do anything to me. After all, I’m her grandfather.”
The soft-spoken man hesitated before saying, “But she didn’t spare her own parents. Second Uncle is imprisoned, and Third and Fourth Uncles are dead or crippled. None of the younger generation dares to oppose her.”
Old Master Luo rubbed his forehead, knowing the man was right.
Luo Yao’s methods were no less ruthless than his own. With his current weakened position, taking on the crazy girl was too risky.
But at least he was her grandfather and the former head of the family. Luo Yao would still have some reservations when dealing with him.
Otherwise, he would have died when she went on her rampage years ago. At least now, she wouldn’t take his life.
To succeed, he needed to bide his time.
Once he regained power, he would make her pay with the harshest punishment imaginable.
Old Master Luo: “Don’t provoke the crazy girl for now. Since we’ve found her weakness, we’ll find our opportunity.”
The soft-spoken man: “Understood.”
Old Master Luo: “Hehe! Who would have thought? You actually care about someone?”

chapters.title: Chapter 21
chapters.content:
Back to Lin Ran, he had been waiting for Luo Yao for a long time, and his heart was growing anxious.
It seemed that even a second earlier to see Luo Yao would make him incredibly happy.
This feeling was absolutely non-existent in his past life, but after being reborn, it became increasingly apparent.
He was utterly convinced that this wasn’t guilt towards Luo Yao, nor was it some kind of emotional compensation.
It was genuine love for this woman.
He wanted to stick to her every moment.
A woman who could bare her heart and soul to you—how could he not love her?
In the past, he simply hadn’t felt it, but now, having been reborn, this feeling gushed out like a spring.
If possible, Lin Ran wanted to take out his own heart and show it to Luo Yao.
To see if their names were written on it."Brother! What are you doing here?"
A familiar voice came, and Lin Ran cursed under his breath.
It was Lin Jian, whom he hadn’t seen in days.
Lin Jian was wearing a large baseball cap and a mask, his eyes wide with "surprise" as he looked at Lin Ran.
Lin Ran knew that Lin Jian’s injuries from last time hadn’t healed yet, and this getup was merely to hide his wounded face.
"Oh! So it’s the young master of the Lin Family! What happened to your face?"
Lin Jian immediately took a nervous step back, glancing around to make sure his previous bodyguards weren’t nearby.
"Brother, you’re the real young master of the Lin Family."
"I know you don’t like me, but it’s fine. As long as you can forgive me, I’d even be willing to leave the Lin Family."
"All I ask is that you go back and kowtow to Dad, apologize, and admit your mistakes. He’ll forgive you."
Lin Ran laughed.
"Lin Jian, there’s no one here but strangers and you and me. Can you stop pretending? Aren’t you tired?"
"Brother, what are you talking about?"
Lin Ran: "I’m saying you’re a trash can—you’re really good at putting on an act."
Lin Jian bit his lip, suppressing the anger deep in his heart.
"Dad’s been talking about you a lot these past few days. Brother, could you go see him?"
"He’s not in good health. After you left last time, he was hospitalized."
"If you’re willing to kowtow and apologize, Dad will definitely let it go. It’s only a matter of time before you return to the Lin Family."
Lin Ran: "Are you out of your mind? Always talking about kneeling and apologizing."
"Your mother kneeled as a mistress for so many years. Did she pass that habit on to you?"
Lin Jian: "How can you say that about Mom and Dad? After all, it was you who had Dad beaten and hospitalized."
Lin Ran: "He deserved it. But even if he dies, he still owes me money. If he doesn’t pay up, I’ll kick him out of the board."
Lin Jian: "Brother, why are you so heartless? He’s your father."
Lin Ran made a gagging gesture.
"Don’t make me sick. He’s not my father. I don’t have a son like him, and I certainly don’t have a grandson like you. Don’t call me brother anymore."
"If you want to call me something, bark like a dog. Maybe I’ll throw you a bone to chew on."
Lin Jian was on the verge of losing it, but he held back, knowing that Lin Ran still held a significant amount of shares.
"Brother, after all, we’re still brothers by blood, aren’t we?"
Lin Ran: "I don’t have a brother. Your mother was a mistress."
"You’re only a few months younger than me, which proves that Lin Tianba cheated on my mom while she was pregnant with me. That scumbag doesn’t deserve to be called my father. He’s only fit to be a dog."
"And you? You’re the product of a dog and a mistress. Let’s just call you ‘Three Dogs’ for short!"
Lin Jian took a deep breath.
"What will it take for you to forgive Dad?"
Lin Ran was a bit surprised. Even with no one else around, Lin Jian could still hold back.
"Go kill your parents, then send Liu Ruxue to the Myanmar compound, and I’ll give you my shares."
Lin Jian’s eyes lit up: "Really? Uh… I mean, do you really hate them that much?"
Lin Ran was amused. He hadn’t noticed before how ridiculous Lin Jian was.
With such a dumb IQ, how had he managed to team up with others to kill him in his past life?
Did that make him even dumber than Lin Jian?
"Whether I hate them or not isn’t important. If you can do it, I’ll give you my shares. I’m serious."
Lin Jian fell silent, realizing that Lin Ran was just messing with him.
Just as he was about to play the emotional card again, he suddenly felt a chill run down his spine, as if something terrifying was watching him.
He slowly turned his head.
Exquisite.
Heart-stopping.
And her figure…
His eyes were glued to her.
"Beautiful lady…"
"Get lost!"
Luo Yao’s single, merciless word shattered the young man’s budding infatuation.
"Fine, I’ll go! Waaah!"
Lin Jian ran off with his head down, but as soon as he left, he felt something was off.
Why had a woman scared him like that?
He turned back to sneak a peek and saw the woman sitting next to Lin Ran, their bodies close, seemingly intimate.
Lin Ran—how could he possibly deserve her?
Such a stunning ice queen—how could Lin Ran be worthy of her?
No, everything Lin Ran liked, he had to take.
Because he was the most legitimate son of the Lin Family. His father was the chairman of Suran Group, and his mother was Mrs. Lin.
Everything Lin Ran had should belong to the Lin Family—which meant it should belong to him.
He would take Lin Ran’s toys, steal Lin Ran’s father.
If Lin Ran studied well, he’d steal his grades.
If Lin Ran liked Liu Ruxue, he’d take her too.
If Lin Ran liked Luo Yao, then he’d have to take her as well.
It was all his, all his.
Of course, he wasn’t stupid enough to show himself directly. Instead, he observed quietly, waiting for the right moment.
When it came to patience, Lin Jian was a professional.
He needed to find out who this woman was, then drop some bombshells about Lin Ran in front of her.
Once he successfully sowed discord, he’d step in to comfort her.
Wouldn’t that make her his?
Hahaha!
As he thought this, a smile crept onto his face.
To avoid exposure, he quietly left the restaurant.
Completely forgetting that he had come to meet a lawyer today.
Luo Yao: "That brother of yours seems like a dumb dog."ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Lin Ran: "He’s not my brother, and don’t insult dumb dogs, okay?"
Lin Ran’s response, his demeanor, his tone—none of it seemed fake.
Luo Yao narrowed her eyes.
"You’ve changed a lot recently."
Lin Ran: "Have I? I’ve just woken up from a dream."
Luo Yao: "Was the past the dream, or is the present the dream?"
Lin Ran was stunned, his mind drifting back to his past life.
Every promise he made to Luo Yao had to be taken seriously.
Lin Ran reached out and cupped Luo Yao’s face.
"Look at me. You are my truest love. I’m absolutely certain that I want only you, and I belong only to you."
"No one else even comes close to a single strand of your hair."
"You’re not a dream, but you’re more beautiful than any dream. Do you understand?"
Thump! Thump!
Even though Lin Ran had been saying a lot of sweet things lately, Luo Yao still felt her heart race every time.
It didn’t matter if it was real or not—she enjoyed this feeling.
The two of them simply gazed at each other, each silently thinking to themselves.
Luo Yao: [Even if you’re lying to me, I’m willing to throw myself into the flames like a moth.]
Lin Ran: [I’ll spend my whole life proving that my love for you is genuine.]

chapters.title: Chapter 22
chapters.content:
The atmosphere in the restaurant gradually warmed up. Lin Ran elegantly fed the little devil, completely ignoring the gazes of others around them.
Lin Ran: "How does it taste?"
Luo Yao chewed the steak, savoring it carefully.
"It was just okay at first, but there's a hint of love in it. Though, it's still not as good as when you cook it yourself, Ah Ran."
"Then I'll make it for you next time. I guarantee you won't be able to say a word after tasting it."
"Deal."
The romantic lunch came to an end, and the two bid each other farewell.
Luo Yao didn’t invite Lin Ran to her office. She was afraid that something messy might still be lying around, and Lin Ran might notice something amiss.
But deep down, she really wanted Lin Ran by her side, every moment of every day.
Lin Ran, of course, didn’t push. He intended to slowly warm Luo Yao up, like a frog in gradually heating water.Right now, Lin Ran lived for just two words: "Luo Yao."
Two days flew by in the blink of an eye.
After his rebirth, Lin Ran and Luo Yao's relationship gradually deepened, and they spent what both considered to be an almost unrealistically perfect short time together.
The day before school started.
In the Luo Corporation office, Luo Yao was radiating an overwhelming aura of hostility.
The entire Luo Corporation was on edge, and no one knew why the boss was so furious.
The entire morning, not a single executive was spared.
Even a dog passing by would yelp in terror and run away under Luo Yao's piercing glare.
The one who felt it the most was Liu Meng, Luo Yao’s personal assistant. At this moment, Liu Meng was trembling as she handed a stack of documents to Luo Yao, stammering,
"Miss Luo... these documents need your review and signature."
Luo Yao remained motionless, her icy gaze fixed on the ceiling, lost in thought.
She was counting how many squares it would take to cover the ceiling, wondering how many heads could fit in each square.
If those squares were filled with the heads of Liu Ruxue, how wonderful that would be.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Only when she felt thirsty and picked up the water cup on her desk did she calm down a little.
Slowly, she reached for the bracelet on her wrist, as if it were an emotional switch she could adjust.
Taking a deep breath, Luo Yao spoke coldly.
"Get out."
Liu Meng fled the office as if her life depended on it. As soon as she returned to the assistant team’s office, she was met by an executive delivering more documents, and her pupils dilated in shock.
"Sister Wang, if you have a problem with me, please use the law to punish me, not hand me more documents."
Wang Fang also felt a bit embarrassed.
"I'm really sorry, Assistant Liu. This document is very important and needs Miss Luo's..."
"If you want to die, go by yourself. Don’t drag me with you."
Wang Fang: "Is Miss Luo really that angry? Why?"
Liu Meng: "How would I know? But I can tell you this—Miss Luo’s mood is terrible right now. You have no idea, the temperature in her office dropped by at least 10 degrees earlier."
Wang Fang pushed the documents forward: "Then what do we do? This is a very important project!"
Liu Meng adjusted her black-framed glasses, deep in thought.
"Maybe... there’s one person who can help!"
"Who?"
Meanwhile, Lin Ran, who was busy reviewing the company’s progress, received a call and was puzzled.
It wasn’t often that Liu Meng contacted him. In fact, this was the first time since his rebirth.
Although he hadn’t saved Liu Meng’s number, he recognized it immediately.
The eye-catching 8888 at the end wasn’t a number many people used.
He was worried something had happened to Luo Yao.
"Assistant Liu, what’s the matter?"
Liu Meng was taken aback: "How did you know it was me?"
Lin Ran was also surprised: "You always call Luo Yao. I recognize the last digits!"
Liu Meng: "That makes sense. Come quickly! Miss Luo is in trouble."
Without a second thought, Lin Ran rushed over, asking for details as he went.
But Liu Meng kept stammering, refusing to explain clearly, only saying the situation was serious.
Lin Ran grew anxious. He didn’t care about the reason anymore; he just wanted to see Luo Yao immediately.
Because if Luo Yao was in trouble, he had to be there. No one was allowed to bully his wife.
Even though he thought no one would dare to bully her in the first place.
"I’m almost there. Should I come straight up?"
Liu Meng was stunned: "So fast?"
Lin Ran: "I’ve been in the office building across from yours."
Liu Meng suddenly understood. As Luo Yao’s assistant, part of her job was to report on Lin Ran’s activities. She knew he had started his own company.
"Then come up. Your fingerprint was already registered by Miss Luo. She said you can enter the company anytime."
Lin Ran: ???
He had no idea about that.
This was the first time since his rebirth that Lin Ran entered this building.
He remembered Luo Yao’s office was on the 88th floor. In his previous life, he had been dragged there by her bodyguards more than once.
As he walked in, many people on the first floor came and went, but the security guards didn’t stop him.
Lin Ran’s appearance caught the attention of many, especially some of the female office workers, whose eyes seemed to sparkle with admiration.
Lin Ran didn’t go through the reception desk. He headed straight for the private elevator, and a security guard immediately stepped forward to stop him.
"Sir, this is a private elevator. Only Miss Luo and her assistant team are authorized to use it."
Lin Ran nodded: "I know. I can use it too."
The security guard chuckled.
"Sir, Miss Luo has a severe aversion to men. She would never hire a male assistant. You should come up with a better excuse."
The guard had misunderstood Lin Ran’s meaning.
Lin Ran didn’t have time to argue. He had no idea what was happening with Luo Yao, and he was in a hurry.
He pressed his fingerprint, and the elevator started moving, leaving the security guard who had just called for backup completely stunned.
Over the walkie-talkie: "Old Liu, why aren’t you saying anything?"
Old Liu: "Never mind. I think I’m too young for this."
Lin Ran stepped into the elevator and politely nodded at the security guard, acknowledging his professionalism.
The private elevator was incredibly fast, and soon it arrived at the 88th floor.
As the elevator doors slowly opened, Liu Meng was already waiting.
"Mr. Lin, you’re finally here! Come with me, quick!"
As she spoke, she handed Lin Ran a stack of documents and explained the situation.
"So... you called me here in such a hurry just to deliver these documents to Luo Yao?"
Liu Meng nodded: "Not just the documents. The main thing is that Miss Luo is really angry right now. No one knows why, but you’re the only one who can calm her down!"
"Delivering the documents is just a bonus!"
She was about to push Lin Ran into the office but suddenly stopped herself.
If Miss Luo found out she had touched Lin Ran, would her hands be chopped off?
Although Luo Yao was just the CEO of Luo Corporation, those in the know understood she was a truly ruthless woman.
Liu Meng knew all too well about Luo Yao’s obsessive possessiveness.
She was the one who received and compiled reports on Lin Ran’s daily activities.
And because she knew, she was even more terrified.
Lin Ran didn’t notice Liu Meng’s hesitation. He walked straight into Luo Yao’s office.
Luo Yao was upset. His wife was in a bad mood, and it was his duty to cheer her up.

chapters.title: Chapter 23
chapters.content:
Lin Ran gently knocked on the door, but there was no response.
He held the doorknob and pushed it open softly—it wasn’t locked.
He stepped inside quietly, but no one was there.
The office area was empty, and so was the lounge.
Lin Ran was utterly confused.
Where was everyone?
Had he come here just to entertain the air?
