Suddenly, a faint sound broke the silence, like something being dropped. It was so quiet that one wouldn’t notice it unless they listened carefully.
Fortunately, Lin Ran’s hearing was sharp enough to catch it.
He paused, wondering where the sound was coming from.He retraced his steps from the lounge back to the office area and realized the noise was coming from behind the bookshelf.
But what was behind the bookshelf? A wall, of course.
Lin Ran placed the documents on the desk and listened more intently, confirming that there was indeed a faint sound coming from behind the bookshelf.
He tapped on the wall—it wasn’t solid. There must be another room hidden there.
“Luo Yao! Are you in there?” he called out loudly.
After calling twice without a response, Lin Ran turned to leave, intending to ask Liu Meng about it. But just as he was about to go, the bookshelf slowly began to move, revealing an opening just wide enough for a person to pass through.
Luo Yao stepped out, and as soon as she did, the bookshelf slid back into place.
When she saw Lin Ran, a flicker of panic flashed in her eyes.
“Well, well! I never knew there was a secret room in your office,” Lin Ran teased with a grin.
“Are you planning to hide a lover in there, my dear?”
Luo Yao quickly masked her unease and shot back, “Would you like to be the one hidden inside?”
To her surprise, Lin Ran nodded.
“If it’s you, my dear, then I’d gladly let you hide me away.”
As he spoke, Lin Ran moved closer, playfully wrapping his arms around her. He gently pushed up her sleeve, revealing a series of fresh scars on her arm.
Luo Yao froze, trying to pull her arm back, but she was too slow.
Seeing the wounds, Lin Ran felt as if his heart had been gripped by an invisible hand.
“I noticed your arm seemed stiff earlier,” he said softly.
Luo Yao stammered, “Lin Ran, it’s not what you think…”
She couldn’t let him fear her again. The past few days had been everything she’d ever dreamed of.
Lin Ran held her arm gently, his gaze fixed on the pale, delicate skin now marred by those wounds.
Each scar was a painful reminder to him.
His love for Luo Yao was still far from enough.
He helped her sit down.
“Do you have a first aid kit?”
Still in a daze, Luo Yao pointed weakly to a corner of the bookshelf.
Lin Ran retrieved the kit and knelt before her, carefully lifting her arm.
“Don’t move,” he said softly.
His tender touch left Luo Yao momentarily lost. As Lin Ran meticulously cleaned and disinfected her wounds, she didn’t flinch or show any sign of pain.
Instead, she simply watched him, her gaze fixed on his focused expression.
“It’s not your fault. It’s mine. I haven’t been a good husband, and that’s why you’re hurting like this.”
“Did you do this to yourself?”
Suddenly, Lin Ran understood why he’d seen scars on her leg before. He cursed himself inwardly for being so oblivious.
Luo Yao’s mind worked differently from most people’s. Her actions often seemed unpredictable, even incomprehensible.Thɪs
To an outsider, Luo Yao might seem unstable, even ill.
But Lin Ran didn’t want to change her. He just didn’t want her to hurt herself.
Her self-harm filled him with nothing but heartache and guilt.
Luo Yao remained silent. She had even hurt herself—would Lin Ran be afraid of her now?
A gentle voice broke the silence.
“Does it hurt?”
Lin Ran looked up, his face so close to Luo Yao’s that their noses almost touched. They could feel each other’s warm breath.
Instead of the fear she had expected to see in his eyes, there was only—heartbreak?
Seeing the tears welling up in Lin Ran’s eyes, Luo Yao quickly said, “It doesn’t hurt, Lin Ran. Please don’t cry.”
After finishing the bandaging, Lin Ran didn’t stand up. Instead, he wrapped his arms around her like a child, resting his head against her stomach.
“If you’re feeling wronged, you should hurt me, not yourself. If you ever feel like harming yourself again, let me share that pain with you. It breaks my heart to see you like this.”
Luo Yao placed her hand on Lin Ran’s head, closing her eyes as a single tear rolled down her cheek.
She didn’t want to agree, but she whispered, “Okay.”
Lin Ran wasn’t afraid of her. He didn’t fear her. He cared for her.
They held each other for a long time before Lin Ran finally loosened his embrace and looked into her slightly reddened eyes.
So she could cry after all. She wasn’t an unfeeling machine. She was a woman—his wife.
“Can you tell me why? If you don’t want to, that’s okay too,” Lin Ran said gently, careful not to upset her further.
After a moment of silence, Luo Yao spoke.
“You’re starting school tomorrow. I want to keep you by my side, but I don’t want to trap you. I’m so conflicted. I feel like I’m going crazy, so…”
Lin Ran finished her sentence. “So you hurt yourself to calm down?”
“But why? We’ll see each other every night. Why would you do this?”
Luo Yao looked at him intently.
“Because of Liu Ruxue. I’m afraid that once you see her, you’ll leave me.”
“The thought of you going to her makes me feel like I’m suffocating.”
“I want to kill both you and Liu Ruxue. I want to rip out my heart and show it to you…”
Now Lin Ran understood everything.
To the outside world, Luo Yao was a powerful, ruthless business magnate—a machine devoid of emotion.
But she had her vulnerabilities, her weaknesses, and they all revolved around him.
Her mind was a tangled web of nerves, each one resonating with darkness at the slightest touch.
“Luo Yao, look at me. I’m your husband. Liu Ruxue is nothing but a stain on my past.”
“You’re the only one I love. I’ll never love anyone else.”
“So please, trust me. No one will ever take me away from you.”
“I’ll never leave you.”
“And I won’t let you abandon me either.”
Luo Yao’s mind was a mess, but Lin Ran’s words gave her a sense of security she desperately needed.
Perhaps she needed to make an effort to change, to truly believe in Lin Ran.
“Okay, I trust you,” she said softly.
Lin Ran could feel the shift in her emotions. He made a silent vow to himself.
He would give Luo Yao all the tenderness she deserved, healing her wounded soul.
As for Liu Ruxue, he needed to resolve that issue quickly. Otherwise, she would always remain a thorn in Luo Yao’s heart.
After comforting her for a while, Lin Ran finally saw the familiar, assertive look return to Luo Yao’s eyes.
This was the real Luo Yao—the one who looked at him with a mix of possessiveness and affection.
The vulnerable, fragile version of her had been a fleeting glimpse into her innermost fears.
“My dear, what about the secret room?” Lin Ran asked playfully.
Luo Yao hesitated. “Lin Ran, next time. I promise I’ll take you inside, okay?”
Lin Ran raised an eyebrow. “You’re not hiding anyone in there, are you?”
Luo Yao shook her head. “No, it’s just some personal secrets. I’m not ready to show you yet.”
Lin Ran smiled charmingly. “Fine, but I’m upset now. I’m going to have to punish you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 24
chapters.content:
Luo Yao thought for a moment and said, "Then punish me. You can punish me however you want when we get home!"
Lin Ran raised an eyebrow. "Is that really a punishment?"
How could you take advantage of the situation like that?
He casually sat down on Luo Yao's office chair. "Then be my secretary! Let me experience what it's like to live as President Luo."
Luo Yao immediately sat on Lin Ran's lap.
"What does this mean?"
Luo Yao's fingers slowly rose, gently tracing Lin Ran's chest.
"The boss is so handsome, and I don’t think I’m too bad myself. So, when there’s work, the secretary handles it, and when there’s no work…"
Lin Ran casually picked up the document that Liu Meng had just handed him.
"Then there’s work now. Secretary Luo, please review this document."Luo Yao took the document with a puzzled look, quickly signed it, all while still sitting on Lin Ran's lap.
"Boss, it’s been reviewed. Please take a look."
Suddenly, there was a knock on the door.
Both of them froze, and a hint of killing intent flashed in Luo Yao's eyes.
"Come in!"
Liu Meng cautiously pushed the door open. "President Luo, the document!"
Luo Yao tossed the document over, and Liu Meng caught it perfectly.
"Thank you, President Luo!"
After closing the office door, Liu Meng let out a long sigh of relief.
It seemed President Luo's anger had mostly subsided. Oh my! Did I just see Lin Ran sitting in President Luo's chair, and President Luo sitting on his lap?
Wow! What a juicy piece of gossip! Excitement mixed with a tinge of disappointment.
Such a big scoop, yet I can’t share it.
Sigh!
Wang Fang asked, "Assistant Liu, is it done?"
Liu Meng listlessly handed the document to Wang Fang.
"Take it down to the operations department."
Wang Fang opened it and exclaimed excitedly, "It’s always you, Assistant Liu. The rest of us don’t dare show our faces in front of President Luo these days."
Liu Meng shook her head. "It’s not me. It’s all Lin Ran. He’s the one who made President Luo happy. Right now, she’s still sitting on his lap, flirting with him."
Wang Fang: "..."
"So, who exactly is Lin Ran?"
As if remembering something, she added, "Is he the handsome guy from that video conference the other day? You’re saying they’re... Oh my god."
"Is it really that intense?"
Liu Meng quickly covered Wang Fang's mouth. "Are you trying to get yourself killed, talking so loudly? I shouldn’t have told you."
Wang Fang also felt a chill.
"Right, right. I’ll go get busy now. Thanks for the reminder, Assistant Liu."
Liu Meng warned, "You better keep your mouth shut about this. If anyone finds out you leaked it, I won’t be responsible for cleaning up your mess."
Wang Fang nodded. "Got it, got it."
After delivering the document, Wang Fang returned to her desk, scratching her head in frustration.
The feeling of knowing such a big secret but not being able to share it was unbearable.
She turned to her colleague beside her.
"Little Zhang, go get me a cup of coffee, and I’ll tell you a secret."
Little Zhang immediately perked up and went to make the coffee without hesitation.
Back in the office, after Liu Meng left, Luo Yao turned around and froze.
Her desk was very simple, with just a computer, a water cup, and a few small decorations.
Lin Ran was staring at a small bottle on the desk, inside of which was a hidden note.
Curious, Lin Ran picked up the bottle, but Luo Yao snatched it back without a word.
Lin Ran teased, "Wife, I’ve noticed you’ve been keeping a lot of secrets lately!"
Luo Yao asked, "A-Ran, do you really want to see it?"
If Lin Ran wanted to see, Luo Yao wouldn’t stop him, but she felt a little conflicted.
Noticing Luo Yao’s hesitation, Lin Ran decided not to push her.
"If you want to show me, I’ll look. If you don’t, I won’t."
Luo Yao quickly put the bottle away, blinking her beautiful eyes. "I’ll let you know what’s inside someday."
Lin Ran sighed on the surface, but deep down, he wasn’t giving up.
It’s just a small bottle. He had a hundred ways to find out what was inside.
If he kept coming to the office, he’d eventually uncover all her little secrets.
Lin Ran was determined to see how many secrets the usually cold Luo Yao was hiding.
"A-Ran, I still want to be your secretary."
Lin Ran smirked. "I didn’t expect Secretary Luo to be so cooperative…"
From the office to the lounge, of course, since Luo Yao wasn’t feeling well, they didn’t take things further.
Luo Yao asked, "A-Ran, do you want to be the real boss of Luo Corporation? What if I gave it to you?"
Lin Ran was startled and quickly shook his head.
"No, I don’t. What would you do if I became the boss?"
Luo Yao gave a charming smile. "I’d keep being your secretary!"
Lin Ran chuckled helplessly.
"Stop joking. I just want to be a carefree slacker, not a workaholic."
Luo Yao teased, "Then why did you start a company?"
Lin Ran replied, "That’s different. I used your money to start a company so I could earn some extra cash to buy gifts for my wife."
"As for me, I’ll just wait for you to make money and support me. Why should I work so hard?"
Luo Yao’s heart was suddenly struck by a wave of happiness.
"Then I’ll support you for a lifetime."
Lin Ran grinned. "Of course. Did you think you could back out halfway?"
"It’s a promise."
"It’s a promise."
This life of being a kept man, Lin Ran was determined to hold onto it tightly.
Soon after, the two left Luo Corporation hand in hand.
Lin Ran’s appearance shocked the entire company, but no one dared to openly discuss it.
The executives, recognizing Lin Ran’s familiar handsome face, exchanged knowing smiles, while the regular employees were buzzing with gossip and shock.
"Did you hear? The entire executive floor is talking about President Luo’s young lover coming to the company."
"The whole company knows by now."
"If President Luo becomes gentler because of love, we’ll all be in for a treat."
"Apparently, this news is only supposed to stay among the executives, but the cleaning lady overheard it."
"President Luo isn’t the same as before. She’s been completely conquered by love."
"How does a security guard like you even know about this?"
"Of course, I do. I was the one who opened the elevator for that handsome guy when he arrived."
The company had seen many young men trying to charm Luo Yao and climb the ranks.
After all, who wouldn’t like a beautiful and wealthy female president?
But anyone who showed interest in Luo Yao would mysteriously disappear, so eventually, no one dared to try.
This icy female president might secretly be a cold-blooded killer.
She had scared off every man in the company.
She had even discouraged a few sapphic admirers.
Lin Ran frowned as he walked out of the building, holding Luo Yao’s hand.
"Why does it feel like everyone in your company is looking at me strangely?"
"Really? They dare to look at us? Their courage is growing."
"I’ll deduct their bonuses later."
Lin Ran felt a bit sorry for them, silently mourning their loss.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Luo Yao took Lin Ran to Huatian Plaza.
It was the plaza that had been transferred to Lin Ran’s name, with the mall being just a part of it.
This time, Luo Yao wanted to give Lin Ran a complete makeover.
Her man had to be the most dazzling guy around.

chapters.title: Chapter 25
chapters.content:
In the past, no matter what she did, Lin Ran would resist. But now that Lin Ran had started to change, she was determined to be even more devoted to him.
It was the first time she went shopping with Luo Yao without any bodyguards trailing them, though they might still be lurking in the shadows.
There was no butler to act as a third wheel, and Liu Ruxue wasn’t around to cause any trouble either.
Standing together, Luo Yao and Lin Ran looked like a couple, and even with masks on, they turned heads as they walked by.
They were just too perfect together.
However, Luo Yao’s shopping style completely shattered Lin Ran’s expectations.
At every store they visited, she would buy everything that fit Lin Ran’s size, having it all delivered to their address.
From head to toe, from watches to underwear, she even bought over a hundred belts.
Watching Luo Yao swipe her card repeatedly, Lin Ran’s jaw dropped in disbelief.
Is this how the elite shop?So effortlessly cool.
Lin Ran: “Let me emphasize again, being a husband is about the feeling.”
Word of Luo Yao’s shopping spree quickly spread among the staff in the mall.
Many of them also knew that the handsome young man accompanying her was the new owner of the plaza.
And the woman? She was none other than Luo Yao, the formidable business tycoon who struck fear into the hearts of the entire Kyoto business circle.
Although the mall was under Lin Ran’s name, the stores were all leased out, which was the norm for large shopping centers.
So, every shop eagerly awaited their arrival, knowing that their visit would mean a hefty commission.
But Lin Ran felt it was all too much and finally managed to talk her into stopping after some persuasion.
Luo Yao then took Lin Ran to a beauty salon.
“This is a place for women. What’s a guy like me doing here?”
“Didn’t you say you’d listen to me?”
“Alright, fine.”
After a spa session and a series of treatments, Lin Ran finally stepped out of the mall.
“Ah Ran, remember, only I can spend this much on you!
Can anyone else spend this much on you? Buy you so many things? Make you this handsome?”
Lin Ran quickly shook his head. No, they couldn’t.
Was Luo Yao trying to win him over with money?
“Darling, I’ve noticed how manly you are, especially when you’re paying.”
Luo Yao: “You’ll never out-man me, so don’t feel inferior.”
That was a critical hit.
Spotting an ice cream shop, Luo Yao casually asked, “Ah Ran, do you want some ice cream?”
Lin Ran shook his head immediately. “No, you’re on your period!”
Luo Yao laughed, genuinely happy.
It was the first time Lin Ran had seen such a smile on her face, one that seemed to melt the world around them.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
“Then let’s go for some desserts! I’ve never had desserts from outside before!”
“Sure!”
When they arrived at the dessert shop, a group of black-suited men appeared out of nowhere and cleared the place.
It wasn’t much—just a stack of cash for each person. Without a word, everyone took the money and left.
Luo Yao: “Can anyone else give you this kind of exclusive service?”
Lin Ran was speechless.
“Definitely not. No one else is this ridiculously extravagant.”
The staff at the dessert shop trembled as they served the two.
Lin Ran: “Which one do you want?”
Luo Yao: “I’ve never had desserts from outside before. Which one do you want, Ah Ran?”
Lin Ran thought to himself, she really is a princess of the elite, never even having tried the most ordinary desserts.
Lin Ran: “Then just pick based on your gut feeling.”
Lin Ran himself rarely ate desserts. The only time he had was when he accompanied Liu Ruxue.
Luo Yao pointed at one. “I’ll have this tiramisu. Ah Ran, you pick one too.”
Lin Ran glanced at the menu and asked,
“What’s your second choice?”
Luo Yao: “Eating too many sweets will make me fat. Do you like me chubby, Ah Ran?”
Lin Ran: “I do.”
Luo Yao: “How about this strawberry cheesecake?”
Lin Ran turned to the server. “We’ll take these two.”
Sitting in a cozy spot on the second floor, Lin Ran fed Luo Yao first.
Luo Yao: “It’s not bad.” She then glanced at the strawberry cheesecake in front of Lin Ran.
With a doting smile, Lin Ran tore off a piece and fed it to Luo Yao.
Luo Yao happily swallowed it, savoring the taste.
She never had high standards for food, but ever since Lin Ran started feeding her, she found herself paying more attention to the flavors.
Her body even started to change, at least she wasn’t as thin as before.
Feeling the sweetness of happiness, Luo Yao scooped a spoonful and offered it to Lin Ran.
The two took turns feeding each other.
“There’s a message wall here. Let’s write something.”
Lin Ran tore off two sticky notes, handing one to Luo Yao and keeping the other.
Luo Yao: “It’s a bit silly, but since you like it, I’ll write something.”
Luo Yao: [Ah Ran, always stay by my side.]
Lin Ran: [I’ll always be with Luo Yao.]
When they both stuck their notes on the wall, they looked at each other and smiled.
Luo Yao: “I know a place with eighteen kinds of torture devices, specially for those who break their promises to me.”
Lin Ran: “Then I guess I’ll never get to see it in this lifetime.”
After leaving the dessert shop, Lin Ran bought a cup of milk tea.
Lin Ran: “I made sure it’s not iced. I heard girls like this. Try it.”
Luo Yao: “Does Liu Ruxue like it?”
Lin Ran laughed helplessly. “She only likes eating crap. Can we stop bringing her up?”
Luo Yao took a sip. “It’s not bad. You try it too.”
It was her first time trying milk tea and desserts from outside, and Luo Yao was pleasantly surprised by the flavors.
When Lin Ran handed her the milk tea, he didn’t hesitate to take a sip as well.
Luo Yao enjoyed the feeling of sharing a cup of milk tea, using the same straw.
This indirect kiss, filled with subtle intimacy, felt even more blush-inducing than their physical affection.
But this was exactly why Lin Ran had only bought one cup.
As their date came to an end, Lin Ran realized it was the happiest one he’d had in this life or the last.
Though they only did simple things, being with Luo Yao made everything feel meaningful.
This kind of love was more about the feeling than the actions.
He realized that happiness depended on who you were with.
In his past life, he had accompanied Liu Ruxue and his family, but it always felt humiliating.
In this life, being with Luo Yao brought him nothing but joy and fulfillment.
For Luo Yao, this was also an unforgettable afternoon.
That night.
“I’ll take you to school tomorrow. Don’t go looking for Liu Ruxue!”
“I definitely won’t look for her, but we’re in the same class!”
“Not after tomorrow!”
Lin Ran was stunned for a moment, then smiled and agreed.
“Alright! I won’t look for her. If she comes to me, I’ll insult and humiliate her!”
Luo Yao pointed at her eyes. “Remember what you said. I’ll be watching you.”
Lin Ran: “Of course, just like the camera on the clock.”

chapters.title: Chapter 26
chapters.content:
Luo Yao was taken aback, then replied coldly, "So you knew."
Lin Ran smiled and reached out to gently tap Luo Yao's nose.
"I should say I like being watched by you all the time. If you're worried, you can install a tracker on me. Isn’t that what the domineering CEOs in novels always do?"
Luo Yao: "I already did. Three years ago."
Lin Ran was stunned.
No wonder she could always find him no matter where he was.
Even if he died and was buried, she would still find him.
So that was the reason.
Luo Yao: "Will you blame me?"
Lin Ran answered seriously."No, this way even if I die, you’ll still find me."
Luo Yao: "If A-Ran dies, I’ll definitely follow you, whether it’s to heaven or hell. You belong only to me."
"Deal."
"Never go back on my word."
**First Day of School.**
Capital University, as one of the top institutions in the country, was bustling with activity on its opening day.
Lin Ran officially became a senior.
Countless students, overcoming obstacles and chasing their dreams, stepped through the gates of this prestigious university.
However, there were also some students who got in through other means.
For example, Lin Jian and Liu Ruxue.
Back then, Lin Tianba had used the Suran Group's name to build a faculty dormitory in exchange for two admission spots—one for his younger son, Lin Jian, and one for Liu Ruxue.
Lin Ran, on the other hand, had earned his place through his own efforts.
Today, Lin Tianba personally drove his son and niece to school. As they arrived at the gate, a super luxurious Rolls-Royce pulled up, startling Lin Tianba, who quickly made way for the VIP.
Lin Jian hadn’t gone out much recently because he was still recovering from the bruises Lin Ran had given him last time. He didn’t want anyone to know about it.
The last time he went to a restaurant was to privately consult a lawyer about some issues, but he ran into Lin Ran.
Fortunately, he had mostly recovered and no longer needed to wear a mask.
Liu Ruxue hadn’t returned to school since the "luxury car incident" because it was too embarrassing, and the campus forums were flooded with posts about her and Lin Ran.
Luckily, most students were rational, at most labeling her as a "materialistic girl."
On top of that, Lin Ran had stopped pursuing her and used a luxury car to "humiliate" her, making it hard for her to hold her head high.
She hadn’t told Lin Jian or Lin Tianba about this.
After making way for the Rolls-Royce, Lin Jian and Liu Ruxue also noticed the luxurious car.
They wondered which young master or princess from a wealthy family was coming to Capital University.
Then they saw the license plate: Jing A00001.
Lin Tianba: "Is that… the Luo family’s car?"
While others might not know, Lin Tianba, as someone of some success, was well aware.
The Luo family was, without a doubt, one of the top-tier elite families in the country, arguably the number one.
It was said that the head of the Luo family, Miss Luo Yao, was only 26 years old but already held immense power.
Her rise to power was nothing short of legendary.
Lost at the age of 5 and found again at 18, everyone thought she would be an easy target when she returned to the family.
But to everyone’s surprise, Luo Yao single-handedly took down the entire Luo family.
Her first move was to eliminate her parents, and her brothers were either killed or left disabled.
After securing control, she even expelled her uncles from the Luo Corporation, and their whereabouts remained unknown to this day.
When the previous head of the family, Old Master Luo, came forward to mediate, he suddenly lost the use of his legs within days and retired to the family estate.
Everyone believed Luo Yao was behind it.
Yet, this cold-blooded and ruthless young woman had completely taken control of the Luo family in just a few years, with no one daring to oppose her.
By the time she took power at 23, the Luo family had already become a formidable force.
Back then, Lin Tianba had even considered befriending her. At a banquet, he overheard Luo Yao’s assistant, Liu Meng, mention that Luo Yao was searching for someone.
Lin Tianba had thought about helping, but within days, he heard the person had been found.
Missing the chance to curry favor with Luo Yao, Lin Tianba was deeply frustrated, though he consoled himself by thinking she was just a woman.
But this "mere woman" had, in just three years, elevated the Luo Corporation to the top of the world. Who could believe it?
Now, Lin Tianba knew he was far beneath the Luo family’s notice—or rather, even in the past, he would never have caught their attention.
The gap was simply too vast.
One was the world’s number one top-tier elite family, while the other was just a moderately successful businessman—there was no comparison.
But now, someone from the Luo family was attending the same university as his son. Lin Tianba couldn’t help but start scheming.
"Xiao Jian! Ruxue! Did you see that Rolls-Royce? That’s the Luo Corporation’s car."
"Whoever is inside coming to study here, you must build a good relationship with them. If you can win their favor, our entire family will rise. Understand?"
Both nodded, but when the three of them turned to watch the slowly opening door of the Rolls-Royce, they were all left speechless.
Lin… Lin Ran?
When Lin Ran stepped out of the car, not only were Lin Tianba and the others stunned, but everyone at the school gate was shocked.
The upperclassmen were surprised that Lin Ran had arrived in a Rolls-Royce, while the freshmen were amazed that such a wealthy guy could also be impossibly handsome.
"Who is that? So handsome, so rich—I want to get close to him!"
"New student, huh? That’s Lin Ran, our school’s heartthrob. But I never heard his family was that wealthy!"
"Wow! Such a handsome guy—I want to pinch his cheeks!"
"Lin Ran, look over here! Is it true you’re not chasing Liu Ruxue anymore? How about me?"
"Lin Ran’s not chasing Liu Ruxue? Where did you hear that?"
"Go check the campus forums…"
Liu Ruxue’s face turned pale as she listened to the girls around her. Her heart ached.
It felt like she was about to lose something important.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Since when had Lin Ran become so popular?
Just as Lin Ran was about to walk away, the car window rolled down, and Luo Yao’s icy voice rang out.
"Honey! A kiss!"
Lin Ran immediately turned back and kissed her: "A goodbye kiss. I’ll come home early tonight."
Satisfied with the kiss, Luo Yao coldly scanned the crowd of students.
She was making a statement.
This man is mine. Don’t even think about it.
The scene startled Lin Tianba, who was about to get out of the car with a cigarette in hand. He quickly retreated back inside.
Was he seeing things? The face that had appeared in the Rolls-Royce window—was that Luo Yao?
Unsure, Lin Tianba pulled out his phone to check.
"My God! It’s… really her!"
Lin Jian also saw her. His heart skipped a beat the moment he laid eyes on Luo Yao.
She was breathtakingly beautiful. Why would such a stunning woman kiss Lin Ran in public? Was there no justice in the world?
Lin Ran was just the unwanted outcast of the Lin family, while he was the family’s treasure!

chapters.title: Chapter 27
chapters.content:
Liu Ruxue’s face turned pale. The woman she had met twice left an indelible impression on her. Every time they met, Liu Ruxue felt as if she was about to be slaughtered by this woman.
"Dad! Brother actually kissed that beauty in public. Isn’t this damaging the reputation of our Lin Family?"
Lin Tianba glanced at Lin Jian but said nothing. Sensing Lin Tianba’s mood, Lin Jian quickly changed his tone.
"It’s all my fault. I haven’t been paying enough attention to my brother, so I didn’t notice how he’s been tarnishing our family’s reputation. This is on me!"
"Dad, don’t be too hard on him. Just let him kneel and apologize, and then forgive him!"
"Don’t hit him either. If you hit him, it’ll hurt me too!"
Lin Tianba sighed.
"Xiao Jian, you’re just too kind, which is why he keeps taking advantage of you."
"Now he’s even pressuring me to hand over my dividends. Even if this unfilial son kneels and apologizes, I’ll never forgive him. He’s lost me as his father forever."
Lin Jian: "Dad, don’t blame Brother. I wonder who that woman in the car was?"Suddenly, a thought flashed through Lin Tianba’s mind.
"Xiao Jian, I have something to tell you!"
He leaned close to Lin Jian’s ear and whispered something. As he spoke, Lin Jian’s eyes widened in shock, then gradually filled with excitement.
Lin Tianba naturally wanted Lin Jian to get close to Lin Ran and, through Lin Ran, get closer to Luo Yao. Ideally, he could gain Luo Yao’s attention, or even stay by her side.
That scoundrel Lin Ran was only a little handsome. Even if Luo Yao had some interest in him, it was probably just because of his looks. When it came to talent, his younger son, Lin Jian, was his pride and joy.
Even if things didn’t work out, he could always go to Lin Ran and squeeze some benefits out of him. After all, he was Lin Ran’s biological father. What could Lin Ran possibly do to him?
Wasn’t it only fair that he, as the father, got a share of the benefits from the Luo Family? He had brought Lin Ran into this world, so Lin Ran owed him everything. Even a dog understood this basic principle, and Lin Tianba certainly did.
After receiving his father’s instructions, Lin Jian thought of something else. He and Liu Ruxue walked into the campus together, whispering to each other.
Soon, Liu Ruxue’s eyes also widened in shock, then slowly filled with excitement.
Lin Jian sneakily pinched Liu Ruxue’s butt: "Oh, not bad. I’ll have to give you a ‘health check’ sometime."
Liu Ruxue blushed: "Lin Jian! You’re so bad. You’re asking me to go after Lin Ran? Aren’t you jealous?"
Lin Jian: "Go ahead. I trust you can protect yourself. As long as Lin Ran is with you, I’m sure that young lady won’t let him off easily."
Liu Ruxue: "So… you’re not jealous?"
She knew that her relationship with Lin Jian could never be made public. Lin Ran, on the other hand, was a perfect cover. Besides, Lin Ran had become more handsome and wealthy. Being with him didn’t seem like a bad idea.
The thought of managing both brothers was thrilling.
It wasn’t so much that Lin Jian was asking her to seduce Lin Ran, but rather that she had already wanted to get close to him.
On the first day of the semester, many senior students were busy as volunteers, helping with orientation and club recruitment. But Lin Ran had no intention of wasting his time on such things. He went straight to find his best friend.
Opening the long-unseen dormitory door, he found Wu Zhishang still asleep. The other two roommates hadn’t returned to school yet.
"Old Wu! Old Wu!"
No response.
"Son! Son?"
Still no response.
The entire campus was bustling with activity on the first day of school, yet this guy remained completely unfazed. What impressive sleep quality!
Lin Ran grabbed a handful of his friend’s hair and yanked him up. The pain immediately woke Wu Zhishang.
Wu Zhishang looked dazed, staring at the clump of hair in Lin Ran’s hand. He reached up and touched his head.
He was bald.
"Sorry, Old Wu! You were sleeping too deeply!"
Wu Zhishang took a deep breath, shook his now-nonexistent bangs, and suppressed his anger.
"Brothers! Brothers! We’ve been through thick and thin together. I’ll let this slide!"
"You handsome devil, I’m warning you. You’d better have a good reason for this, or else I’ll pretend you never said anything!"
Lin Ran felt a little awkward. He hadn’t meant to make Wu Zhishang’s already thinning hair even worse.Googlᴇ search ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"Old Wu! How’s the company doing?"
Wu Zhishang smirked proudly: "It’s all set up. We’re just short on staff now. Being on campus is perfect—we can recruit directly from here. Both the students and the school will support us. After all, everyone wants an internship certificate."
Lin Ran nodded: "Let’s find an opportunity to talk to the dean. Of course, we won’t take just anyone. People like Liu Ruxue, for example, are out of the question."
Wu Zhishang gave a thumbs-up: "Got it! I heard Liu Ruxue interned all summer but didn’t get her certificate. Hilarious!"
"Apparently, she tried to seduce her boss and got fired on the spot."
Lin Ran was stunned. That was quite the scandal.
Wu Zhishang: "It’s annoying to think we’ll have to see that trashy woman around."
Lin Ran: "After today, she won’t be in our class anymore!"
Wu Zhishang: "...???"
Meanwhile, in the dean’s office, Liu Ruxue was in shock.
"Why?"
"No reason. Starting today, you’re no longer a student in the Finance Department. The dean has arranged for you to transfer to the Foreign Languages Department to study Burmese."
Liu Ruxue couldn’t believe it: "Are you kidding me? What right do you have to change my major? This is tyranny! I’ll report this to the education bureau!"
The dean looked at her with disdain. He despised students who got in through connections.
"Go ahead! But before you do, I’ll have the education bureau investigate how someone like you, with such poor academic performance, got into Capital University in the first place!"
"Wait… you can’t do this…"
The dean: "Don’t act innocent. The Luo Corporation has already informed the school about your attempt to seduce a married man. The fact that you’re not being expelled is already a mercy."
"If you don’t want to change your major, I’ll have to ask the dean to expel you instead."
Liu Ruxue: "I was framed! You’re so unreasonable… Fine, I’ll study Burmese."
Seeing the dean’s cold expression, Liu Ruxue gave up resisting.
She walked out of the office in a daze, and soon her phone buzzed.
Looking at it, she saw a message from the dean. A flicker of hope rose in her.
Had the school changed its mind?
Dean: [I forgot to mention earlier. Your performance at the orientation party has been canceled. The student council said your dance looked like a squirming worm and isn’t suitable for the stage.]
Liu Ruxue stood frozen in place, unable to move for a long time.
Why had she been so unlucky lately?
First, Lin Ran left her. Then she was inexplicably saddled with a million-yuan debt. And now, even her best friend had abandoned her.

chapters.title: Chapter 28
chapters.content:
Even though she knew Lin Ran wouldn’t actually ask her for money—it was just a way for him to humiliate her when he was angry—it was because of this incident that she had become a hot topic on the campus forum, with many details about her being exposed.
She couldn’t even get her internship certificate at work, was accused of seducing a married man, expelled from her major at school, and her show was canceled.
What was the point of all the hard work she had put in these past few days?
Everything had started going downhill since Lin Ran left her.
“Lin Ran, I hate you!”
No, she had to go find Lin Ran. She still had a mission to complete.
She needed to find an opportunity to confess her feelings to him, leaving no room for retreat.
If she wanted to gain something, she had to lose something first. Since she had already lost, she had to make sure she gained something in return.
After today, she wouldn’t be in the same class anymore, and her chances of interacting with Lin Ran would become fewer and fewer. Today was the perfect opportunity.
As Lin Ran and Wu Zhishang were walking to the classroom, Wu Zhishang suddenly exclaimed, “Holy crap, Lin Ran! You’re on the forum’s front page! You and your girl were caught kissing in public on the first day of school?”Lin Ran quickly took out his phone and logged into the forum. Sure enough, there were posts about him—more than one.
Fortunately, none of the posts had clear photos of Luo Yao. Most of them were blurry, and the clearest one only showed a corner of her face, as Lin Ran had blocked most of it during their kiss.
Even so, it was enough to tell that Luo Yao was a beauty.
Wu Zhishang complained, “What the heck? There’s no clear photo of your girl! But even from this little bit, it’s obvious she’s stunning. Did you save the Milky Way in your past life or something?”
Lin Ran smiled but didn’t respond.
In his past life, he hadn’t saved the Milky Way—he had hurt an angel.
At the entrance of the large classroom, Lin Ran was stopped.
“Lin Ran, I need to talk to you.”
Liu Ruxue’s actions caused the entire classroom to fall silent.
“What, do you have the money ready?”
“Lin Ran, when did you become so shallow? Can’t we talk about something other than money?”
“What else is there to talk about? Should we talk about dreams? Then tell me, what’s your dream? Why are you here putting on a show?”
Liu Ruxue was furious. She took a deep breath, as if steeling herself for what she was about to say.
“I know you’ve been ignoring me and mocking me because I didn’t accept your confession, but I don’t care about that anymore. I’ve thought about it carefully these past few days, and I realize that I actually like you.”
“Ever since you’ve been gone, I’ve found it harder and harder to hide my feelings for you. Lin Ran, I’ve decided—I’ll be your girlfriend. Let’s be together!”
Lin Ran replied coldly, “Then you’d better be careful.”
Liu Ruxue was confused. “What do you mean?”
Lin Ran smirked. “Liking one person is hard to hide, but if you like two people, you’d better hide it well.”
Liu Ruxue was stunned. For some reason, a sense of panic crept into her heart.
“What are you talking about? I’ve already agreed to be your girlfriend. What more do you want?”
Lin Ran said indifferently, “I don’t agree. And you still owe me money.”
Liu Ruxue finally couldn’t take it anymore.
“Money, money, money! Is that all you care about? Have things between us really come to this?”
Lin Ran replied, “The only relationship we have is that I’m your creditor.”
Liu Ruxue was disappointed but still pleaded, “I admit I used to have high standards for you, Lin Ran. Let’s stop this nonsense and go back to how things were before, okay? I’ll be your girlfriend. Please don’t ignore me anymore. Haven’t you missed me at all these past few days?”
Lin Ran cut her off. “Stop. Whether I’ve missed you or not doesn’t matter. If you miss me, just call me.”
“My bank account number hasn’t changed. It’s still the Agricultural Bank.”
Liu Ruxue felt utterly humiliated. Her confession had been so obvious—how could Lin Ran not understand?
“Lin Ran, are you really this clueless, or are you just pretending? I’m seriously angry now.”
Lin Ran retorted, “If you’re sick, call 120. If you want to die, don’t drag me into it. If you have money, send it to me. If you don’t, go sell something.”
Tears streamed down Liu Ruxue’s face like broken beads, but the entire classroom remained silent, watching her. No one stepped forward to defend her.
If this had happened before, at least a few of her admirers would have come to her aid and criticized Lin Ran. But things were different now.
“Wow, Liu Ruxue has no shame. Lin Ran already posted on his social media that he’s married, and she’s still clinging to him. Isn’t this typical mistress behavior?”
“Well, it’s not like they’ve had a wedding or anything. They just got the marriage certificate.”
“Maybe the certificate is just a fake photo he found online to mess with Liu Ruxue.”
“I saw Lin Ran arriving in a luxury car today. There was a beautiful woman inside. He might be getting supported by her.”
“I don’t think so. Lin Ran doesn’t seem like the type to compromise for money.”
“Regardless of whether it’s true or not, it’s still surprising that Liu Ruxue confessed so openly.”
Hearing the whispers, Liu Ruxue’s eyes widened in shock as she looked at Lin Ran.
“Lin Ran, you… got married?”
Lin Ran shrugged. “Is that not allowed?”
“Liu Ruxue, let me make this clear. If you want to be a mistress, go find someone else. If you want to pay me back, then come see me.”
Liu Ruxue ran off, crying.
She had only just found out that Lin Ran had posted about his marriage on social media.
But she was no longer in his circle—she was in his blacklist.
As Liu Ruxue ran away, the classroom buzzed with chatter again.
A few people glanced at Lin Ran, and some even dared to ask him directly.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Lin Ran wasn’t ready to reveal who his wife was until he knew how Luo Yao felt about it. He simply told his classmates that he was indeed married, but no one knew who his wife was.
The girls in the class were heartbroken, but some thought Lin Ran was just putting on an act.
They believed he was playing hard to get to mess with Liu Ruxue, given how deeply ingrained his former “simp” image was in everyone’s minds.
Liu Ruxue returned to her dorm and cried under her blanket.
She felt like Lin Ran truly didn’t care about her anymore, and she couldn’t accept it.
When Huo Haini opened the dorm door, she immediately noticed Liu Ruxue’s swollen eyes.
Remembering her betrayal last time, she felt a little guilty.
“Ruxue, last time was just a temporary strategy. If it had been just you, Lin Ran wouldn’t have really made you pay. But if it were both of us, he definitely would’ve made me pay. You understand, right?”
“After all, we’re best friends.”
Liu Ruxue stared blankly at Huo Haini, unsure if she was telling the truth.
“But you never explained it to me all this time.”
Huo Haini said, “My dad made me go home for a blind date, so I didn’t have the chance.”
Liu Ruxue accepted Huo Haini’s explanation, and the two of them reconciled.
“How did your blind date go?”
“Not great. Those guys were either ugly or useless. None of them were as good as your Lin Ran.”

chapters.title: Chapter 29
chapters.content:
When it came to Lin Ran, Liu Ruxue's eyes turned red again.
"Ruxue, what's wrong? Did Lin Ran bully you again?"
Liu Ruxue cried even louder.
"Lin Ran, it seems like he got married. He doesn’t want me anymore."
Huo Haini widened her eyes in shock. "What?!"
After Liu Ruxue explained for a while, Huo Haini laughed.
"Ruxue, don’t worry. I’m sure Lin Ran is just lying to you."
Liu Ruxue: ???
Huo Haini: "Think about it. Lin Ran has always been madly in love with you. How could he just let go so easily?"
"He’s just gotten smarter now, playing hard to get.""He drives luxury cars, pretends to be rich... Although I don’t know where his money comes from, all of this is definitely to provoke you, to make you realize how good he is."
"Plus, you’ve always spent his money without committing to him. He’s probably upset, which is why he rejected you today."
Liu Ruxue suddenly understood.
She lifted her head and thought of the woman who had taken Lin Ran away.
Could it be because of her that Lin Ran didn’t dare to get too close to her?
It must be. There’s no way Lin Ran doesn’t like her. He must be under some kind of pressure.
And there’s no way he would marry someone else.
"Wuwuwu, Lin Ran is lying just to provoke me?"
"I only spent his money to motivate him to work harder. How could he be so clueless and not understand?"
Huo Haini looked at Liu Ruxue as if she were a fool.
If it weren’t for wanting to get closer to Lin Ran, she wouldn’t have bothered staying friends with such a clueless woman.
These past few days, she had also used her cousin who worked at an insurance company to investigate. It turned out Lin Ran was indeed the owner of that Koenigsegg.
Not only that, but Lin Ran also owned dozens of luxury cars, the cheapest of which cost millions.
This discovery shocked Huo Haini.
Now, Lin Ran’s coldness toward Liu Ruxue seemed genuine. He really didn’t like Liu Ruxue anymore.
So, didn’t that mean she could try to take his place?
Lin Ran was so handsome, rich, and outstanding.
He was the complete package—tall, rich, and handsome.
If Liu Ruxue didn’t appreciate him, she certainly would.
After knowing him for so many years, she hadn’t even held his hand once, yet she kept spending his money. How shameless.
Ugh! What a gold digger.
"It’s okay, Ruxue. You’re the most innocent girl I’ve ever met. You’ll definitely make Lin Ran fall for you again."
"Thank you, Haini. You’re right. Lin Ran loves me so much. He must be lying to me."
"No need to thank me. Aren’t we best friends?"
That afternoon, in the principal’s office.
Principal Tang was contacting his former students to see if he could use his connections to secure some internship positions at various companies.
The job market was getting worse. Big companies were monopolizing opportunities, while small companies struggled to survive.
Positions at big companies were highly competitive, and small companies didn’t want to waste resources. As a result, it was becoming increasingly difficult for college students to find jobs.
Even at Capital University, a top-tier institution, many students were struggling to find employment.
This wasn’t something Principal Tang wanted to see.
On top of that, the library was aging, and the funding from above was delayed. All these trivial matters required his personal attention.
At just 50 years old, his hair was already completely gray.
"Knock, knock, knock!"
The sound of knocking came from the door.
"Come in."
Seeing two students enter, Principal Tang looked puzzled.
"What can I do for you two?"
Ten minutes later.
Principal Tang: "You’re saying you’ve started a media company and want to recruit some students from the university?"
Lin Ran nodded.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on
Principal Tang immediately smiled warmly.
"Of course, that’s possible! Not only will this provide talent for your company, but it will also help solve the employment problem for our students!"
In the past, there had been students who had done similar things, but the results were never satisfactory.
"How many positions can you offer?"
Wu Zhishang handed a document to Principal Tang, who widened his eyes as he read through it.
"You need a hundred students?"
"Such a large-scale recruitment—if the results aren’t ideal, can you handle it?"
Lin Ran: "Thank you for your concern, Principal Tang, but it’s fine. We have sufficient funds. These hundred people are just the first batch. As the company grows, we’ll continue to recruit more. We hope you’ll continue to support us then."
Principal Tang’s eyes welled up with tears.
"Of course, of course. A hundred people is no small number. After the freshmen finish their military training, you can announce it at the welcome party and conduct on-the-spot recruitment."
Lin Ran: "Thank you, Principal Tang. Besides recruiting from the arts and finance departments, we may also hire from other faculties."
Principal Tang: "That’s fine, that’s fine. A company needs diverse talents to thrive. I understand."
After leaving the principal’s office, Lin Ran and Wu Zhishang exchanged smiles.
Mission accomplished.
The day passed quickly, and soon it was evening.
In the morning, Luo Yao had personally driven Lin Ran to school. In the evening, Lin Ran left in his Koenigsegg.
This scene left many students in awe.
Everyone was filled with curiosity about Lin Ran.
The younger female students were practically swooning, eager to throw themselves at him.
From that day on, Lin Ran became the undisputed prince of Jingda University. Combined with his previous fame, he became the center of attention for countless students.
When Lin Ran returned to the manor, he was shocked as soon as he opened the door.
"Welcome home, sir."
The servants lined up in two rows, a red carpet rolled out in the living room, and the butler stood at the end, holding a bottle of champagne.
Lin Ran was confused.
"Master Lin, Miss Luo said today is your first day of school, so she had us prepare a welcome-back celebration."
A celebration for starting school?
Indeed, with money, you could do anything.
"Is Luo Yao back yet?"
At that moment, Luo Yao walked in from outside.
Lin Ran turned around, hugged Luo Yao, and kissed her.
Luo Yao: "You’re very punctual."
Lin Ran: "Of course. I promised to come home early."
Luo Yao lifted her eyes, her gaze suddenly sharp.
"Did you see Liu Ruxue today?"
The room fell silent.
"Yao, I don’t want to lie to you. Yes, I did see her, but I have absolutely no feelings for her. I only asked her for money because she damaged the car you gave me."
Luo Yao already knew everything. In fact, she knew exactly where Lin Ran had gone, what he had said, and even how many words he had spoken.
Fortunately, Lin Ran hadn’t done anything outrageous, but this still left Luo Yao feeling dissatisfied.
She wanted to punish Lin Ran, to make him feel the pain, so he would be more careful in the future.
Liu Ruxue had dared to publicly confess her feelings for Lin Ran. She was practically asking for trouble.
The dining table had been transformed into a grand banquet table.
Lin Ran still sat next to Luo Yao, doing his best to give her a sense of security.
Otherwise, he might never be able to leave this manor again.
Luo Yao’s gaze lingered on Lin Ran.
The show was about to begin...

chapters.title: Chapter 30
chapters.content:
To celebrate Lin Ran's return to school, Luo Yao opened a bottle of red wine.
The two shared a warm and cozy meal, during which Luo Yao showed no signs of behaving differently than usual.
Lin Ran knew his alcohol tolerance was low and was afraid of saying something inappropriate if he got drunk, so he kept himself in check.
Luo Yao picked up her wine glass and walked behind Lin Ran, wrapping her arms around his neck before speaking softly.
"Ran, happy start of the semester. Let me feed you this last sip of wine."
Lin Ran blushed and nodded, "Okay."
This girl sure knows how to flirt.
Luo Yao leaned in and kissed him, feeding him a sip of imported red wine in the process.
That sip of wine was poisoned.
Literally.Lin Ran felt his head grow heavy, and when he woke up again, he found himself lying naked on the bed.
What the...?
He tried to get up but realized he couldn’t move.
This familiar feeling?
Memories from the past immediately flooded back, sending a chill down Lin Ran’s spine. He slowly turned his head to see a figure standing by the bed.
"Wife, what... what are you doing?"
Luo Yao didn’t say a word. Instead, she leaned over Lin Ran, her face close to his, staring into his eyes.
Her gaze seemed to say, "You’ve been naughty again."
"Luo Yao, you’re not serious, right? Right?"
Luo Yao put on a pitiful expression.
"Husband, do you love Yao Yao?"
Lin Ran nodded frantically, "Yes, yes, I love you the most."
"Then no matter what I do, you won’t blame me, right?"
Lin Ran nodded like a bobblehead, "Of course, of course, how could I ever blame you?"
Forty-nine minutes later.
This girl is really something.
Lin Ran knew that the more he resisted, the angrier Luo Yao would get.
This was a lesson he had learned in his past life.
Luo Yao was still that little devil, even if she had been acting gentler recently. It didn’t change her true nature.
Lin Ran remembered a time in his previous life when things had been even worse—he had been left bloodied and bruised.
The reason? On Luo Yao’s birthday, Lin Ran had used the excuse of preparing a gift to meet Liu Ruxue.
Afterward, Luo Yao had personally applied medicine to his wounds. At the time, Lin Ran had fought back fiercely, even slapping Luo Yao across the face.
Lin Ran remembered that after that incident, he had been subjected to a schedule of confinement: locked up on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, and semi-confined on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
This went on for three whole months before Luo Yao finally let him out again.
He never thought that even after being reborn, he wouldn’t be able to escape the same fate.
"Ran, why don’t you listen to me? Why did you meet Liu Ruxue again? Don’t you love Yao Yao anymore?"
Lin Ran took a deep breath. The last few strikes had left bloody marks on his body.
"Of course I love you. I hate Liu Ruxue, but she keeps showing up out of nowhere. There’s nothing I can do about it. Honestly, it’d be more practical if you just dealt with her directly."
Luo Yao grabbed Lin Ran and pulled him close, forcing him to look her in the eyes.
"I’ve already been dealing with Liu Ruxue, Ran. We’re the same kind of people—we both enjoy taking our time with the torment."Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"But I can’t tell if you’re being real or just acting in front of me, and I don’t even want to know."
"All I want is to warn you: if you dare to betray me, you’ll die a horrible death, and Liu Ruxue’s fate will be even worse."
"Don’t think I’m joking. When I’m serious, even I scare myself."
Lin Ran wasn’t intimidated by Luo Yao’s threats. In his understanding, the current Luo Yao was simply...
having an episode.
Lin Ran’s knowledge of Luo Yao wasn’t limited to this life—it extended to his past life as well.
In his past life, Luo Yao had been relatively restrained most of the time. She loved clinging to him, controlling him, and possessing him, but occasionally, she would truly lose it.
Of course, every time she lost it was because he had done something to upset her.
After her episodes, Luo Yao would either come back to comfort him or disappear for a few days before reappearing.
Once, after a particularly intense outburst, Luo Yao had confessed to Lin Ran.
She simply couldn’t control herself, especially when Lin Ran tried to escape. She couldn’t stop herself from doing those terrifying things.
Back then, Lin Ran hadn’t understood. He had simply seen Luo Yao as a monster.
But after being reborn, he had chosen to accept Luo Yao, to love her, and to understand her.
Gradually, he began to realize that Luo Yao might have a dual personality.
In her good moments, she was filled with love for him. In her bad moments, she vented her hatred toward him.
That’s why, when he saw Luo Yao hurting herself in the office last time, Lin Ran had immediately guessed why she had done it.
He had hurt Luo Yao before, and this was his debt to her.
Besides, this time, Luo Yao had been much kinder to him—at least compared to how she had been in the past.
If it had been like before, the consequences would have been far worse, and he knew that better than anyone.
Luo Yao tightened her grip around Lin Ran’s neck, her breath, her gaze, and her heartbeat all pressing against him.
She lacked love, so he would give her love—endless, boundless love.
"Let me say this seriously: the only person I love is you."
"You can hit me, scold me, and I won’t get angry. Even when you need to vent, I’d rather be the one hurt than you. Just like now."
"But if you doubt that I’d ever betray you, then I can only say this: it’s absolutely impossible."
"Go ahead! If this makes you feel better, then do it!"
Luo Yao looked at him with confusion.
"Are you serious?"
Lin Ran’s heart skipped a beat.
"Of course... Ah!"
Wait, girl, you’re not following the script!
Are you getting addicted to this or something?

chapters.title: Chapter 31
chapters.content:
After a long while, Lin Ran finally regained his freedom. Luo Yao sat quietly beside him, like a child who had done something wrong.
"Ah Ran, I'm sorry, I'm sorry... I didn't mean to do this..."
Luo Yao's heart ached with guilt and pain.
When dealing with enemies, she could be utterly ruthless, but with Lin Ran, she only wanted to show tenderness.
Yet, she couldn't understand herself. She loved Lin Ran deeply, but sometimes she couldn't help but do things that hurt him.
Every time she felt a surge of frustration because of him, she couldn't resist the urge to grab him and inflict pain.
If she didn't punish Lin Ran, she would retreat to the secret room.
She didn't want to go to the secret room because Lin Ran didn't like her hurting herself.
But she also didn't want to hurt Lin Ran.
The more intense her inner conflict grew, the more obsessive her actions became.Sometimes, she even wondered if she was going mad.
Lin Ran: "Do you remember what you asked me when I woke up earlier?"
"So don't say sorry. No matter what you've done, I don't blame you, because we're husband and wife."
Luo Yao shook her head. "But I feel uncomfortable."
Luo Yao felt uneasy because she had made a mistake.
Yet, the inexplicable anger she had felt earlier had vanished.
Now, she was more worried that Lin Ran would be afraid and run away from her.
She wanted to treat him well, but she was also afraid he would leave. Doing such things was both her idea and not her idea. This chaotic, insecure emotion was something no one could understand.
Her head was really aching.
Lin Ran: "Actually, I understand your feelings. Don't worry, I won't be afraid, and I won't run away. I just want to stay with you forever, building a safe haven for your heart over a lifetime."
Luo Yao looked at Lin Ran in disbelief. Every word he said seemed to resonate deeply within her.
So, he really understands me.
Luo Yao confidently handed over the item she was holding.
"Here."
Lin Ran: "???"
Luo Yao: "It's for you."
Lin Ran's eyes lit up, and he immediately sat up.
Whether forced or willing, he had indeed suffered a lot in this life and the last.
Wasn't this the perfect opportunity for some well-deserved payback?
Lin Ran gripped the small object tightly, raising his hand. Luo Yao looked up at him directly, her eyes unblinking, not avoiding his gaze in the slightest.
As long as Ah Ran was happy, as long as he didn't blame her, he could hit or scold her as much as he wanted.
Lin Ran's hand lingered in the air. Looking into Luo Yao's eyes, he ultimately couldn't bring himself to do it.
In this regard, Lin Ran admitted he was no match for Luo Yao.
Luo Yao loved him more than he loved her—at least, that's what he believed.
But Luo Yao could still bring herself to act, and that was where this woman surpassed him.
Loving someone and hitting them didn't have to be mutually exclusive.
"Forget it. A good man doesn't fight with a woman."
The sparkle in Luo Yao's eyes brightened.
"Ah Ran... you can't bear to, can you?"
Lin Ran nodded, admitting it openly.
"I love you too much to do it."
Too much?
Luo Yao silently repeated those words in her heart, feeling as if something had struck her deeply.
"You can do it gently."
"Even gently, I can't bear it."
Luo Yao's gaze grew hazy. "In that case, let's change the punishment for now."
Lin Ran: "What punishment... Mmm!"
Luo Yao began to sway freely on top of Lin Ran, dancing as if in a trance.
Lin Ran tried several times to flip over but failed.
How could this little girl be so strong?
Here he was, a grown man standing at 185 cm, being completely overpowered by a woman barely 170 cm tall.
It was utterly ridiculous. Who was the man here?
After a long while, Luo Yao's startled cry announced the perfect conclusion to their performance.
Lin Ran: "When did your period end?"
Luo Yao: "Last night, probably."
After catching his breath, Lin Ran pulled Luo Yao into his arms.
"Is this punishing you? Is this really a punishment? Huh?"
Luo Yao looked up with innocent eyes. "What else would it be?"ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Lin Ran grumbled indignantly, "This isn't fair. This is clearly a reward. I want a different punishment."
Luo Yao thought about it and realized it really didn't count as punishment.
"Alright, then you decide."
Lin Ran raised an eyebrow. "Are you serious?"
Luo Yao: "Dead serious."
Lin Ran smiled meaningfully. "Do you have any... black ones for me to appreciate?"
Luo Yao shook her head, but just as Lin Ran's face fell in disappointment, she pulled out her phone.
Liu Meng, who received the call, was utterly shocked.
Lin Ran stared at Luo Yao in confusion. Sis, are you really this bold?
Liu Meng, who had been woken up in the middle of the night, was both stunned and excited, her drowsiness completely gone.
So, this is how wild CEO Luo gets?
Without a second thought, she went to prepare what was needed.
Soon, Liu Meng personally drove to the manor and handed the items directly to Luo Yao.
This involved Luo Yao's privacy, so she couldn't let anyone else know. She hated gossip.
"CEO Luo, the items you asked for. Is it really this urgent in the middle of the night?"
Luo Yao glanced coldly at Liu Meng. "Yes, Ah Ran is eager to see them."
With that, she returned to the villa, leaving Liu Meng standing at the door in shock.
It seems it really was urgent.
CEO Luo is treating Young Master Lin this well? Just because he wanted to see something, she made her employee fetch it in the middle of the night.
And she asked for so many, in all sorts of colors. It wasn't hard to guess what they were for.
Young Master Lin is truly blessed.
Ahhh, I can't share this, I can't say anything. This is unbearable, truly unbearable.
Back in the villa's bedroom, Luo Yao sat on the bed.
"Do you like them?"
"They're beautiful. I love them."
Lin Ran sighed inwardly. No wonder so many people are obsessed with this.
It's not just about beauty.
It's also about the thrill.
The fact that Luo Yao was a domineering CEO only added to Lin Ran's sense of conquest.
Soon, the room was in disarray.
"Yao Yao, let me take charge."
Luo Yao obediently nodded.
"Whatever my husband says."

chapters.title: Chapter 32
chapters.content:
A few words stirred Lin Ran's heartstrings, and he felt that even if he were to die tonight, it would be worth it.
After it was over, Luo Yao still wasn't sleepy, clinging to Lin Ran and breathing softly like an orchid.
"Do you like it, Ah Ran?"
Lin Ran placed a finger on Luo Yao's lips.
"Shh! Woman, I warn you, don't seduce me. It's been a long time since I graduated high school, and I've completely forgotten 'Li Sao.' Now, I'm terrifyingly mischievous."
Luo Yao: "So?"
Lin Ran: "...I'm speechless."
Lust is a knife hanging over one's head, and under the pomegranate skirt, escape is impossible—each stroke of the blade cuts deep into the waist.
Early in the morning, opening the window, the mood was delightful.
At the dining table, Lin Ran sat beside Luo Yao and whispered, "Honey, I still think we should exercise some restraint. After all, I'm only human."Luo Yao: "Then I'll have Liu Meng throw away the things she prepared."
Outside the villa, Liu Meng, who had been waiting for Luo Yao, was resting with her eyes closed. She had tossed and turned all night, unable to sleep, and now had dark circles under her eyes.
She opened her eyes, checked the time, and realized it was past the scheduled hour. She knocked on the door to inquire.
Just as she followed Uncle Fu into the dining room, she heard Luo Yao's words and was filled with confusion.
Did Luo Yao ask me to prepare something?
Oh no... Could it be?
A glimmer of gossip flashed in her eyes again.
Having worked with Luo Yao for many years, rising from a small assistant to a trusted right-hand, she naturally understood Luo Yao well.
But precisely because she understood, she was shocked by Luo Yao's current transformation.
So this is the real Luo Yao.
Lin Ran, you're so lucky! But are you really worthy of our Luo Yao, the best in the world?
Eh, he's just good-looking. I haven't noticed anything else special about him.
Lin Ran: "??? There's more?"
"Wait, that... wasting is shameful, and we shouldn't litter."
Luo Yao smiled and leaned closer.
"Ah Ran, I think I've discovered some ways to control you."
Lin Ran: "I'd say it's voluntary."
"Is that so?"
"Yes."
"Be good today, okay?"
Lin Ran obediently nodded.
In his heart, he knew he had to deal with Liu Ruxue; otherwise, she would always be a thorn in Luo Yao's side.
Luo Yao straightened her clothes and left with Liu Meng. As soon as they got in the car, she said, "Don't forget to prepare the things I mentioned."
Liu Meng: "Luo Yao, are you serious? I'm your assistant, but I can't do this kind of thing for you."
"Okay, Luo Yao."
What galaxy did Lin Ran save in his past life?
Luo Yao: "Prepare more."
Liu Meng: "...???"
Luo Yao: "If Ah Ran isn't satisfied, you can stop coming to work."
Liu Meng's pupils shook: What?
Luo Yao, are you even listening to yourself?
Lin Ran, back at the villa, decided not to go to school and called Wu Zhishang to cover for him.
After a nap, his legs finally felt less weak.
Well-rested, Lin Ran began to think about how to formally deal with the enemies from his past life.
The first step is to make them experience true torment.
Lin Family, Liu Ruxue, prepare to face the judgment of the devil.
After planning, he contacted Wu Zhishang: "Do you know Brother Dao?"
Wu Zhishang was startled. As a local, how could he not know Brother Dao?
Cold sweat dripped down Wu Zhishang's face on the other end of the line: "Of course I know. Lin Ran, what do you mean? Did you mess with him?"
Lin Ran: "No."
Wu Zhishang: "That's good. If you messed with Brother Dao, it would be trouble."
Lin Ran confidently replied: "It's fine. Even if I did, he'd have to make way for me. After all, my wife is amazing."
Wu Zhishang: "Lin Ran, I've noticed you've been bragging a lot lately."
Lin Ran didn't bother explaining: "Listen, help me contact Brother Dao. Tell him I have a deal to discuss with him."
There was silence on the other end before Wu Zhishang responded: "Bro, are you serious? What are you trying to do?"
Negotiating with Brother Dao? Isn't that like dancing on the edge of the law?
Lin Ran: "Just tell me if you'll help or not."
If Wu Zhishang refused, Lin Ran planned to ask Luo Yao for help.
He didn't go to Luo Yao directly because he didn't want her to worry about what he was doing.
Wu Zhishang: "Alright, I'll help. I have a scoundrel cousin who works under Brother Dao."
Lin Ran: "Good, thanks, bro."
After hanging up, Lin Ran's eyes welled up with tears.
Of course, Lin Ran knew about Wu Zhishang's cousin working for Brother Dao; otherwise, he wouldn't have approached him directly.
In his past life, after his death, Wu Zhishang was the first to know, even before Luo Yao.
When Lin Ran was pushed off the rooftop, Wu Zhishang was waiting for him downstairs. That day, Wu Zhishang had risked everything to help Lin Ran escape from the estate.
Wu Zhishang couldn't believe what had happened. He called the police, but Lin Jian, Liu Ruxue, and Liu Yuemei claimed Lin Ran had accidentally fallen.
With Lin Tianba's behind-the-scenes manipulation, the three weren't even investigated. Wu Zhishang was devastated.
He hated his own helplessness and regretted bringing Lin Ran out that day.
He finally realized that perhaps it would have been better for Lin Ran to remain as the young mistress's caged bird—at least he wouldn't have died.
After grieving, he sought revenge and contacted his cousin, who immediately borrowed men from Brother Dao. Brother Dao generously agreed.
Unfortunately, one of his cousin's lackeys happened to know Lin Jian and sold the information to him for 100,000 yuan.
Lin Jian had the lackey get Wu Zhishang drunk and encouraged him to seek revenge immediately.
Heartbroken and unsuspecting, Wu Zhishang drank and got into a car to storm the Lin Family. Unbeknownst to him, the car had been tampered with.
Drunk and driving, Wu Zhishang crashed, shattering both his legs and leaving him wheelchair-bound for life.
At the time, Lin Ran, as a spirit, desperately tried to stop it, but he could do nothing.
Less than an hour after Wu Zhishang's accident, Luo Yao had already captured the Lin Family.
It was as if fate had arranged it all, always letting the wrong people suffer the consequences.
Wu Zhishang, a brother for life.
In the afternoon, Lin Ran finally left the house after receiving the message.
The capital was incredibly prosperous, but behind its glamour lay hidden gray industries.
A cluster of unfinished buildings might not be as simple as they appeared.
"So you're Lin Ran?"
Wei Xiang was surprised when he saw the car Lin Ran was driving. He hadn't expected his cousin to have such a wealthy classmate.

chapters.title: Chapter 33
chapters.content:
Lin Ran nodded, "Hello, my name is Lin Ran."
Lin Ran didn’t dislike people like Wei Xiang. In fact, in this lifetime, he didn’t dislike him at all.
Everyone has their own life to lead, and what happened in his past life wasn’t Wei Xiang’s fault. He hadn’t known that there was a traitor among his subordinates.
Besides, Lin Ran wasn’t exactly a good person himself now. The naivety he once had would never resurface in this life.
Wei Xiang didn’t dare to be careless and quickly shook hands with him. "Hello, I’m Wei Xiang, Wu Zhishang’s cousin. Let me take you to see Brother Dao."
Following Wei Xiang into an unfinished building, they entered an elevator in a very hidden spot.
Lin Ran couldn’t help but marvel at how strange this world was. Who would have thought that beneath such a dilapidated place lay a dazzling underground money-making hub?
Lin Ran followed Wei Xiang straight down to the third underground level.
As they stepped out of the elevator, there was a cage-enclosed fighting ring. Even if Lin Ran hadn’t seen one before, he knew this was an underground fighting arena.
The ceiling of this level was exceptionally high, and the design was quite ingenious.Lin Ran followed Wei Xiang to a private box on the second floor of this level, which offered the best view of the ring.
Inside the box, Lin Ran saw the man who was considered the top figure in the underground scene of the capital, known in the underworld as Brother Dao.
Brother Dao was around forty years old, and true to his name, a scar ran diagonally across his face, starting from his skull and ending at his chin.
Surviving such a severe injury was a testament to his resilience.
Wei Xiang had served time in prison with Brother Dao, which was why Brother Dao held him in high regard.
Wei Xiang confidently walked to one side of the sofa in the box.
"Brother Dao! I’ve brought him. This is Lin Ran, my cousin’s classmate."
Lin Ran nodded at Brother Dao, who gave him a once-over.
Hmm, a young man, probably here to ask for help dealing with someone.
Upon closer inspection, his attire suggested he was a wealthy second-generation heir.
But then, Brother Dao’s eyes widened in shock, and he nearly fell to the ground.
Holy crap! Isn’t this the man of Boss Luo?
What’s he doing here?
"So it’s Young Master Lin. Please, have a seat."
Lin Ran was surprised by Brother Dao’s polite demeanor, thinking to himself that the top figure of the capital’s underworld was surprisingly courteous.
Sitting across from Brother Dao, Lin Ran watched as Brother Dao personally pushed a freshly brewed cup of Longjing tea toward him. This scene made the surrounding underlings widen their eyes in disbelief.Follow current novels on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Brother Dao was treating this young man with unusual respect.
Lin Ran took a small sip and complimented, "Not bad. Thank you for the hospitality, Brother Dao."
Brother Dao was equally polite, showing none of the usual arrogance of a big shot. "So, Young Master Lin, what business do you have to discuss?"
Lin Ran handed over an IOU.
Brother Dao took it with a puzzled look, glanced at it, and asked, "Young Master Lin, are you asking me to help you collect this debt? You’ve come to the right person. We’re very professional at this."
Naturally, he wouldn’t scoff at the relatively small amount on the IOU. After all, even small profits added up.
According to underworld rules, debt collection came with a 20% service fee.
Lin Ran shook his head and raised a finger.
"There’s a much bigger deal here, Brother Dao. One that could make you a fortune, and it’s completely legal. As for this IOU, consider it a gesture of goodwill. If you can collect it, the money can be used to treat your men to drinks."
Brother Dao looked at Lin Ran in surprise. From what he knew, Lin Ran was still a student.
Yet, the young man showed no trace of nervousness or discomfort in his presence. This was truly unexpected.
What’s more, Lin Ran was willing to hand over the IOU as a gesture of friendship. While the IOU might not be worth much in someone else’s hands, Brother Dao was confident he could cash it in.
This showed that Lin Ran was both bold and generous.
And considering he was connected to Boss Luo, even without the IOU, Brother Dao couldn’t afford to not befriend him.
After a moment of silence, Brother Dao said, "Brother Lin, I consider you a friend now. I’ll take on your job, and whether it’s legal or not is our concern. If anything goes wrong, it won’t involve you."
With that, he reached out and shook Lin Ran’s hand. Lin Ran hadn’t expected things to go so smoothly.
Brother Dao thought to himself, how could it not go smoothly? You’re the real boss here.
If I dared to give you a hard time, I might end up floating in the ocean tomorrow, and some shark might have a feast tonight.
Lin Ran didn’t fully trust Brother Dao. After all, people in the gray areas of society weren’t exactly known for their integrity.
The term "brother" was just a polite formality. The only true brother he had was Wu Zhishang.
But for now, Brother Dao would undoubtedly be willing to cooperate, as there was nothing more appealing to them than money.
Lin Ran glanced at the few underlings around Brother Dao, who wisely cleared the room, leaving only Lin Ran and Brother Dao inside.
Only then did Lin Ran explain what was about to happen to the Lin family. Upon hearing this, Brother Dao’s eyes lit up.
Well, well, well. This wasn’t exactly illegal, and it could make him a fortune.
But wasn’t Young Master Lin part of the Lin family? Why was he being so ruthless toward them?
Well, that wasn’t for him to ponder, nor did he dare to think too deeply about it.
Perhaps it was all part of Boss Luo’s plan, and Lin Ran’s appearance today might even be a test from Boss Luo.
With that in mind, Brother Dao didn’t dare to delay and readily agreed to Lin Ran’s request. In fact, even if Lin Ran hadn’t come to him, he would have done the same if he had gotten wind of the situation.
But since it was Lin Ran who had orchestrated this, Brother Dao felt a sense of gratitude toward him. He even invited Lin Ran to take a look upstairs.
Lin Ran didn’t refuse. He was curious about this place.
The entire underground entertainment complex was nearly empty, as it was still daytime.
When they reached the second floor, Lin Ran was immediately struck by the sight before him.
It was a massive den of indulgence, the kind of casino one only saw in movies, but here it was, real and alive.
However, since it was still daytime, only a dozen or so people were gathered around a single gambling table.
Brother Dao said, "Brother Lin, care to play a few rounds? If you lose, it’s on me."
Lin Ran shook his head. "I have no tolerance for gambling or drugs."
Brother Dao thought to himself, you’re conveniently leaving out the "prostitution" part, huh?
Seeing that Lin Ran had no interest in gambling, Brother Dao simply smiled and didn’t press further.
Just then, a man at the gambling table was suddenly kicked to the ground.
"Damn it, I told you I don’t touch that stuff, and you keep asking. Are you looking for trouble?"
At these words, the entire casino fell silent, and Brother Dao’s face turned dark.
Everyone knew that while Brother Dao’s establishment offered gambling and other vices, drugs were strictly off-limits.
No one knew why a gangster like Brother Dao was so against drugs, but that was the rule.
Brother Dao glanced at Wei Xiang and said coldly, "If I’m not mistaken, that’s one of your men, right?"
Wei Xiang wiped the sweat from his forehead and replied, "Yes, Brother Dao. His name is Zhang Dahai. I’ll make sure you get a satisfactory resolution."
With that, he walked over, grabbed Zhang Dahai by the collar, and yanked him up, snatching the drugs from his hand.
"Damn it, do you have a death wish? Selling this crap here?"

chapters.title: Chapter 34
chapters.content:
Lin Ran narrowed his eyes. If he wasn’t mistaken, this man was the traitor from his previous life—the one who had sold information to Lin Jian.
Zhang Dahai knew how formidable Wei Xiang could be. Though Wei Xiang usually seemed easygoing, when he was truly angry, he could be ruthless.
Zhang Dahai also knew that Wei Xiang’s weakness was his sense of loyalty and righteousness, so he quickly began to cry and plead.
“Brother Xiang, I was wrong! My wife is lying in the hospital, and my son has disappeared, leaving us with nothing. I had no choice but to take a risk and make some quick money to pay for her medical bills. My daughter just started university, and I still haven’t scraped together her tuition. Please, spare me this time. I know selling this stuff in your place is against the rules, but I was desperate! Wuwuwu…”
Wei Xiang was momentarily stunned. He had to admit, Zhang Dahai’s story was convincing.
But Brother Dao, a seasoned veteran, saw right through the man.
“Xiang, rules are rules. I don’t want to repeat myself. Keeping someone like this under you will only bring you trouble.”
Wei Xiang pursed his lips, unsure if he should plead for leniency.
Lin Ran observed the scene and realized that Wei Xiang might not be cut out for this life. Brother Dao wasn’t wrong.
As it turned out, Zhang Dahai did indeed become a traitor in the end.Lin Ran thought of Wu Zhishang’s fate in his previous life, and a sudden surge of anger welled up inside him, though he forced it down.
Lin Ran glanced around, picked up a wooden stick, and silently handed it to Brother Dao. Brother Dao was momentarily surprised but then smiled and took it. He walked over and handed the stick to Wei Xiang.
“Xiang, do it.”
Wei Xiang closed his eyes, then opened them again, a fierce glint in his gaze. He grabbed the stick and swung it hard at Zhang Dahai’s legs, shouting, “How many times have I told you not to sell this crap? You think my words are just wind in your ears, huh?”
Zhang Dahai’s screams echoed throughout the gambling den, but no one showed any sympathy.
Zhang Dahai was a man who indulged in all sorts of vices—gambling, drinking, womanizing, and even drugs. He had the audacity to sell drugs in Brother Dao’s territory. If he got beaten to death, it would be no less than he deserved.
Wei Xiang broke both of Zhang Dahai’s legs, and the man passed out from the pain. Wei Xiang waved his hand, signaling for someone to carry him out.
Brother Dao patted Lin Ran’s shoulder. “Sorry you had to see that, brother.”ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Lin Ran thought to himself that this was karma. In this life, it was Zhang Dahai who ended up with broken legs.
But why had Zhang Dahai been caught by Brother Dao at this exact moment? Was it a ripple effect of Lin Ran’s presence here?
In his previous life, Lin Ran hadn’t been here at this time, and Zhang Dahai’s legs had remained intact.
For the first time, Lin Ran began to ponder the strange workings of fate.
He shook his head. “He broke your rules. He got what he deserved.”
Brother Dao looked at Lin Ran with surprise. Once again, he was convinced that Lin Ran was no ordinary man. No wonder Boss Luo had taken a liking to him.
Brother Dao nodded in approval, then addressed the guests in the gambling den. “Ladies and gentlemen, my apologies for the disturbance. Each of you will receive ten chips to settle your nerves.
