But let me remind you again—drugs are not allowed in my establishment. If anyone is caught, they won’t be shown any mercy.”
The gamblers didn’t care about Zhang Dahai’s fate. They were all too happy to accept the free chips and eagerly agreed with Brother Dao.
When Brother Dao returned to Lin Ran’s side after handling the situation, Lin Ran said something that nearly made him lose his composure.
Lin Ran: “What’s on the first floor? Shall we take a look?”
Brother Dao felt a chill run down his spine. He shook his head. “The first floor isn’t open for business yet. I’ll take you there another time.”
He didn’t dare bring Lin Ran to the first floor. If Lin Ran made a mistake there, it would be the end for him too.
Lin Ran was purely curious. Since Brother Dao didn’t want to take him up, he didn’t push the matter and decided to leave.
Despite Brother Dao’s enthusiastic invitation to have dinner together that evening, Lin Ran made an excuse and left.
After leaving the underground entertainment city, Lin Ran drove back to the estate. He wanted to get home before Luo Yao so that she would see him as soon as she returned.
On the way, he called Xu Kai and told him to start the operation.
When he arrived at the estate and slowly opened the door, he found Luo Yao sitting coldly on the sofa.
“You’re back early today?”
Instead of answering Lin Ran’s question, Luo Yao coldly asked, “What did you do today?”
Lin Ran was momentarily taken aback, wondering how to respond.
He didn’t want to worry Luo Yao, but he also didn’t want to lie to her.
“I went to take care of some business.”
Luo Yao narrowed her eyes. She already knew what Lin Ran had done that afternoon and had a good idea of his next move.
Brother Dao had just reported the day’s events to Luo Yao, and she had coldly told him, “Don’t take Lin Ran to such places again.”
Brother Dao was inwardly frustrated. Lin Ran had come to him on his own!
But what could he do? He didn’t dare argue and could only meekly agree.
Luo Yao: “Tell me the truth.”
Lin Ran: “Alright! I’m planning to deal with Liu Ruxue and the Lin family. That’s what I was doing today.”
Luo Yao: “Are you really willing to go that far?”
Lin Ran: “Darling, I am more than willing. I want them to suffer and die without a proper burial.”
Luo Yao’s eyes were deep as she stared at Lin Ran for a long time before finally speaking.
“If you need help, you must tell me.”
Lin Ran nodded. For now, he didn’t want Luo Yao’s help. He preferred to handle his revenge personally.
“If I run into something I can’t handle, I’ll definitely come to you to clean up the mess. After all, you’re the one who’s willing to take care of me. If you’re going to take care of me, you’ll have to clean up my messes too.”
“Ahem!” Uncle Fu coughed lightly. “Young Master Lin, do you realize what you’re saying?”
Luo Yao relaxed her stern demeanor and walked over to Lin Ran.
“It’s good that you think that way. With my resources, I can turn you into the most notorious playboy in the world.”
Uncle Fu thought to himself, “Miss, are you really this lovesick?”
During the cozy dinner, Luo Yao kept glancing at Lin Ran as he fed her.
Lin Ran, recalling the time Luo Yao had fed him a sip of wine, still felt a lingering sense of dread.
Thankfully, the feeding went smoothly, and Lin Ran enjoyed his meal as well.
After dinner, Luo Yao walked behind Lin Ran and wrapped her arms around his neck from both sides, like a seductive enchantress.
The familiar gesture made Lin Ran stiffen.
Luo Yao leaned close to his ear and whispered, “Aran, come with me.”
Lin Ran let out a sigh of relief, but then his face filled with confusion as he followed Luo Yao to the bedroom. What he saw there left him frozen in shock.
What on earth was all that on the bed?
Wait, did she really prepare seven different colors of those things?
And what was that? A dog leash?
Lin Ran shuddered. He couldn’t imagine how embarrassing it would be to have all those things used on him.
He turned his stiff neck to look at Luo Yao. “Darling, I didn’t do anything wrong today, did I?”
Luo Yao blinked innocently. “No, of course not! I prepared all of this for you, Aran.”
“If you like these things, then I’ll buy them all. Don’t you like them?”
Lin Ran forced a smile. “Heh… heh! I! Love! Them!”

chapters.title: Chapter 35
chapters.content:
Damn, has it really gotten this crazy?
Luo Yao pulled Lin Ran into the bathroom, but Lin Ran seemed preoccupied.
Back in the room, Lin Ran’s gaze began to waver.
But things quickly spiraled beyond Lin Ran’s expectations.
So this was how it was?
Staring at the flawless Luo Yao, Lin Ran froze in shock, suddenly feeling a warm sensation in his nose.
Drip, drip—blood trickled onto the floor. Lin Ran hurriedly covered his nose and rushed to the bathroom.
Damn, where did this girl learn all this? Isn’t this just asking for trouble?
After washing up, Lin Ran turned around to find Luo Yao standing behind him, looking pitiful.
“A-Ran, do you not like Yao Yao anymore?”Lin Ran’s nosebleed erupted again.
That night…
After the chaos.
Lin Ran turned to look at the energetic little devil beside him.
“Yao Yao, don’t you ever rest?”
Luo Yao woke up early every day and often stayed up late into the night.
While Lin Ran had plenty of time to nap during the day, Luo Yao seemed to be working non-stop.
Lin Ran felt like Luo Yao was some kind of perpetual motion machine, never stopping, and he had no idea how she managed it.
Luo Yao was momentarily surprised but quickly replied, “Of course I rest. I’ll rest now.” With that, she clung to Lin Ran like a koala.
The next day, unsurprisingly, Lin Ran skipped school again, and Wu Zhishang was fuming.
What Lin Ran didn’t know was that someone was desperately trying to find him.
Lin Tianba had been using illness as an excuse to delay the court hearing, hoping to settle things privately with Lin Ran before the trial.
By “settle privately,” what he really meant was forcing Lin Ran to kneel, kowtow, and apologize, after which he would magnanimously allow Lin Ran to be his son again.
On the first day of school, he had planned to take Lin Ran away directly, but when he saw Lin Ran arriving with Luo Yao, he hesitated and decided to return the next day.
But when he came back the next day, he was told Lin Ran hadn’t shown up. That very morning, court officials had visited his company and, citing Lin Tianba’s malicious refusal to appear in court, froze all his assets.
Not only that, since Lin Ran was a shareholder of Suran Group, the entire company’s accounts were also frozen.
The reason given was that Suran Group had failed to pay shareholder dividends, and the shareholder had requested a freeze on the company’s funds.
When Lin Tianba heard the news, he was stunned. He hadn’t expected Lin Ran to be this ruthless.
By this point, he was in a frenzy. He rushed to the school, only to find out Lin Ran still hadn’t come to class.
He contacted Lin Jian and even Liu Ruxue, but none of them could reach Lin Ran.
He was desperate because he needed to make a crucial payment to an important business partner.
If the payment wasn’t made on time, the construction site could face shutdown, and he might be held liable for breach of contract.
After a morning of negotiations, neither the bank nor the court budged.
Who would dare? The plaintiff’s lawyer was none other than the head of Luo Corporation’s legal department.
A heavyweight in the industry, known as the top legal mind in the country. One wrong move, and even the judge might end up in trouble.
Moreover, Lawyer Xu Kai’s procedures were completely by the book. No one could find fault with them.
The entire Lin family was on the verge of collapse, and Lin Tianba, overwhelmed with stress, ended up hospitalized.
Liu Ruxue approached Wu Zhishang, asking to contact Lin Ran but not explaining why.
Wu Zhishang, of course, refused to help. Left with no options, Liu Ruxue turned to other classmates for help.
Finally, around noon, she managed to reach Lin Ran through a classmate’s phone.
When Lin Ran answered, it was Liu Ruxue’s voice on the other end.
“Lin Ran? Your uncle is looking for you urgently. Can you… *beep! beep! beep!*”
Lin Ran cursed, “Damn it!”
The phone rang again, and Lin Ran hung up immediately.
He knew exactly why Lin Tianba was looking for him.
It was clear that Lawyer Xu Kai had made his move.
You want to delay paying? Fine, let’s see who cracks first.
Just as Lin Ran was feeling triumphant, Wu Zhishang called him.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
“Lin, your stepmother Liu Yuemei has caused a scene in the principal’s office. She’s threatening to tell the whole school that you drove your father to the hospital.”
“The principal said Liu Yuemei is making a huge fuss. She’s calling you ungrateful, saying the Lin family raised you all these years, and now you’re pushing them to the brink. The principal asked me to check with you. He’s trying to keep her under control for now.”
“I felt sick just hearing it. This family is so disgusting. Lin, you’ve really been through hell all these years.”
Lin Ran paused for a moment, thinking they must truly be desperate.
Otherwise, Liu Yuemei, who cared so much about her reputation, wouldn’t have resorted to causing a scene at the school.
“It’s fine. I’ll go see what she’s up to.”
Meeting the Lin family again, Lin Ran decided to make a grand entrance.
This time, he picked out an outfit that exuded authority—luxurious yet understated, the kind that screamed old money.
Unaccustomed to wearing watches, he surprisingly chose a Patek Philippe 5208T and drove out in his Koenigsegg.
The car alone was worth a fortune, the watch half of that, and the clothes at least several hundred thousand.
Lin Ran was like a walking billboard of wealth, making a high-profile exit from the estate and heading to the school.
He had already registered the car, so the gate automatically opened as he approached.
As soon as he entered the school grounds, he was met with countless envious and jealous stares.
Students from the lab building, classroom buildings, and dorms all peeked out. The Koenigsegg was simply too eye-catching.
The last time Lin Ran had driven this car to school was during the summer break. Now it was the start of the semester.
Even the freshmen on the field, taking a break from military training, looked up in awe, their faces filled with envy.
When the car stopped in the parking area and Lin Ran stepped out, he instantly captivated countless adoring gazes.
Step by step, he made his way to the principal’s office. As he entered, he saw Liu Yuemei sprawled on the floor, throwing a tantrum, while a few security guards looked on helplessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 36
chapters.content:
"Principal, I'm here."
Hearing Lin Ran's voice, Liu Yuemei froze for a moment before quickly standing up.
"Xiao Ran, you're finally here. Please, save your father!"
As soon as she finished speaking, Liu Yuemei was stunned.
Lin Ran's outfit was undeniably luxurious. The clothes he wore seemed to be custom-made by hand, and the watch on his wrist was clearly worth a fortune.
He had left the Lin Family—where did he get the money for such an extravagant wardrobe?
Principal Tang walked over, patted Lin Ran on the shoulder, and gave him a meaningful look.
"Lin Ran, does the school need to help? Our legal department is quite capable."
"No need to trouble the school. I can handle it myself."
Principal Tang nodded. "Alright, then. Talk things over, and if you need anything, remember to come to me. The school is your strongest support."With that, Principal Tang shook his head and left.
It was only today that he found out Lin Ran was a child of the Lin Family.
If that was the case, why hadn’t the Lin Family shown much care for him?
From what he knew, Lin Ran had not had an easy life these past few years.
Although he had started a company now, Principal Tang always believed that Lin Ran had worked his way up through sheer effort.
Lin Ran was an outstanding student, willing to endure hardship. Such a person was destined to succeed.
Lin Ran's reputation wasn’t limited to the students; even the teachers and the principal knew of him.
However, as the principal, he only knew that Lin Ran had lived a hard life. He didn’t know that Lin Ran’s relentless efforts were all for the sake of being a "lapdog."
Lin Ran nodded, showing respect for the old principal.
After Principal Tang left, only Lin Ran and Liu Yuemei remained in the room.
"Xiao Ran, please save your father! His company's funds have been frozen."
Lin Ran raised his hand to stop Liu Yuemei from coming closer.
"First, he’s not my father. Do I need to show you the proof of our severed relationship again?"
"Second, the company isn’t his. In terms of shares, I’m the one with the most authority."
"Third, I’m a heartless person. I only care about money, not people."
Lin Ran’s words left Liu Yuemei speechless.
"Regardless, you need to get the company’s accounts unfrozen."
Lin Ran: "Do you think I’m a bank? You think I can just unfreeze them with a snap of my fingers?"
Liu Yuemei: "But if you drop the lawsuit, this whole thing can be resolved."
Lin Ran: "You’re right. Dropping the lawsuit would solve it, but I don’t want to drop it."
Liu Yuemei: "You... you really are heartless. If you don’t drop the lawsuit, I’ll tell the whole school that you drove your own father to the hospital and ruined your reputation."
Lin Ran: "Liu Yuemei, Suran Group was founded by my mother. When she passed away, she left the shares to me. For years, you not only withheld my dividends but also mistreated me in every way possible. You were just a mistress—where do you get the nerve to threaten me?"Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"The freezing of your assets is completely legal and justified. All you have to do is hand over my share of the dividends, and I’ll drop the lawsuit. Is that so hard?"
"You’ve been leeching off me for years. The fact that I haven’t sent you to hell is already an act of mercy. What more do you want?"
Liu Yuemei: "You’re lying! When did we ever mistreat you? I never laid a hand on you. Look at how well-dressed you are now. How can you say you didn’t rely on the Lin Family for this life?"
Lin Ran: "Oh, you didn’t hit me, but you had Lin Tianba beat me. You starved me, made me do all the housework and cooking for your family, even though there were maids. From the time I was thirteen, you gave me 300 yuan a month—cheaper than a maid. Even my school fees had to be earned by me. How dare you question how I dress now? The money I spend now has nothing to do with your Lin Family."
"Or do you not want to admit to these facts?"
Liu Yuemei: "We were just trying to toughen you up. You’re a boy—it’s good for you to endure some hardship."
Lin Ran: "Why don’t you toughen up your son? Or is he not a boy? When did he go to Thailand? I didn’t know. Are you trying to cut off your own family line?"
Liu Yuemei: "You’re talking nonsense! My son is a real man. How can you compare to him? He’s the young master of the Lin Family."
Lin Ran: "A child born from a mistress dares to call himself the young master of the Lin Family?"
Liu Yuemei: "I’m the true wife of the Lin Family. Your father never liked your mother, and he never liked you either. Every holiday, he spent it with me and Xiao Jian."
Lin Ran: "So, you admit you were the mistress. Or did you seduce Lin Tianba to become the Lin Family’s wife? Or was it true love?"
Liu Yuemei’s eyebrows shot up in anger. She couldn’t understand why Lin Ran had changed so much.
He had always been so submissive in the past.
Lin Ran: "Admit it. It’s just the two of us here. No need to pretend to be a good person. If you want to talk, let’s be clear."
Liu Yuemei: "I... I didn’t seduce your father. He seduced me. He said that if I became his mistress, he would eventually marry me."
Lin Ran’s face darkened. Could his mother’s death be related to Lin Tianba as well?
Lin Ran stepped closer to Liu Yuemei. "So, you killed my mother?"
Liu Yuemei’s eyes widened. "No, it wasn’t me. Don’t talk nonsense."
Lin Ran: "Then it was Lin Tianba."
Liu Yuemei looked at Lin Ran in disbelief, shaking her head frantically. "No, don’t say that. No one killed that bitch."
Lin Ran slapped her across the face. Liu Yuemei stood frozen.
Lin Ran smiled. "A mistress dares to insult my mother? If you think I’ll drop the lawsuit, you’re dreaming. Since you and Lin Tianba are so in love, money must not matter that much to you. Go live your life with your true love."
"I will make sure the Lin Family goes bankrupt!"
Liu Yuemei cried, "You can’t do this! I’m the wife of the Lin Family. I can’t live without money. If you dare do this, I’ll humiliate you in front of the whole school."
Lin Ran shrugged. "It doesn’t matter. I’ve already severed ties with Lin Tianba. There’s a signed document, witnessed by a lawyer. So no matter what you say, I won’t drop the lawsuit."
Liu Yuemei: "Aren’t you afraid I’ll say..."
Lin Ran took out his phone and played the recording.
"#¥%... Your father seduced me... You can’t do this. I’m the wife of the Lin Family. I can’t live without money..."
Liu Yuemei: "You..."
Lin Ran turned and walked out of the office.
"Say whatever you want. I don’t mind making this recording public."
Liu Yuemei collapsed to the floor. She hadn’t expected Lin Ran to be so cunning.
If Lin Ran released the recording, not only would everyone know she was a mistress and that Lin Jian was a child born from an affair, but Lin Tianba would also misunderstand her.
If Lin Tianba got angry and dug deeper, Liu Yuemei shuddered at the thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 37
chapters.content:
Lin Ran walked out of the office and left the campus directly, wanting to avoid any chance of running into Liu Ruxue.
Not long after, Xu Kai called.
"Mr. Lin, Lin Tianba has agreed to hand over the dividends. His condition is that we drop the lawsuit, and then he’ll pay."
Lin Ran replied, "We won’t drop the lawsuit. Only when the money is in our hands will we consider it."
Lin Ran knew full well that Lin Tianba wouldn’t be able to come up with the money unless his funds were unfrozen. He wanted to make him sweat.
If Lin Tianba had a plan, good for him. If not, tough luck.
After all, his escape routes had already been sealed.
At Suran Group, Lin Tianba, dragging his sickly body, returned to face the wrath of the shareholders, who were all condemning his actions.
By now, the shareholders had learned why the company’s funds had been frozen.
They never expected the father and son of the Lin family to escalate things to this point.As shareholders, they didn’t care about family drama or who was right or wrong.
What they cared about was profit and power.
Now that Lin Tianba’s mistakes had caused such significant losses, the shareholders couldn’t sit still.
They held a joint meeting, intending to remove Lin Tianba from his position as chairman, but it ultimately failed.
There was no way around it—Lin Tianba held too large a share, and he still had some supporters, which led to the meeting ending in discord.
In the end, they could only issue an ultimatum: Lin Tianba had one day to resolve the issue, or they would go to war with him, even if it meant sacrificing their shares.
Lin Tianba sat alone in the conference room, his expression dark, smoking one cigarette after another.
There was no choice—he had to find a way to scrape together the money for Lin Ran. Otherwise, the company wouldn’t survive much longer. This could very well be the spark that ignited a full-blown crisis.
With a *ding*, Lin Tianba weakly picked up his phone.
Most of the messages he received these days were from shareholders blaming him. However, when Lin Tianba saw the sender’s name this time, his pupils dilated slightly.
He immediately tried to call, but the call was rejected with a notification: *[The other party is not your friend yet.]*
Lin Tianba was so angry he almost threw his phone. After a moment, he opened the file that had been sent to him and listened to a recording.
"...It was your father who seduced me... You can’t do this, I’m Mrs. Lin. I can’t be left without money..."
Lin Tianba’s face turned as dark as storm clouds, and it took him a long time to regain his composure.
After some thought, he contacted Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian, and they held a family meeting.
"That rebellious son is determined to humiliate me. There’s no other way—we have to come up with the money."
Liu Yuemei immediately looked unwilling.
"How? Our family doesn’t have 300 million to spare."
Lin Tianba rubbed his forehead.
"Then we’ll sell our assets—houses, cars, and all those jewelry pieces you have. Sell everything at once. Once this storm passes, we’ll buy back what we’ve lost."
Though Liu Yuemei was a thousand times unwilling, it was no use. She knew how serious the situation was.
Seeing her reluctance, Lin Tianba spoke slowly.
"Did you go see that rebellious son Lin Ran today?"
Liu Yuemei froze, then thought of something and began to tremble slightly.
"Husband, I just wanted to help you and the company."
Lin Tianba chuckled. "You helped quite well. Next time, don’t."
Before Liu Yuemei could say more, Lin Tianba continued.
"She sent me the recording of your conversation."
Liu Yuemei felt a chill run through her body but quickly regained her composure.
"Husband, it’s not what you think. I was just angry and said things I didn’t mean. I love you."
Lin Tianba nodded. "I know. I’m not angry because I love you too. We’re a loving family."
Liu Yuemei looked moved, holding Lin Tianba’s hand with one hand and Lin Jian’s with the other.
"That’s right, we’re a family—a loving family."
Lin Jian looked at his father and then at his mother, nodding obediently.
"Yes, we’re a loving family."
Lin Tianba took a deep breath. He admitted that he had been furious when he first heard the recording, but upon reflection, it wasn’t such a big deal.
If Liu Yuemei didn’t love him, why would she have borne his child and been his mistress for thirteen years?
Could it really be just for his money? That didn’t make sense.
Lin Tianba felt a pang of sorrow and guilt for his momentary doubt.
So he chose to forgive Liu Yuemei, to forgive his wife.nᴇt
"Once we get through this crisis, I’ll take you all on a trip to Africa."
Both nodded in agreement.
To raise cash quickly, Lin Tianba sold all his properties at a low price, keeping only the villa he currently lived in.
He also sold Lin Jian’s cars, his own cars, and all the stocks and funds he held, but it still wasn’t enough.
The shareholders, smelling blood in the water, swooped in to buy Lin Tianba’s assets at rock-bottom prices.
Due to the freeze, they only signed purchase agreements, but Lin Tianba didn’t dare renege on the deals later.
By evening, they were still short of the 300 million, missing a full 100 million.
Liu Yuemei pursed her lips but said nothing.
She had a backup plan.
Over the years, she had secretly saved a considerable amount of money—50 million, to be exact—stored in a card held by Lin Jian.
The cash the Lin family could raise before selling assets was also around that amount.
Just as they were at their wits’ end, an unexpected person showed up.
Brother Dao, the top underground figure in the capital, whose wealth was built on activities that were practically written into the criminal code.
Lin Tianba was puzzled but didn’t dare offend him. After all, he had heard of Brother Dao’s reputation.
Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian didn’t know Brother Dao, but seeing Lin Tianba’s respectful attitude, they also greeted him politely.
Brother Dao said, "Mr. Lin, I won’t beat around the bush. I hear you’re in need of money. I’m here to provide it."
Lin Tianba was stunned, then his face lit up with hope.
He knew Brother Dao’s main business was lending money. Given his recent asset sales, it was no secret that he was in trouble.
So Brother Dao was here to lend him money. All he had to do was pay some interest.
As long as the company’s funds were unfrozen and operations resumed, even a high interest rate wouldn’t be a problem.
Thinking this, Lin Tianba’s face brightened, and even Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian looked excited.
Lin Tianba said, "I see. Brother Dao, you’re truly a lifesaver. I do need a significant amount of money. I wonder if you can help."
Brother Dao asked, "How much?"
Lin Tianba held up one finger. Brother Dao was momentarily surprised, thinking to himself how accurate Lin Ran’s prediction had been.
"100 million? Easy. We can sign the agreement right now."
Lin Tianba was taken aback. He hadn’t expected a man from the underworld to have such resources.
"Thank you, Brother Dao. I’ll repay you as soon as possible."

chapters.title: Chapter 38
chapters.content:
Lin Tianba wasn’t stupid. He knew better than to get too involved with people like this.
Brother Dao chuckled, but then his expression suddenly turned cold. "Boss Lin, you have one month. You’ll pay 30% interest, and this villa will serve as collateral. If you have any objections, you can refuse now."
Lin Tianba stiffened. He had to admit, he was a bit scared. The interest rate was ridiculously high.
Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian also looked uneasy, their brows furrowed at the mention of such steep interest.
Lin Tianba gritted his teeth and said, "Fine, consider it a way to make friends with Brother Dao."
After signing the informal IOU, Brother Dao tucked it away and looked at Lin Tianba with a smile.
"Boss Lin, I won’t elaborate on the consequences of failing to repay. I’ve been in the capital for years, and I’ve never failed to collect a debt."
"You wouldn’t want your wife teaching foreign languages at an entertainment club, would you?"
At these words, Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian were visibly shaken, a sense of foreboding creeping into their hearts.
Liu Yuemei tugged at Lin Tianba’s sleeve, and he wiped the sweat from his forehead, nodding."Don’t worry, don’t worry. I’ll repay the principal and interest within a month."
He knew all too well what would happen if he failed to repay. With Brother Dao’s influence, Liu Yuemei might indeed end up teaching foreign languages at an entertainment club—or worse, he himself might be dragged into something similar.
Brother Dao left the Lin family villa, satisfied, and the Lin family let out a collective sigh of relief as they sat back down on the couch.
"It’s all that little brat Lin Ran’s fault. He’s cost me an extra 30 million. One day, I’ll make him pay for this."
Liu Yuemei frowned. "Actually, the loss is 330 million, and with the things we sold at a low price, it might even reach 400 million."
Four hundred million! In all her years with the Lin family, she had never seen such a sum of money, and now it was about to go to that little brat.
Lin Jian started crying.
"Dad! Even if Big Brother forced you to give him all the money, I wouldn’t blame him. After all, he’s my only brother."
Liu Yuemei chimed in, "I hope Little Ran will come to his senses after getting the money. After all, nothing in this world is more important than the bond between father and son. If he kneels and apologizes and gives up the money, you should forgive him, dear."
Lin Tianba’s anger surged.
"You two are too kind-hearted. You treat him like family, but he doesn’t see you the same way."
"Even if he kneels and apologizes and gives up his share, I’ll still give him a good beating before I let him be my son again."
Liu Yuemei said worriedly, "Dear, we must repay the loan within a month. Otherwise, I’m afraid Brother Dao might do something terrible to our family."
Lin Tianba replied, "Don’t worry, I know what I’m doing. That ungrateful brat, I…"
The more he spoke, the angrier he became, as if he’d explode if he didn’t vent his frustration.
After a moment of thought, he turned to the housekeeper. "Granny Wang, throw out all of Lin Ran’s belongings. I don’t want to see anything related to him in this house."
Granny Wang sighed. "Sir, when the young master came back last time, he already took everything with him. There’s nothing left, not even the bicycle by the door—he smashed it."
Lin Tianba was stunned. "He only took one suitcase. How much could he have carried away?"
When Granny Wang didn’t respond, Lin Tianba stood up angrily. "Fine, I’ll do it myself."
With that, he stormed toward Lin Ran’s room. Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian exchanged glances, but it was too late to stop him.
Lin Tianba pushed open the door to Lin Ran’s room and froze.
"Why is this a storage room?"
Granny Wang looked at him, puzzled.
"Sir, this has always been a storage room. The young master has lived here for ten years."
Granny Wang didn’t understand. The villa had plenty of rooms, so why had the young master been relegated to a storage room?
She also didn’t understand why the Lin family, despite their wealth, had always treated the young master so poorly.
She was just the housekeeper, but many tasks had been pushed onto the young master.
Was Lin Ran really Lin Tianba’s biological son?
Liu Yuemei caught up behind him. "Dear, didn’t you say you wanted Little Ran to live a simple life to avoid developing bad habits? That’s why I had this room prepared for him."
She glanced inside the room and also froze.
The room was less than five square meters. Aside from a bed and a simple wardrobe, there was nothing—no windows, barely any space to stand.
"Dear, it’s my fault. I didn’t notice the room had no windows."
Lin Tianba rubbed his forehead. "Forget it. He’s a boy. It doesn’t matter."
He stepped inside, intending to find something of Lin Ran’s to throw out, but there was nothing.
The wardrobe was empty, and so was under the bed.
"Granny Wang, when did Lin Ran come back to take his things?"
Granny Wang replied, "Sir, I told you already. The young master took everything when he came back last time. He had nothing—just a pair of shoes that had been repaired many times, two high school uniforms, and one set of everyday clothes that I once gave him."
Lin Tianba was at a loss for words. It suddenly dawned on him that Lin Ran had never had much money to buy clothes.
A pang of guilt struck his heart.
He realized that he hadn’t paid much attention to his son over the years.
If Lin Ran gave up his share and knelt to apologize, perhaps he could forgive him.
The boy was probably just going through a rebellious phase.
Lin Jian glared at Granny Wang, thinking she had spoken too much.
Liu Yuemei quickly added, "Dear, I did offer to take Little Ran shopping for clothes, but he always said he didn’t want anything. Don’t blame Granny Wang."
Granny Wang: ??? What are you talking about?
With this excuse, Lin Tianba stepped down from his high horse.
"If he didn’t want anything, then it’s not our fault."
"Sigh! I’ll talk to him when we meet tomorrow."
Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian exchanged another glance but said nothing.
Lin Tianba contacted Xu Kai, saying he wanted to meet Lin Ran and give him his share.
When Lin Ran received the message, a sly smile spread across his face.
Everything was going according to plan.
Lin Tianba, did you think this was over?
Once you hand over the money, your nightmare will truly begin.
"What are you smiling about, Ah Ran?"
Luo Yao, lying beside Lin Ran, asked.
Lin Ran held the beauty in his arms with one hand and used the other to feed her a grape.
Luo Yao opened her mouth and "chomped" it down.
"I’m smiling because you look so cute when you eat."
Luo Yao chewed thoughtfully.
"It’s not as good as imported ones."
Such a small request—of course, he’d indulge her.Google seaʀᴄh NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Luo Yao had become increasingly clingy to Lin Ran. Whenever she saw him, she couldn’t help but attach herself to him.
Lin Ran enjoyed her clinginess too. He had to take good care of his yandere wife.
"Ah Ran, I have a business trip tomorrow. Be good while I’m gone."

chapters.title: Chapter 39
chapters.content:
Lin Ran looked sorrowful. "You're going on a business trip? When will you be back?"
"The day after tomorrow."
Lin Ran nodded helplessly.
Luo Yao said, "There's an auction tomorrow night. Why don't you go on behalf of Luo Corporation?"
She wanted to keep Lin Ran occupied, fearing he might seek out Liu Ruxue if he got bored.
With her away from home, she couldn't give Lin Ran any chance to disappear.
Lin Ran was taken aback. "Luo Corporation? Can I really represent it?"
Luo Yao replied, "You're my husband, of course you can. I'll have Uncle Fu accompany you tomorrow. Buy whatever you like, and don't worry about the cost."
Lin Ran grinned. "Alright! Hehe! Tomorrow's my payday."
Luo Yao knew that Lin Tianba wanted to discuss the Lin Family dividends with Lin Ran the next day. After a moment of silence, she still reminded him, "If anything happens, make sure to contact me."Lin Ran nodded. "Got it."
...
Time flew by, and the next day arrived. At 8 a.m., Lin Ran arrived at the agreed-upon restaurant with Xu Kai.
Lin Tianba hadn't shown up yet.
As the father, he had to assert his authority and would never arrive before his son.
Though the meeting was set for 8 a.m., he deliberately planned to show up at 9.
Lin Ran waited for only five minutes. Seeing that Lin Tianba hadn't arrived, he decided not to wait any longer. Before leaving, he gave Xu Kai a few instructions.
At 9 a.m., Lin Tianba finally arrived at the restaurant with his family, hoping to sway Lin Ran through familial affection as a last-ditch effort.
Upon entering the room, he saw Xu Kai and two assistants but no sign of Lin Ran.
"Where's that little brat... I mean, where's that rebellious son of mine?"
Xu Kai responded politely, "Mr. Lin has already left. He said since you're not in a hurry to hand over the money, neither is he."
Lin Tianba was stunned. He took a deep breath and said, "Who said I don't want to give him the money? Tell him to come back, and I'll give it to him right now."
Xu Kai replied, "I'm sorry, Mr. Lin, but Mr. Lin Ran said he's going back to sleep. If there's anything else, it can wait."
Lin Tianba was so furious he almost couldn't catch his breath.
If he didn't resolve this matter today, the shareholders would surely make his life miserable.
"Sleeping in the middle of the day? What kind of bad habit is that? Tell him to come here, and I'll give him the money right now."
Xu Kai said, "I'm sorry, but Mr. Lin Ran said it was your fault for being late, not his. If you want him to come back, you'll need to show some sincerity."
Lin Tianba frowned. "What do you mean?"
Xu Kai smiled politely. "If you want Mr. Lin Ran to come back, you'll need to kneel and beg him."
Lin Tianba's eyes widened. "What? You want me to kneel and beg him? Has he lost his mind?"
Xu Kai maintained his smile. "So, will you kneel or not? If not, I'll leave right now and won't trouble you any further."
Lin Tianba suppressed his anger. "Tell him there's no way I'm kneeling."
This time, Xu Kai didn't say another word. He stood up and prepared to leave, with the two assistants following suit.
Lin Tianba was dumbfounded, while Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian were equally shocked.
"Wait!"
Just as Xu Kai was about to step out the door, Lin Tianba called out to him.
Xu Kai turned around with a smile. "Have you made up your mind, Mr. Lin?"
Lin Tianba gritted his teeth and said, "I'll kneel. You! Make! Him! Come!"
Xu Kai shook his head. "No need for Mr. Lin Ran to come."
He then took out his phone and dialed Lin Ran's video call. After several rings, Lin Ran finally answered.
Through the video, Lin Ran was indeed lying in bed, looking as if he had just woken up.
"Xu Kai, what's up?"
Xu Kai said, "Sorry to disturb your rest, but Mr. Lin Tianba wants you to come over."
Lin Ran yawned. "No need for me to come. You can handle it for me. Tell him to kneel, apologize, hand over the money, and then get lost."
Lin Tianba trembled with rage upon hearing Lin Ran's words, barely holding back a string of curses. Now wasn't the time to lose his temper—he still needed Lin Ran to drop the lawsuit.
Xu Kai turned the phone's camera toward Lin Tianba. "Mr. Lin, you may begin."
Lin Tianba hesitated, gritting his teeth as he said, "Lin Ran, do we really have to go this far?"
Lin Ran snapped, "Are you kneeling or not? If not, I'm hanging up."
Lin Tianba closed his eyes and slowly knelt down.
A father kneeling to his son—didn't this rebellious brat fear it would shorten his lifespan? Wouldn't he feel the urge to kneel and apologize the next time they met?
A voice came through the phone. "Can't you speak? Are you mute?"
Lin Tianba clenched his teeth and said, "I'm sorry. It was my fault for being late."
Lin Ran shifted comfortably in bed. "Not bad, not bad. Mr. Lin, you're quite adaptable. A real obedient dog. Transfer the money to my account, and handle the rest with Xu Kai."
With that, he hung up, saved the screen recording, and drifted off to sleep with a satisfied smile.
This was a video that would bring him joy. He'd watch it whenever he felt like it.
Always thinking you could make me kneel? Let's see who's kneeling now.
After Lin Ran hung up, Lin Tianba sat in stunned silence, feeling as though decades of humiliation had culminated in this single moment.
He had actually knelt to Lin Ran?
Suppressing his grief, he stood up.
"Now can you drop the lawsuit?"
Xu Kai nodded and handed over a document.
"Transfer the money to the specified account and sign here. Once the money is received, the lawsuit will be dropped."
Lin Tianba had hoped to use familial affection to sway Lin Ran and avoid paying. But he never got the chance and now regretted being late.
He didn't dare try any tricks in front of Xu Kai, a lawyer, and reluctantly transferred the money to the specified account.
Beside him, Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian were heartbroken—this was their money.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
As soon as Lin Ran received the notification of the transfer, he sent a message to Xu Kai, who then arranged for the lawsuit to be dropped.
With the matter settled, Lin Tianba regained his usual bravado.
"Tell that rebellious brat he can forget about ever returning to the Lin Family. Even if he kneels, apologizes, and slaps himself, I'll never acknowledge him as my son again."
Xu Kai smiled and extended his hand. Lin Tianba was confused.
"What do you mean?"
Xu Kai said, "Mr. Lin, my name is Xu Kai. On behalf of Mr. Lin Ran, who has entrusted me with the sale of his shares in Suran Group, I formally notify you to convene a shareholders' meeting as soon as possible. I will act as Mr. Lin Ran's legal representative to handle the matter."
Lin Tianba was stunned. "What?"
Xu Kai handed him another document.
"This is the authorization certificate and the share sale proposal. Please review it, Chairman Lin."
Lin Tianba took the document and read it over and over, his eyes filled with shock.
Lin Ran was selling his shares in Suran Group?
This would have a massive impact on Lin Tianba, potentially altering the entire structure of the group. His position as chairman might be at risk, and even if he retained it, he would lose his influence in shareholder meetings.
After all, Lin Ran held 30% of the shares, while Lin Tianba held 21%. Together, they could control the entire group.

chapters.title: Chapter 40
chapters.content:
Now, however, Lin Ran is planning to sell his shares, which means he is preparing to step away.
But Lin Ran is his own son, and those 30% shares were originally his as the father. In the past, he was able to control the entire company precisely because of this.
Shouldn’t this rebellious son, Lin Ran, unconditionally transfer those shares to his father?
"How could this little brat not tell me about such a major decision?"
Xu Kai: "Chairman Lin, I have already clearly informed you of my client’s decision to sell the shares. If you continue to insult my client, I have the right to sue and hold you accountable for your actions."
Lin Tianba was utterly stunned. He knew that Lin Ran was determined to sell the shares.
If the old-timers found out that Lin Ran was selling his shares, they would definitely fight to acquire them, and then he would no longer be the actual controller of the Suran Group.
Why does this rebellious son, Lin Ran, have the right to sell the shares?
Those shares should rightfully be his, his alone.
What’s worse is that Lin Ran holds 30% of the shares—this is no small stake.If sold, given the Suran Group’s reputation, it’s highly likely they could be sold at a premium. Even conservatively estimated, they could fetch at least 800 million.
He has no ability to buy them back, even if he emptied the entire Lin family’s coffers.
As for expecting Lin Ran to simply gift them to him, that’s clearly impossible under the current circumstances.
What on earth is this rebellious son trying to do?
Does he have to drive his own father to the grave to be happy?
*Pfft!*
Lin Tianba spat out a mouthful of blood.Thɪs updatᴇd by Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Liu Yuemei and Lin Jian were startled and hurried to help the collapsed Lin Tianba.
Liu Yuemei: "You heartless lawyer, can you even afford to compensate if you’ve harmed my husband?"
Xu Kai looked at Liu Yuemei seriously and said, "Madam, you must speak with evidence, or I can sue you for defamation. I’m not joking with you."
Liu Yuemei was also stunned. She didn’t know much about the law, but she was aware of Xu Kai’s capabilities.
After all, it was Xu Kai who had helped Lin Ran handle the 300 million matter. Without him, Lin Ran, that good-for-nothing, would never have been able to achieve such a feat.
With trembling hands, she dialed 120, and soon, Lin Tianba was taken away by an ambulance.
Xu Kai reported the situation to Lin Ran, who naturally had another reason to be happy.
He instructed Xu Kai on the next steps and then prepared to attend the evening auction.
With 300 million in his hands, his own money, he could spend it however he wanted, on whomever he wanted.
This feeling was truly exhilarating.
Nighttime.
The Luo Family Old Mansion, located in a mountain valley on the outskirts of Kyoto.
It wasn’t particularly large, but it was built facing south, nestled against the mountains. Several small streams meandered through the mansion, making it a place of excellent feng shui—truly backed by mountains and surrounded by water.
After centuries of weathering, the old mansion had been continuously renovated and still retained its ancient charm to this day.
A graceful figure appeared at the entrance, and the guards did not stop her.
Walking into the courtyard, it was eerily quiet. The figure didn’t linger and continued inward, slightly raising her head. It was none other than Luo Yao, who was supposedly "on a business trip."
After leaving the company that evening, she had come alone to this place, a journey that took over two hours by car to return to where she had once lived.
She didn’t know how long it would take to settle things here tonight, nor did she know if she would go mad from the bloodshed afterward. That’s why she had lied to Lin Ran, saying she was on a business trip.
Passing by one old building after another, she soon arrived at the main house in the backyard.
"Since you’ve returned, why not come in?"
Luo Yao gently pushed the door open and entered, her eyes scanning the old man inside with a mocking gaze.
The old man sat in a wheelchair, looking up at Luo Yao with an indescribable expression in his eyes.
Faced with Luo Yao’s sudden appearance, Old Master Luo didn’t show much panic.
"What? Can’t even call me ‘Grandpa’ anymore?"
Luo Yao walked step by step toward him, the sound of her high heels clicking on the floor like a death knell. It was then that Old Master Luo began to feel a chill run down his spine.
He didn’t know why the aura of this crazy girl had suddenly become so terrifying—it was as if it carried the stench of death.
Luo Yao smiled, a smile that was both radiant and eerie.
Then, in a light, cheerful voice, she spoke.
"Old man, even with your legs broken, you still can’t stay quiet. How does it feel to be in a wheelchair?"
The old man frowned, as if to say, "Don’t you know how my legs got broken?"
"Clearing everyone out during the day and having this place locked down, I knew you’d be back. So, what brings you back this time?"
Luo Yao nodded: "Not bad, you’re not completely senile yet. Actually, it’s nothing major. Your granddaughter has returned tonight to borrow two things from you, but I’m afraid I won’t be able to return them!"
Cold sweat trickled down Old Master Luo’s spine: "What do you want to borrow?"
Luo Yao held up one hand, forming a "V" with two fingers, and pointed them at Old Master Luo.
"Your eyes."
"Since you love spying on people so much, I’ll borrow your eyes. That way, you can keep an eye on me all the time."
Her tone was almost playful, but it sent shivers down everyone’s spine.
Old Master Luo looked at her in disbelief.
"You... you unfilial granddaughter."
Luo Yao: "Isn’t this what you wanted from me? Isn’t this what you, the Luo family, shaped me into?"
"Didn’t you say I was the most suitable to be the Luo family’s granddaughter? So why am I unfilial? Look at how well I’ve developed the Luo family!"
"Don’t worry, it won’t hurt. I’ll be very gentle and slow as I pluck out your eyeballs to give to my Ah Ran as glass marbles to play with!"
As she spoke, a cold glint appeared in Luo Yao’s hand.
Old Master Luo was furious: "Is that man so important to you? Important enough to make you harm your own grandfather?"
Luo Yao looked at Old Master Luo’s furious expression and sneered.
"You look like a dog barking helplessly!"
As she spoke, her footsteps didn’t stop.
Anyone who dared to target Ah Ran, no matter who they were, would not be spared.
When she was just a few steps away from Old Master Luo, a side wall suddenly opened, and several people jumped out. The leader was a man with a sinister, delicate appearance.
The man was named Lang Ya, Old Master Luo’s trusted aide.
The last time Luo Yao had broken Old Master Luo’s legs, Lang Ya had been away on a mission and hadn’t been able to stop her.
His feelings toward Luo Yao were complex—a mix of hatred, admiration, fear, and resentment.
Of course, there was also a strong desire.
He wanted Luo Yao to become his woman. Possessing a woman like Luo Yao would be the ultimate achievement.
The way he looked at Luo Yao was full of aggression, devoid of love, purely driven by possessiveness.
Especially in recent years, this desire had consumed his thoughts constantly. He was going mad, wanting to lock Luo Yao away and ravage her, even devour her.

chapters.title: Chapter 41
chapters.content:
However, he had never acted on it, biding his time, because he knew that Luo Yao's strength was indeed formidable.
Luo Yao wasn’t the least bit flustered, as she had long anticipated that the old man wouldn’t simply surrender without a fight.
What surprised her, though, was that he had managed to dig a secret room under her surveillance. That was unexpected.
Feeling Lang Ya’s gaze on her, Luo Yao narrowed her eyes, instantly recognizing the problem with this man.
His eyes didn’t just hold hostility; there was something else in them, something unmistakable.
Luo Yao knew exactly what it was. He was just like her.
Both were sick.
But Luo Yao’s possessiveness over Lin Ran was rooted in love, while the effeminate man’s was purely driven by desire.
If this man ever got the chance, her fate would be unspeakably horrific—even suicide wouldn’t spare her from humiliation.
Old Master Luo sneered, “Do you really think I’m some soft, helpless old man you can push around? Did you think I wouldn’t have a backup plan?”“Let me tell you this: if Lang Ya had been by my side last time, you wouldn’t have succeeded.”
“Lang Ya, go! Take down this mad girl. She’s yours now.”
Lang Ya’s eyes gleamed with greed, but he didn’t let his guard down for a second—it was the instinct of a top-tier assassin.
“Miss, don’t harm the old master. Surrender and—”
Before he could finish, a cold flash of light shot past, so fast it was terrifying.
Lang Ya prided himself on having world-class reflexes, but before he could even react, he felt a sweet taste in his throat. He tried to swallow in disbelief.
“Gulp!”
It was over.
Luo Yao moved like a shadow, gripping the dagger embedded in Lang Ya’s throat. With a twist, Lang Ya’s head rolled to the ground, his body still standing in place.
A second later, blood gushed from his severed artery, a testament to the speed of Luo Yao’s blade.
“You think you’re worthy?”
Luo Yao despised the way men looked at her, and with her misandry, she couldn’t afford to give this man any chance.
The room fell silent, save for the sound of Lang Ya’s blood spurting.
Old Master Luo’s bodyguards were stunned, their eyes wide with shock.
Lang Ya wasn’t just any bodyguard—he was once the top assassin in the Yangtze River Delta.
And he had been killed in an instant?
Everyone, including Old Master Luo, stared at Luo Yao in disbelief.
Old Master Luo pointed at her, trembling. “You… you’ve been hiding your strength all along.”
Lang Ya had been his final trump card.
Luo Yao didn’t respond, instead turning her cold gaze to the four remaining bodyguards.
The four men froze, feeling as though they were already dead.
If Lang Ya had been killed so easily, what chance did they have?
Run?
They had to run. The old man in the wheelchair could fend for himself.
They were just bodyguards, not martyrs. There was no need to sacrifice their lives for a dying old man.
The four bodyguards bolted for the door, glancing back at Luo Yao, who stood motionless inside, and silently thanked their luck.
It seemed this woman wasn’t the type to hunt them down.
But then—
“Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!”
Four gunshots rang out, and the bodyguards fell to the ground, twitching briefly before going still.
Luo Yao blew on the barrel of her gun and slowly holstered it.
Having efficiently dealt with the remaining bodyguards, she turned her attention back to Old Master Luo.
“Any more tricks? Show me what you’ve got.”
Old Master Luo trembled, unsure whether from anger or fear.
When he remained silent, Luo Yao lost interest in conversation and stepped closer to him.
“Your turn, Grandfather.”
Old Master Luo shook his head in terror.
“No! No! Luo Yao, you can’t do this. I’m your grandfather.”
Luo Yao’s expression didn’t waver.
Old Master Luo: “I was wrong, Grandfather won’t dare again.”
A flash of cold light, and the tip of Luo Yao’s blade now held an eyeball, still twitching.
Luo Yao: “Ah, I forgot. I need to take my time.”
Only then did Old Master Luo feel the pain. He let out a blood-curdling scream and collapsed from his wheelchair, writhing on the ground.
“Luo Yao, you… you’re insane! You… you’re a madwoman who kills her own parents!”
Luo Yao crouched down, looking down at him. “That’s right. I’ve always been a madwoman.”
She gripped Old Master Luo’s chin with one hand and waved the knife with the other.
“This time, I’ll take my time and make sure your eyeball is removed perfectly.”
As Luo Yao’s seemingly gentle movements continued, Old Master Luo’s screams echoed through the mansion.
“Ah…”
“Spare me… Grandfather begs you!”
“Ah…”
Luo Yao seemed to relish the torment, even if the victim was her own grandfather.
“You should’ve known this would happen the moment you started following Lin Ran.”
After what felt like an eternity, the perfect eyeball finally rested in Luo Yao’s hand. She held it up to the light, admiring her handiwork.
“Perfect. Don’t worry, I’ll preserve this and display it in the manor. That way, you can always keep an eye on us.”
Old Master Luo writhed on the ground, his hands clawing blindly, as if searching for his missing eye.
Luo Yao looked at him with disgust, her voice cold and mocking.
“How pitiful. No legs, no eyes. You’ll have to behave from now on, or who knows what you’ll lose next?”
“Of course, if you hand over what I want, I might grant you a quick death.”
Old Master Luo, enduring the pain, spat out bitterly, “You… will never have family… or love!”
Luo Yao: “Lin Ran is all I need.”
Old Master Luo wailed in agony, “Mad… everyone’s gone mad.”
Stepping out of the mansion, Luo Yao looked up at the stars, then down at her blood-soaked clothes, feeling particularly pleased.
She closed her eyes, savoring the natural scent in the air, listening to the mournful cries behind her.
“The world still feels beautiful. Maybe tonight, I won’t lose control again.”
“Should I rush back? I really want to see Lin Ran soon. I wonder if he misses me too.”
Just then, her phone rang.
Opening her eyes, Luo Yao glanced at the number and frowned.
She walked back inside, kicked Old Master Luo unconscious to silence his wailing, and answered the call.
As she listened, her expression grew darker.
Hanging up, her rage was palpable.
“Lin Ran, you’ve lost your freedom!”

chapters.title: Chapter 42
chapters.content:
The scene rewinds to the evening at the only seven-star hotel in Kyoto.
Liu Ritian: "Ruxue, tonight's auction banquet is of the highest caliber. Since your uncle is ill, we are representing his company today, so we must be mindful of our behavior and manners."
Liu Ruxue nodded gracefully, glancing at Lin Jian, who was standing beside Liu Yuemei.
Brother Lin Jian doesn't seem too happy.
Liu Ritian never imagined he would one day attend such a high-profile auction banquet.
Lin Tianba was hospitalized and unable to attend personally, but he knew that during such times, it was even more important to show up at significant events to demonstrate the normalcy of the Suran Group.
Thus, he handed the invitation to Liu Yuemei, asking her to bring Lin Jian to represent the Suran Group and, by extension, the Lin family.
Liu Yuemei not only brought Lin Jian but also invited her own brother, Liu Ritian.
Liu Ruxue was brought along by Liu Ritian.
The four of them, a whole family entourage, arrived at the entrance of the Pangu Hotel.Liu Yuemei was decked out in glittering jewels, flaunting her status as Mrs. Lin. Lin Jian was dressed in a sharp suit, looking quite dashing.
Liu Ritian sported a slicked-back hairstyle, shiny as if a calf had licked it. Liu Ruxue, on the other hand, opted for a pure and innocent look, exuding a girl-next-door vibe.
Just as Liu Ruxue and Lin Jian were discussing the identities of various wealthy heirs, a dazzling red Ferrari LaFerrari pulled up to the hotel in grand style.
"Wow! A Ferrari LaFerrari! Ruxue, do you know? This car has long been discontinued and is worth 25 million! I wonder who could drive such a sports car out in public."
"If it were mine, I'd definitely take you for a spin up the mountain."
A mountain drive?
As if recalling something, Liu Ruxue's face turned red.
"Brother Lin Jian, you're so annoying."
While she spoke to Lin Jian, her eyes were glued to the Ferrari, her envy impossible to hide.
Liu Ritian: "Ruxue, you must find a boyfriend of this caliber in the future."
Liu Ruxue: "Dad, what are you talking about? Love can't be measured by cars!"
Liu Yuemei, however, remained silent, frowning. She felt that the person in the car looked somewhat familiar.
Yet, when they saw who stepped out of the car, their eyes widened in shock.
Lin Ran arrived at the Pangu Hotel with Uncle Fu and his friend Wu Zhishang.
Today, Lin Ran was driving a red Ferrari LaFerrari, his entire outfit exuding flamboyance.
Wu Zhishang, sitting in the passenger seat, asked awkwardly, "Should I have worn black stockings?"
Lin Ran shot him a sidelong glance and said, "Don't be gross. My stomach isn't great, and I might throw up."
Wu Zhishang: "A weak stomach not only makes you prone to vomiting but also requires soft foods to nourish it."
Outside the hotel, the stunning red supercar came to a stop, and the doorman rushed to open the door.
Lin Ran tossed him the keys and pulled out a few bills. "Take good care of the car, or I won't tip you next time."
The doorman quickly nodded. "Don't worry, young master."
Wu Zhishang, standing beside him, looked shocked, while Lin Ran felt a rush of satisfaction—this was the confidence of being wealthy.
Uncle Fu also got out of the car and, along with Wu Zhishang, followed Lin Ran into the hotel.
The entire time, no one paid any attention to the dumbfounded Liu Ruxue and the others.
Wu Zhishang: "Brother Lin, Liu Ruxue and the others are here. What should we do?"Follow current novels on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Lin Ran: "What does that have to do with me? If they dare to provoke me, I'll lie down on the spot and make them pay me a million for car repairs."
Wu Zhishang gave him a thumbs-up.
Just as Liu Yuemei and Liu Ritian were about to approach and greet him, they were stopped by Lin Ran's bodyguards. Lin Ran and his group walked into the hotel without a second glance.
Liu Yuemei, barely containing her anger, said, "I'm his mother. Why are you stopping me?"
The bodyguards exchanged glances, and the leader spoke up.
"Sorry! Our Mr. Lin has said that his mother passed away long ago. If you continue to cause trouble by pretending to be his mother, we won't hesitate to take you away for a chat."
Liu Yuemei nearly choked on her breath. It took her a while to recover, and by the time she looked up to explain, the bodyguards were already gone.
Liu Ritian: "Was that really Lin Ran, that little brat? How could he afford a Ferrari? And with so many bodyguards?"
Liu Yuemei was seething with anger. She knew Lin Ran had money now.
Three billion! Spending a few million on a car was entirely possible.
Another issue was that when she had visited Lin Ran at school recently, his attire had clearly been high-end. It seemed he had been embezzling money from the Lin family over the years.
That money should have been hers, Liu Yuemei's. The more she thought about it, the angrier she became.
"Let's go in!"
Liu Yuemei, adorned in her clinking and clanking accessories, led the way. Liu Ritian, with his shiny, slicked-back hair, followed. Lin Jian and Liu Ruxue, the slightly more presentable ones, brought up the rear.
Taking the elevator to the venue, even Liu Yuemei, who was "used to" luxury, was stunned by the opulent, golden decor.
Presenting the invitation card, they were about to enter when a staff member stopped them.
"Madam, one invitation card only admits two people. You cannot all enter with four."
Liu Yuemei's anger flared. She had already endured too much frustration today, and now being stopped by a staff member pushed her to the brink of explosion.
"The group ahead went in with three people. Why can't I?" She was referring to Lin Ran.
The staff member politely replied, "They are from the Luo Corporation. Naturally, it's different for them."
The staff member thought mentioning the "Luo Corporation" would suffice, but the woman before her wasn't having it.
Liu Yuemei had no idea what the Luo Corporation was and angrily retorted, "What the hell is the Luo Corporation? I've never heard of it. If they're invited, isn't the Suran Group invited too? This is discrimination. I'm going to file a complaint."
The staff member raised an eyebrow but quickly regained her composure.
"I'm sorry, but these are the rules."
Just as Liu Yuemei was about to explode, Liu Ritian stopped her, whispering in her ear, "Sister, the Luo Corporation is the world's top financial group. Our Suran Group can't compare to them. It's like dust next to a skyscraper."
"Besides, I've heard that tonight's auction banquet has deep connections. Even as the Suran Group, it's best not to cause trouble."
Liu Yuemei was shocked.
The world's top financial group? Really?
So Lin Ran had entered with that kind of status?
Liu Yuemei took a deep breath, suppressing her temper.
"So only two people can really enter? Can't you make an exception?"
The staff member thought to herself, "Do you think this is some random place? Make an exception? Look at how you're dressed—like four walking disasters. The fact that I haven't called security yet is a testament to my patience."
"Yes, only two people are allowed."
Liu Yuemei sighed and said, "Then my son and I will go in."

chapters.title: Chapter 43
chapters.content:
Liu Ritian and his daughter, Liu Ruxue, both looked astonished, especially Liu Ritian, whose hair seemed to stand on end from anger.
"Sister, did you call me here just to make us stand guard like this?"
Liu Yuemei also felt a bit awkward, but she really wanted to enter because she and Lin Jian were representing the Suran Group.
Liu Ritian snorted coldly, "Hmph, I don’t have to go in, but Ruxue must go in to gain some experience."
Lin Jian noticed the awkwardness in the atmosphere and spoke up calmly.
"I won’t go in. Let Ruxue go in instead."
Liu Ruxue looked at Lin Jian with gratitude, and he returned her gaze with a meaningful look.
Liu Yuemei knew that this whole situation was because she hadn’t properly inquired about the rules beforehand. Now, she couldn’t say much and could only silently agree.
Thinking about how Lin Ran had swaggered in earlier made her furious.
It was all Lin Ran’s fault. If it weren’t for him, she wouldn’t have been humiliated like this.Her hatred for Lin Ran grew even stronger.
Just like that, Liu Yuemei led her niece into the venue, where they immediately spotted Lin Ran sitting in the front row.
After a moment of thought, she put on a kind expression and walked with Liu Ruxue toward the front row. However, they were stopped by a staff member.
"Ladies, you can only sit in the back. The front-row seats are reserved for VIPs."
Liu Ruxue retorted, "Do you know who we are? We’re from the Suran Group."
The staff member smiled, "I know the Suran Group, but in the capital, it’s a small company that’s not even on the radar. I’m surprised you even dare to look down on the Luo Corporation. If you’re not satisfied, you’re free to leave now."
The staff member had clearly seen Liu Yuemei causing trouble for other staff at the entrance earlier. He also knew that she had dared to disrespect the Luo Corporation, and he had already taken a dislike to the two of them.
Liu Yuemei was fuming inside. How dare this staff member look down on the Suran Group? It was a slap in her face.
"You dare to look down on the Suran Group?"
The staff member replied, "If that’s how you see it, there’s nothing I can do."
"You… Do you believe I’ll…" She was about to say something but then remembered her brother’s warning that the organizer of tonight’s auction had a very powerful background.
She then pointed in Lin Ran’s direction and said, "My son is sitting up front, right there. He’s representing the Luo Corporation. Can I go over now?"
The staff member was startled and quickly confirmed through his earpiece. After a moment, another staff member came over and said,
"Mr. Lin says he doesn’t know these two."
Liu Yuemei was instantly enraged. "Nonsense! Lin Ran is my son. How dare that ungrateful brat say he doesn’t know me? Does he think he can disown his family just because he’s climbed up the ranks in the Luo Corporation?"
The staff member sneered, thinking to himself that climbing up in the Luo Corporation was indeed a good reason to disown one’s family.
"Ladies, if you’re not going to take your seats, please leave. We have the right to remove anyone who disrupts the order."
Liu Yuemei hadn’t expected a mere staff member to be so assertive, but when she saw the security guards approaching behind him, she backed down.
She pulled Liu Ruxue to the back row and sat down, silently glaring at Lin Ran in the front row, her face filled with hatred.
It was all Lin Ran’s fault. If it weren’t for him, she wouldn’t have been humiliated like this.
Liu Ruxue asked, "Auntie, what’s going on with Lin Ran?"
Liu Yuemei didn’t answer. She couldn’t very well say that Lin Ran had swindled three billion from the Lin family.
However, what Liu Yuemei didn’t know was that Lin Jian had already told Liu Ruxue about it, though Liu Ruxue was pretending not to know.
Three billion! If she had that much money, how many designer bags could she buy?
Her gaze toward Lin Ran was filled with affection.
If Lin Ran were willing to offer three billion as a dowry, she might even consider marrying him. Although she also "loved" Lin Jian, he was her cousin, and such love was neither recognized nor blessed.
But Lin Ran now met all the criteria for marriage.
He was rich, handsome, and most importantly, he had always been generous to her.
If he could cut ties with that woman from the Luo family, hand over the three billion, and propose, she might just say yes.
Lin Ran, sitting in the front row, didn’t glance back even once. However, Uncle Fu beside him kept looking back nervously.
Wu Zhishang, on the other hand, kept whispering into Lin Ran’s ear.
"Brother Lin! This place is freaking luxurious! Look at that stage, those girls, those legs, look at…"
Lin Ran snapped, "I’ll look at your mom’s hammer, you idiot. Are you trying to get me killed?"
Wu Zhishang was baffled. "…???"
At that moment, the lights dimmed, and a host stepped onto the stage.
The entire room erupted in gasps.
Wu Zhishang’s eyes widened. "Holy crap, isn’t that Chen Qingtian, the star anchor from Donghai TV?"
"I thought the auction host would be some old geezer, but it’s actually a household-name celebrity!"
Lin Ran nodded. He hadn’t expected the host to be a celebrity either.
Lin Ran remembered that Chen Qingtian’s career had been smooth sailing so far, with her only low point coming soon when she would be caught in a scandal involving a late-night "script discussion" with a director at a hotel.
However, Chen Qingtian was no ordinary person. As soon as the scandal broke, she immediately revealed her wealthy family background. Not only did the director retract his statements, but even the media apologized and clarified the situation.
With such a powerful background, no one dared to slander her anymore.
But none of this concerned Lin Ran. He just recalled some memories upon seeing her in person.
A celebrity? Hah, to ordinary people, you might seem untouchable, but in the eyes of the powerful, you’re just a plaything.
What truly commands respect is the power behind someone, like Chen Qingtian. Without her background, she would have been crushed by the scandal, never able to recover.
Soon, Chen Qingtian picked up the microphone.
"Respected leaders, ladies, and gentlemen, good evening!"
"Thank you all for attending tonight’s charity gala. I’m Chen Qingtian…"
She spoke for about ten minutes before finally getting to the main event—the charity auction.
"Everyone, the charity auction is now officially beginning. We solemnly promise that all proceeds from tonight’s auction will go toward charitable causes, and we welcome your supervision. Now, let’s welcome tonight’s auctioneer, Mr. Yang Wei."
Pfft!
Lin Ran stifled a laugh. That name carried a certain… lack of confidence.
As Chen Qingtian finished speaking, a man in his fifties, dressed in traditional Tang attire, slowly walked onto the stage.
The staff immediately brought out the first item of the night.
As the item was displayed, gasps of awe filled the room, and the screen began its presentation.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
"Ladies and gentlemen, this is the first item up for auction tonight—‘Eternal Love.’"
"This necklace is the final masterpiece of Master Jack, the chief designer of a renowned jewelry company. It features the world’s top craftsmanship, with a central sapphire surrounded by white diamonds. There is only one of its kind in the world, making it the number one necklace globally."
"It is said that Master Jack created this piece to commemorate his eternal love for his late wife. It symbolizes not just love but also holds immense significance and unparalleled collectible value. The sapphire alone was once auctioned for one billion Chinese yuan in the United States."
"The starting bid for this piece is 130 million, with each increment no less than 10,000."

chapters.title: Chapter 44
chapters.content:
As soon as the words fell, the entire room gasped in shock.
No one expected the auction to start off with such a grand gesture right from the beginning.
Everyone had assumed it would begin with lower-value items, but no one could have anticipated this.
No one doubted the value of the necklace, as it was embedded with the largest sapphire in the world. That alone made countless people desire to possess it.
The socialites, both genuine and pretentious, could no longer sit still.
"My goodness! It's 'Eternal Love'! If someone were to buy this necklace for me, I’d be willing to have their child!"
"Ridiculous, would you not get married without the necklace? Is this something you can even dream of?"
"Stop yapping, you poor fool. Without money, where’s the romance?"
Hearing this, Lin Ran frowned, thinking to himself that he didn’t have much money either, yet Luo Yao loved him wholeheartedly.
"140 million."Soon, someone started bidding.
"170 million."
"170.1 million."
"180 million."
"..."
Quickly, the price reached 200 million. Such a luxurious necklace, even if resold, wouldn’t depreciate in value.
The wealthy in the room began to bid aggressively, with one female tycoon offering the highest bid.
Lin Ran was also deeply moved by the necklace. He could already picture Luo Yao wearing it, and a faint smile appeared on his lips as he raised his bidding paddle.
"300 million."
As soon as the words left his mouth, the room fell into dead silence.
Wu Zhishang’s eyes widened in disbelief.
"Bro, everyone else is raising the bid by tens of thousands, and you just went up by a whole billion? And you only have 300 million to your name. Are you out of your mind?"
Well… he does have a wife to support him. Damn it, just kill me now.
Uncle Fu was also taken aback. He hadn’t expected Lin Ran to make a move, let alone spend the young lady’s money.
But this was a good thing.
The auctioneer was equally startled, his hammer trembling slightly in his hand.
At this price, no one would dare to compete.
It simply wasn’t worth it.
At least not at this moment.
"300 million, going once."
"300 million, going twice."
"300 million, going three times."
The auctioneer’s hammer came down with a decisive thud. "Sold! Congratulations to the gentleman in seat number one for winning 'Eternal Love' at 300 million. May your career and love be everlasting."
Selling the necklace for 300 million was a significant achievement for the auctioneer.
From today onwards, 'Eternal Love' firmly secured its position as the number one necklace.
The entire room was in shock, and all eyes turned to Lin Ran.
With just one glance, countless socialites were captivated.
Not only was he wealthy, but he was also incredibly handsome. What kind of fairy-tale prince was this?Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Many of the socialites’ eyes nearly popped out of their heads, like demons catching sight of the Tang Monk, their gazes filled with greed.
Lin Ran had obtained the necklace he desired. Uncle Fu wanted to handle the transaction on the spot, but Lin Ran stopped him.
"I’ll take care of it myself."
A gift for his wife had to be purchased by his own hands. Although 300 million was a staggering amount, Luo Yao’s place in his heart was priceless.
He had his reasons for bidding 300 million in one go.
First, to prove that his love for Luo Yao was all-encompassing. Second, to intimidate those who kept raising the bids.
He wanted to crush them with a single, decisive blow.
Uncle Fu was momentarily stunned, then sighed inwardly, refraining from objecting.
It seemed that getting Young Master Lin to spend the young lady’s money was still a bit too idealistic.
Although Lin Ran had previously spent a few hundred thousand on renting an office, decorating, and other expenses, was a few hundred thousand even considered money?
It wasn’t even enough for the daily maintenance of the estate.
Before long, Lin Ran was once again a "penniless man," holding the luxurious packaging box as he returned to his seat. All the women were envious, and the men were green with jealousy.
Lin Ran instinctively glanced around, only to remember that Luo Yao wasn’t by his side. He scratched his head awkwardly.
Why did it feel so strange without Luo Yao around?
He really wanted to put the necklace on her right now, but unfortunately, she wasn’t here—she was away on a business trip today.
Meanwhile, the most shocked individuals in the room were Liu Yuemei and Liu Ruxue.
They both knew Lin Ran had 300 million, but they never expected him to spend it all in one go.
Wait, Liu Yuemei suddenly frowned.
Lin Ran had arrived in a sports car. If he had just bought the car, how could he still have 300 million left?
Unless…
The car must have been rented, just to put on a show of wealth.
Thinking this, Liu Yuemei’s mood improved slightly, and the corners of her mouth twitched upward.
But then she remembered that Lin Ran had spent the Lin family’s 300 million, and her heart ached again.
That lowly brat had spent all the money. No, she had to find a way to get the necklace back. It was the Lin family’s property.
Liu Ruxue, on the other hand, had a different thought. She wondered what Lin Ran’s purpose was for buying the necklace.
Could it be for that woman from the Luo family?
No, that couldn’t be. Lin Ran hadn’t known her for long. How could she compare to her, his childhood friend?
Suddenly, seeing Lin Ran glance around as he returned to his seat, Liu Ruxue froze.
Could it be that Lin Ran had bought the necklace for her? Was he looking for her? Oh my goodness.
Liu Ruxue covered her mouth, tears glistening in her eyes.
She had to admit, she was deeply moved.
The auction continued, with items ranging from a few thousand to several million, even tens of millions. Lin Ran didn’t bid again.
After all, he was out of money.
Of course, if something caught his eye, he might consider spending Luo Yao’s money. After all, spending your wife’s money wasn’t something to be ashamed of.
Toward the end, some unexpected items came up for auction, and Lin Ran’s interest was piqued.
There were companies, land plots, and real estate properties. The land plot, in particular, sparked a fierce bidding war among developers.
Unlike physical items that required immediate payment, land auctions allowed developers to pay a deposit and use the pre-sale contract to secure a loan.
Once the loan was approved, they could use the land as collateral for a second loan to fund the development project. After building a few structural frames, they could start pre-selling units to quickly recoup their investment, leveraging a small amount of capital to tap into a large market.
Although the real estate industry was becoming more transparent, with the right strategy, the profits were still considerable.
The Suran Group’s main business was real estate development. Although it wasn’t a major player, it was a legitimate real estate company, so Lin Ran had some understanding of the industry.
What caught Lin Ran’s attention wasn’t the land plot but the few properties.
Squinting his eyes, Lin Ran noticed that some of the properties seemed to belong to the Lin family.

chapters.title: Chapter 45
chapters.content:
Lin Ran quickly figured it out. These properties were likely sold at a low price by Lin Tianba to raise funds for himself, and now the buyers were putting them up for auction.
Lin Ran smiled, and he smiled very happily.
In a little while, he would make the Lin family homeless.
The auction didn’t end until 8 p.m., transitioning into a cocktail dinner party.
Lin Ran had never attended such a high-profile event before. Thinking that Luo Yao wasn’t home and there was no one to keep him company, he decided to bring Wu Zhishang along to the banquet hall to broaden their horizons.
Lin Ran’s appearance quickly drew a lot of attention—after all, he had made quite a splash today.
Countless socialites were eager to approach him, and many wealthy families wanted to establish connections.
When someone can casually spend 300 million in cash, even dogs would wag their tails at you.
After all, having 300 million in liquid assets isn’t just about being worth 300 million—it signifies so much more.
Even a company with a market value of 10 billion would need extensive preparation to come up with 300 million in cash, let alone someone like Lin Ran, who spent that amount just to buy a necklace.No sane person would liquidate all their assets just to purchase a necklace.
But what they didn’t know was that Lin Ran was anything but sane.
The socialites flocked closer, trying all sorts of subtle moves, but Lin Ran saw through every one of them and decisively distanced himself.
He even coldly rejected their offers to toast or dance.
Lin Ran was certain that if he dared to dance with another woman today, both he and that woman would face dire consequences tomorrow.
Death or severe injury would be the least of their worries.
Besides, how could these mediocre women compare to his wife?
Wasn’t Luo Yao adorable? Beautiful? Fragrant?
Well… though she sometimes went a little crazy, Lin Ran loved everything about her now, including her madness.
Seeing Lin Ran’s unapproachable demeanor, the socialites stomped their feet in frustration, but some turned their attention to Wu Zhishang, who was by his side.
Someone who could hang out with such a wealthy family must be no ordinary person, even if Wu Zhishang’s attire was rather plain.
But does dressing plainly mean you’re plain?
Take Jack Ma, for example. No matter where he goes, he wears a pair of traditional Beijing cloth shoes, but does that mean he’s not rich?
The whole world knows he’s loaded.
Moreover, everyone present at this event had some level of status.
So, some began to flirt with Wu Zhishang.
To everyone’s shock, Wu Zhishang also turned them down without hesitation.
He couldn’t betray his girlfriend.
“Damn! I get it now—they’re a couple.”
“Going after the guy, huh? That explains it.”Thɪs ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
“I was wondering why I got rejected despite my charm, but if it’s a matter of sexual orientation, that makes sense.”
“Who would’ve thought? Such handsome guys, and they’re into each other?”
Lin Ran naturally overheard some of the rumors and rubbed his forehead, thinking that perhaps he should clarify things.
He rejected women because he had a wife, but Wu Zhishang’s rejection didn’t make sense.
His girlfriend wasn’t exactly a prize, and Lin Ran needed to find a way to make Wu Zhishang see the truth.
By his calculations, Wu Zhishang’s family was about to face some trouble, and that needed to be resolved soon.
As Lin Ran was deep in thought, Chen Qingtian approached the two of them, politely raising her glass in greeting.
“I wonder if I might have the honor of getting to know you both.”
Facing Chen Qingtian, Wu Zhishang’s eyes lit up, and Lin Ran quickly noticed this detail.
“My friend really likes you. He’d like to invite you to dance,” Lin Ran said, pushing Wu Zhishang forward.
Wu Zhishang, though tempted, was confused and exchanged a look with Lin Ran.
Wu Zhishang: Did I say that?
Lin Ran: For the sake of our reputation, just take one for the team. Look how beautiful Chen Qingtian is.
Wu Zhishang: But I don’t know how to dance.
Lin Ran: You’ll learn as you go.
Chen Qingtian, seeing the two of them exchanging glances, smiled politely.
“Then I won’t refuse. Mr. Wu, shall we?”
Chen Qingtian had actually wanted to get to know Lin Ran. She wasn’t after him, but she felt a natural pull toward him, finding him quite unique.
But since Lin Ran had pushed Wu Zhishang forward, she didn’t object.
After all, Wu Zhishang’s shy and awkward demeanor was rather endearing, giving her a playful urge to tease him.
Seeing that even Chen Qingtian had been rejected by Lin Ran, the socialites finally gave up hope, though they felt a little smug about it.
They knew they couldn’t compare to Chen Qingtian’s looks, charm, or celebrity status.
But if Lin Ran had rejected her too, then by extension, weren’t they on par with Chen Qingtian?
Thinking this, the socialites felt somewhat comforted.
Of course, Lin Ran’s rejection of Chen Qingtian also effectively deterred other women from approaching him.
Wu Zhishang followed Chen Qingtian to the dance floor, clumsily attempting to dance.
