Watching Wu Zhishang’s awkward movements, stiff posture, and hesitant hands, Chen Qingtian couldn’t help but laugh.
“It’s alright, Mr. Wu. Just follow my lead. Not knowing how to dance isn’t embarrassing. Place your hand here, and follow me. See…”
Wu Zhishang felt his heart racing, scolding himself for being so disloyal to his girlfriend.
But his body, honest as ever, followed Chen Qingtian’s movements, and slowly, it didn’t seem so difficult anymore.
Lin Ran watched with a knowing smile. So, Wu Zhishang, you’re not as virtuous as you claim to be, huh?
But Chen Qingtian, you’re just dreaming. She’s from a wealthy family, the kind that could devour you in an instant.
Then again, he thought, wasn’t he and Luo Yao seen as an equally explosive duo in the eyes of others?
Perhaps anything was possible.
Wu Zhishang, you’ve always wanted to live off someone else’s wealth, haven’t you? This might be your chance. Whether you can become the second me depends on your efforts.
As Lin Ran idly watched the scene unfold, Liu Yuemei arrived with Liu Ruxue in tow.
The moment they appeared, Lin Ran’s expression turned cold.
“Stop them.”
Uncle Fu and his men immediately blocked the two without hesitation. Liu Yuemei began cursing loudly.
“What are you doing? I need to speak with Lin Ran. I have matters to discuss with him!”
Bodyguard: “I’m sorry, but our young master doesn’t wish to speak with you.”
Liu Yuemei: “Your young master? Your young master? Do you think I’m an idiot? I know exactly what kind of person Lin Ran is!”
Liu Ruxue stood beside Liu Yuemei, gazing tenderly at Lin Ran, but her view was soon obstructed.
She moved to the left, and the person moved left. She moved to the right, and the person moved right.
Huh?
Looking up, she saw an old man glaring at her with barely concealed anger. Liu Ruxue frowned, trying to suppress her irritation.

chapters.title: Chapter 46
chapters.content:
She didn’t want to lose her composure in front of Lin Ran, so she kept a gentle smile on her face.
Suddenly, a loud roar startled Liu Ruxue, making her jump.
Liu Yuemei shouted, “Lin Ran, you ungrateful wretch! Have you forgotten your own mother?”
The room instantly fell silent.
Who could be so rude?
Everyone turned to look, their faces filled with shock. Even the dancers on the floor stopped moving, leaving only the music playing softly in the background.
Liu Yuemei’s voice was too loud to ignore.
All eyes were now on Lin Ran.
How could such a handsome and wealthy young man be so unfilial?
Lin Ran wasn’t about to take the insult lying down. He quickly retorted,“You’re just a mistress. What right do you have to call yourself my mother?”
That one sentence was a knockout blow.
You want to shout? Let’s see who ends up looking worse.Follow current novels on
Come on, let’s hurt each other.
Liu Yuemei stood frozen, unable to believe what she had just heard. She struggled to respond but couldn’t, because if anyone dug deeper, it would be revealed that she was, in fact, a mistress in name.
Uncle Fu frowned and said, “Throw them out.”
Several bodyguards immediately stepped forward to drag the two women away. Liu Ruxue was horrified.
“Lin Ran, it’s me, Ruxue! Tell them to let go!”
Liu Yuemei also snapped out of her daze and shouted,
“I’m the wife of the chairman of Suran Group! Is this how your hotel treats its guests? Do you even want my business in the future?”
The staff: ??? Have you ever even spent money here?
At that moment, a stunning woman in her thirties walked over. She was the hotel’s manager.
Seeing her, all the staff greeted her respectfully.
From their demeanor, Liu Yuemei quickly deduced the woman’s position.
“Is this how your hotel treats its customers? I’m Mrs. Lin of Suran Group! Do you believe I can have your hotel torn down?”
Her words sent a chill through the room.
Many people there were familiar with Suran Group. A company worth only two or three billion, threatening to tear down Pangu Hotel? How delusional can you get?
Pangu Hotel’s estimated value exceeded five billion, and its owner was a mysterious figure with extensive connections. You’re going to tear it down?
And looking at Liu Yuemei and Liu Ruxue’s outfits, they looked more like a nouveau riche mother and her innocent daughter.
They were completely out of place in this setting!
Look at the socialites here—each one exudes sexiness and elegance. And the ladies? They’re all refined and dignified.
But you? One’s decked out in gaudy accessories, and the other’s putting on a pitiful act. What kind of soap opera are you trying to stage here?
Probably just a mistress flaunting her wealth and her daughter pretending to be pure.
By now, most people had already concluded that Liu Yuemei was indeed a mistress. Humans are often creatures of instinct.
The manager raised an eyebrow, surprised as she looked at Liu Yuemei, thinking, “Where did this tacky, nouveau riche woman come from?”
“Suran Group, huh? Not bad, not bad!”
Hearing this, Liu Yuemei felt a surge of triumph and barked at the bodyguards holding her,
“Did you hear that? Let me go! Your manager just gave the order!”
The bodyguards: ??? Whose manager?
The hotel manager then continued,
“Your group’s name is nice, but I’ve never heard of it. And these bodyguards aren’t from our hotel, so I have no authority over them.”
She had originally intended to defuse the situation but now decided to change her approach.
Liu Yuemei was trembling with rage. Since marrying Lin Tianba, she had never been humiliated like this before.
“Let me go right now! And as for your hotel, just you wait!”
The hotel manager narrowed her eyes and said coldly, “You all, can’t you see how hard these bodyguards are working? Go and help them!”
The staff had already been annoyed by Liu Yuemei and Liu Ruxue since they arrived. Seeing them cause a scene at the banquet only made things worse.
Now, they all rushed over to assist, with four people lifting Liu Ruxue and Liu Yuemei and literally carrying them out.
No one at the scene sympathized with Liu Yuemei. Many of the women even wore expressions of satisfaction, as if they wanted to step on her a few times.
She’s just a mistress, after all. Mistresses have no shame, which explains why she lacks the grace of a proper lady from a wealthy family.
Many of the high-society ladies present despised mistresses the most.
After Liu Yuemei was thrown out, the staff briefed the manager on what had happened. The manager was stunned and turned to look at Lin Ran.
Lin Ran represented Luo Corporation, and no one dared to offend him—not even the event organizers, who turned a blind eye.
How could such a young man represent Luo Corporation? Could he be from the Luo family?
And why did he look so familiar?
The manager, being sharp, quickly approached Lin Ran.
“Sir, I deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused. As a gesture of goodwill, our hotel would like to offer you a Diamond Membership.”
A Diamond Membership—the highest tier of membership at Pangu Hotel, granting access to the most exclusive services.
The manager’s announcement shocked the room once again.
After all, the incident wasn’t the hotel’s fault, yet they were willing to apologize and offer such a generous compensation. This only deepened everyone’s curiosity about Lin Ran’s identity.
Just the status of a Diamond Member was something most people here could only dream of achieving.
Lin Ran smiled and declined. He wasn’t sure what the manager’s intentions were, and he didn’t want to use Luo Corporation’s name to gain favors.
These kinds of favors would have to be repaid by Luo Yao.
The manager seemed to sense Lin Ran’s hesitation and whispered, “Mr. Lin, Ms. Luo holds shares in our hotel. As her representative, it’s only natural that we treat you with the utmost respect. And this membership isn’t for Luo Corporation—it’s my personal apology to you. You don’t need to feel any pressure.”
Hearing this, Lin Ran finally understood. So, the hotel had some connection to his wife. In that case, he could accept the membership as a gesture of respect for Luo Yao.
After all, Luo Yao loved giving him gifts, and she’d probably be thrilled to hear about this.
“Thank you, then,” Lin Ran said.
The manager replied, “You’re welcome, sir. May I have your full name for the registration?”
Lin Ran answered without hesitation, “I’m Lin Ran.”
The manager froze in place.
“You… you’re Lin Ran?”
She frantically pulled out her phone to check something, and then—
Oh my God.
Seeing the manager stammering, Lin Ran was puzzled.
The next moment, the manager bowed deeply and exclaimed,
“Good evening, Boss!”
Her words sent everyone’s jaws dropping to the floor.
Lin Ran… was the owner of Pangu Hotel?
Even Lin Ran himself was stunned.
“What did you just call me?”

chapters.title: Chapter 47
chapters.content:
The manager exclaimed, "Boss! You are my boss. Although you've never been here before, we have your information in our system. No wonder you looked so familiar when I first saw you. You're our benefactor! I should be punished for not recognizing you at first glance."
Lin Ran looked at Uncle Fu in confusion, and Uncle Fu nodded.
It was clear now—Lin Ran was indeed the owner of this hotel.
Good heavens, the only seven-star hotel in the entire capital city was under his name?
Luo Yao, how much more wealth have you prepared for me?
Lin Ran's expression was awkward, but deep down, he was thrilled.Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Wu Zhishang and Chen Qingtian, who had been arm in arm, were now staring at Lin Ran in stunned silence.
The women who had given up on approaching Lin Ran suddenly reignited their hopes.
A guy this handsome, wealthy, and influential—how could ordinary women possibly be worthy of him?
How could I retreat just because he rejected me once?No, I must rise to the challenge. Even if he likes men, I'll straighten him out.
Feeling the odd gazes around him, Lin Ran awkwardly smiled.
"Ah? Actually, I didn’t know either. This hotel was probably a gift from my wife. Um… you all can go back to work now."
What?
This hotel was a gift from his wife?
No way, absolutely no way.
This must be his way of deflecting us, but he’s mistaken if he thinks this will work.
The manager, noticing the awkward silence, quickly instructed the staff to resume their duties, and gradually, the atmosphere in the room began to warm up again.
Lin Ran asked Uncle Fu to escort the necklace back to the manor first while he waited for Wu Zhishang.
Uncle Fu, knowing there were hidden bodyguards outside and that potential threats had already been dealt with, agreed.
Chen Qingtian gave Wu Zhishang a meaningful look. "Your friend is truly extraordinary."
The Pangu Hotel, the only seven-star hotel in the capital, was estimated to be worth 5 billion. Its previous owner had always been a mystery, but today, the truth was revealed.
Wu Zhishang remained silent, unsure of what to say. He had just found out too.
And judging by Lin Ran's reaction, even Lin Ran himself hadn’t known he was the owner of this hotel.
What kind of goddess is Lin Ran’s wife?
Although the atmosphere had returned to normal, with people chatting and dancing, many still glanced frequently at Lin Ran.
Wu Zhishang knew it was time to leave. With Uncle Fu gone, the women were closing in on Lin Ran again.
Although Lin Ran was doing his best to dodge and reject them, it was clearly becoming difficult. As a brother, he couldn’t let Lin Ran face this alone.
He had to clear away these temptresses for the sake of Lin Ran’s wife. If even one of them succeeded, not only would Lin Ran feel guilty, but Wu Zhishang himself would feel Lin Ran had wronged his wife.
However, looking at Chen Qingtian in front of him, he felt a bit reluctant to leave.
While he couldn’t betray his girlfriend, making a new friend wasn’t a crime, right?
Chen Qingtian, noticing Wu Zhishang’s shy demeanor, found it amusing. Such a bashful guy was a rare sight. She smiled warmly.
"Let’s exchange contacts."
Wu Zhishang was taken aback. He had only wanted an autographed photo, but Chen Qingtian had taken the initiative to add him as a friend.
Excited, he nodded and pulled out his phone, displaying a QR code. "You can scan me."
Chen Qingtian fell silent when she saw Wu Zhishang’s payment QR code but still scanned it with her phone.
"How much?" she asked.
"How much for what?" Wu Zhishang replied, confused.
"How much to add you as a friend?"
Wu Zhishang glanced at his phone screen and instantly felt embarrassed. He quickly refreshed the QR code.
"Refreshing the payment QR code for a discount?" Chen Qingtian teased.
Wu Zhishang felt like he could dig a three-bedroom apartment with his toes out of sheer embarrassment. He quickly pulled up the correct QR code for adding friends.
The two "happily" exchanged contacts, and Chen Qingtian smiled like a spring breeze.
"Goodbye!"
"Goodbye!"
As soon as Wu Zhishang returned, Lin Ran called out to him.
"Finally, you’re back. Let’s go. We have classes tomorrow."
Wu Zhishang: ??? You actually care about classes?
You showed up on the first day of the semester and then disappeared. The only time you came back was to visit the principal’s office. And now you’re talking about attending classes?
Seeing the women starting to make moves again, Wu Zhishang quickly agreed. "Yes, yes, let’s go. We have classes tomorrow!"
The two of them fled like the wind.
Lin Ran hated being stared at like a zoo animal. If it weren’t for Wu Zhishang still being inside, he would have left long ago.
As soon as they left, the room erupted in murmurs.
"Who would’ve thought? The owner of the Pangu Hotel is that young man?"
"He seems to still be a student. What kind of background does he have?"
"Didn’t you hear him? His wife gave it to him. Maybe he’s being kept. He might even be a side piece."
"You’re the side piece. Your whole family are side pieces."
"F*ck! Are you crazy?"
"Even if I’m sick, I wouldn’t take your medicine. Your family’s medicine is all sour anyway."
...
Half an hour earlier, Liu Ritian and Lin Jian, starving, had gone to eat a bowl of beef noodles.
Liu Ritian was shocked. He couldn’t believe his own nephew had only treated him to a bowl of beef noodles.
Lin Jian was also helpless. The Lin family was in a crisis, and he had to share their hardships.
If he took his uncle out for a lavish meal now, how would Lin Tianba view him?
When they returned to the hotel entrance, they saw Liu Yuemei and another person being thrown out. Both Liu Ritian and Lin Jian were stunned.
After asking around, they learned the whole story. Liu Yuemei couldn’t hide it because Liu Ruxue also knew.
Liu Ritian exclaimed, "Lin Ran actually threw you out? Where did he get the guts? And where did he get 300 million to buy that necklace? Did Lin Tianba give it to him? Sister, what have I and our parents always taught you? How could you let Lin Tianba give Lin Ran money?"
Liu Yuemei sighed. There was no choice but to tell the truth.
Liu Ritian’s pupils shook. "What? He… he swindled 300 million from you?"
Lin Jian added, "Not just that. Lin Ran is also planning to sell his shares. Those shares should have belonged to the Lin family. The Lin family is really in a tough spot now."
Liu Ritian was in disbelief. He had no idea Lin Ran held so many shares.
He glanced at Liu Yuemei, then at Lin Jian, and finally locked eyes with his daughter, Liu Ruxue.
A lightbulb went off in Liu Ritian’s head. If Lin Ran really sold his shares, marrying Ruxue to him might not be a bad idea.
Of course, the condition would be that Lin Ran had to hand over all the money as a bride price. Otherwise, he wouldn’t agree.
But for appearances' sake, Liu Ritian spent a long time scolding Lin Ran alongside Liu Yuemei. It wasn’t until a few security guards came out and shooed them away that they finally left.
Lin Jian seized the opportunity to secretly slip a key to Liu Ruxue, whispering something to her.
Liu Ruxue’s eyes widened in shock as she stared at Lin Jian.

chapters.title: Chapter 48
chapters.content:
Lin Jian nodded at her, and Liu Ruxue took a deep breath.
"Alright! I'll go."
Then, Liu Yuemei and the other two got into the car and left, leaving Liu Ruxue alone. After some thought, Liu Ruxue sneaked back to the hotel entrance.
"What is Ruxue up to?" Liu Ritian wondered.
Lin Jian: "I just saw her best friend and told her about it. She said she wanted to go back to school with her friend."
Liu Ritian snorted coldly: "Hmph! She’d rather stay at school every day than come home. She’s grown up and has her own ideas now."
But he didn’t say much more, thinking he’d talk to Liu Ruxue about Lin Ran’s situation next time.
Driving the car, the three of them headed to the hospital.
Lin Tianba was just sick, not dead.
At this moment, their concern would surely move Lin Tianba, so they decided to stay by his side.Lin Ran and Wu Zhishang walked out of the hotel, with Wu Zhishang still in a daze.
"Brother Lin, are you really the owner of this hotel?"
Lin Ran nodded: "Seems like it. My wife probably gifted it to me, but I just found out."
Wu Zhishang felt like his entire worldview was under attack.
"Damn, bro, look at me. Do I have what it takes to be a kept man?"
Lin Ran glanced at Wu Zhishang: "What about your girlfriend?"
Wu Zhishang looked embarrassed: "Bro, I’m just joking. I wouldn’t actually do it."
"But your wife is way too good to you. I overheard people saying this hotel is worth at least five billion. What does your wife even do?"
"She’s a professional at keeping me."
"Damn! Just kill me now! This is too much to handle."
Lin Ran: "Seriously, bro, have you ever thought about being a kept man?"
Wu Zhishang: "I can’t betray my girlfriend."
Lin Ran sighed inwardly. Like him, Wu Zhishang was also blind.
As they reached the parking lot, both of them were stunned.
The valet who had been helping Lin Ran earlier was crouched on the ground, crying his eyes out, while a few staff members seemed to be helping him look for something.
"What’s wrong?"
The valet quickly looked up at the sound of Lin Ran’s voice, his eyes filled with fear and avoidance when he saw Lin Ran.
"Sir, I’m so sorry! I lost your car key! Waaah!"
The valet cried loudly, like a heartbroken puppy.
Lin Ran’s face darkened. He quickly said,
"If it’s lost, it’s lost. Stop crying in front of me like I’ve bullied you."
The valet cried even louder. Lin Ran sighed but didn’t blame him. After all, it wasn’t intentional.
Losing a car key wasn’t a big deal. It wasn’t like the car had been smashed. No harm done.
Besides, from a certain perspective, the valet was his employee. Seeing him cry so pitifully, as the boss, Lin Ran felt he should be magnanimous.
"Stop crying. It’s fine, I’m not blaming you. Just be more careful next time."
As he spoke, he glanced at his Ferrari.
Huh?
He looked again. There seemed to be something inside.
Upon closer inspection, there was a shadowy figure in the car.
"Bro, do you see a ghost in the car?"
Wu Zhishang also looked over in confusion: "It looks like... a person?"Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Lin Ran, incredulous, walked over to the car, opened the door with a puzzled expression, and saw an almost naked woman inside, gazing at him with longing.
Ugh!
Liu Ruxue.
Without hesitation, Lin Ran slammed the door shut with a loud "bang" and shouted,
"What’s wrong with your hotel? Why is there a naked woman in my car? Is this some kind of test? What man wouldn’t pass a test like this?"
Lin Ran’s words echoed through the hotel entrance, and everyone who had been searching for the key turned to look.
The valet was also startled and hurried over to open the passenger door.
At a glance, he saw Liu Ruxue. He had no time to admire her body, instead angrily saying,
"How did you get in here? Did you steal my car key?"
Liu Ruxue was dumbfounded. She never expected that even after appearing like this in the car, Lin Ran would ignore her.
Before doing this, she had mentally prepared herself, imagining a romantic encounter with Lin Ran in the car.
But who would have thought Lin Ran would just "expose" her like this?
Not only did she fail to seduce Lin Ran, but she also ended up humiliating herself.
Liu Ruxue immediately covered her face, the car key still dangling from her hand.
The valet snatched the key and angrily said,
"You thief, you almost cost me my job!"
He handed the key to Lin Ran and then tried to pull Liu Ruxue out of the car.
"Get out of here, you thief! Do you know how much trouble you’ve caused me?"
Lin Ran held the key, deep in thought.
Can I even use this hand now?
Did Liu Ruxue do something weird with the key?
If it’s Liu Ruxue, she might actually do something like that.
As the valet tried to pull Liu Ruxue out, she clung to the car door: "Don’t lie! I found it! Brother Lin Ran, it’s me! It’s Ruxue!"
Hearing Liu Ruxue’s voice, Wu Zhishang was also shocked. He looked at Lin Ran and said, "Bro, you’ve got to stay strong!"
Lin Ran shot Wu Zhishang a sidelong glance, noticing that Wu Zhishang was becoming more and more mischievous.
The valet yanked Liu Ruxue out of the car and slapped her across the face, shouting hysterically, "You evil woman! Why did you steal my car key?"
Liu Ruxue covered her face, looking at the valet in disbelief.
"You actually hit a woman?"
"I’m hitting you because you’re a thief!"
The valet slapped her again, this time turning her head ninety degrees, directly facing Lin Ran.
Seeing Lin Ran, Liu Ruxue’s eyes welled up with tears: "Brother Lin Ran, I just missed you so much. Didn’t you buy ‘Eternal Love’ for me today? I was so touched, so I waited for you in the car."
The valet was stunned. He glanced at Liu Ruxue, who was only wearing lingerie, then at Lin Ran, and took a sharp breath: "Did I mess up again?"
Lin Ran facepalmed, thinking to himself, "This world has gone completely insane."
Liu Ruxue slowly walked toward Lin Ran, her expression filled with grievance.
She was wearing thin, translucent lingerie, her body barely concealed.
Lin Ran sidestepped to avoid her, completely disregarding her state of undress.
He turned to the valet and said, "Those two slaps were well-deserved. Go find your manager and tell them to give you a bonus."
Then he pointed to himself: "Tell them Lin Ran said so."
The valet nodded dumbly, then suddenly became excited.
Lin Ran’s status clearly wasn’t ordinary, and it made sense that he knew the manager. Not only did he not get punished for losing the key, but he might even get a bonus just for slapping this woman twice.
This woman clearly seemed like the type who would do anything to seduce a man.

chapters.title: Chapter 49
chapters.content:
Seeing that the young master was wealthy, she actually stole the keys, stripped naked, and lay down in his car.
"Alright, young master, should I beat her up for you? If she calls the police, I’ll take the fall and continue beating her after I get out."
Lin Ran looked at the valet in surprise, thinking to himself that this guy had quite the imagination.
"Ahem... not today. You can go back now."
"Got it!" The valet left happily with a few colleagues.
The young master had said not today, but he hadn’t said anything about tomorrow, the day after, or the day after that.
Liu Ruxue covered her face and said, "Brother Lin Ran, if beating me up will make you feel better, then go ahead!"
"Don’t you like me? Today, I’ll give myself to you."
"You bought 'Eternal Love' for me, and I’m truly touched."
Lin Ran felt a chill run down his spine, sensing that something bad was about to happen.He leaned closer to Liu Ruxue, his eyes filled with killing intent, and whispered, "Get lost!"
With that, he pushed Liu Ruxue away, his heart aching as he looked at his beloved car.
When he saw the pile of discarded clothes on the passenger seat, he felt a wave of disgust.
Could he even drive this car anymore?
After some thought, he tossed the car keys to Wu Zhishang.
"It’s dirty. It’s yours now."
Wu Zhishang took the keys, stunned, completely forgetting the situation he was in.
"Thank you! Thank you... foster father."
Meanwhile, unbeknownst to Lin Ran, a bodyguard in the shadows was frowning as he watched the scene unfold.
The bodyguard had followed Lin Ran downstairs from the hotel and had just arrived at the parking lot when he heard Liu Ruxue’s words: "Don’t you like me? Today, I’ll give myself to you," and "You bought 'Eternal Love' for me, and I’m truly touched."
Seeing Liu Ruxue now, wearing nothing but her underwear, he felt a chill in his heart.
This young master was in for a rough time.
After some consideration, the bodyguard decided to report everything truthfully to Luo Yao.
There was no other choice. When it came to Lin Ran’s affairs, he couldn’t afford to be careless or lie, as he valued his life too much.
This was part of his job—not only to protect Lin Ran but also to report on his whereabouts.
Upon receiving the bodyguard’s call, Luo Yao naturally went into a frenzy and rushed back from the old mansion overnight.
Liu Ruxue, half-naked and shivering under Lin Ran’s icy, murderous gaze, realized she couldn’t continue humiliating herself in her current state.
She now understood that the necklace Lin Ran had bought wasn’t for her, and that he had no desire to take advantage of her naked body.
"Wuwuwu! Brother Lin Ran, I hate you!" she cried, grabbing the clothes from the passenger seat and running off.
She couldn’t bear to stay there any longer.
All her efforts had only earned her a "Get lost" from Lin Ran. It was all so laughable, so brutally real.
She had fallen for Lin Ran, but he no longer cared for her.
Wu Zhishang watched Liu Ruxue run off, unsure whether to laugh or cry.
"Brother Lin, I just realized how shameless Liu Ruxue is."
Lin Ran raised an eyebrow. "You’ll encounter even more shameless people as time goes on."
Wu Zhishang nodded in agreement. After all, the longer you live, the more bizarre things you’ll see.
"I thought there’d be food at tonight’s banquet. I didn’t eat dinner before coming, but it turned out to be just wine and pastries, not even a proper table."
"Don’t these rich people get tired of living like this?"
Lin Ran looked at Wu Zhishang in surprise. "Hey, you know what? You’re absolutely right. I had to stuff myself with several pieces of cake just to feel full, and now I’m burping up acid."
The two of them shared a laugh.
"The lives of the rich are truly simple and unpretentious."
"Agreed."
Lin Ran turned and walked back toward the hotel. Wu Zhishang asked, puzzled, "What are you doing? Aren’t you leaving?"
Lin Ran waved his hand.
"No, Liu Ruxue was in there. Just thinking about it makes me uncomfortable. But don’t you worry about it, buddy."
Wu Zhishang, holding the car keys, was deeply moved. How could he possibly complain?
In fact, he was starting to like Liu Ruxue a little.
Maybe you should sneak into Lin Ran’s garage next time?
The two parted ways. Lin Ran, unwilling to ride in the Ferrari again, returned to the hotel and had them prepare another car to take him home.
The hotel manager offered to drive him personally, but Lin Ran declined.
Even though you look like you’re in your thirties, you’re still a woman.
He was afraid Luo Yao might misunderstand, though it was probably too late for that.
"Could you prepare the parking lot surveillance footage and send it to me? If you want to send me off, just have that valet do it."
The manager quickly arranged everything, and soon the same teary-eyed valet arrived driving a commercial Mercedes. Lin Ran didn’t mind.
In the car.
"Bro! Next time I see that woman, I’ll slap her silly for you."
Lin Ran: "Make sure both sides of her face get equal treatment. If you get arrested, just call me. I’ll bail you out."
"Got it, bro!"
As they entered the estate, the valet was completely awestruck. What kind of wealthy family lived in a place like this?
He had driven a few rich people home before—some lived in townhouses, others in villas.
But a private estate? He hadn’t even heard of such a thing, let alone seen one. It was beyond extravagant.
"Bro! This place is huge. If I weren’t driving, I’d probably get lost."
Lin Ran: "You better not get lost."
"Why?"
"Because there are crocodiles here."
Valet: ???
"And tigers."
Valet: ???
"And snow leopards."
Valet: "Bro, I’ll... I’ll try my best not to get lost."
Lin Ran chuckled. "Relax, I’m just messing with you. Those animals are all locked up, with people watching over them. They won’t get out."
Valet: "Bro, just hypothetically, what if one of them did escape?"
Lin Ran: "I’d give you a grand send-off."
Following Lin Ran’s directions, the car drove a little further into the estate before reaching the central villa. The valet was buzzing with excitement.
After getting out of the car, the valet left, and Lin Ran walked up to the villa entrance, about to go inside.
"Meow!"
"Meow!"
"Meow!"
The cat’s cries were eerie, as if warning Lin Ran not to enter.
Lin Ran turned his head and saw the same black cat that had appeared late at night when he was stargazing with Luo Yao in the rooftop garden.
He had noticed something strange about it back then, and now he was certain—this cat’s eyes were unusually expressive.
Its eyes seemed to speak.
Just as Lin Ran reached out to pet it, the black cat took a step back. Lin Ran moved forward, and it retreated again.
"Meow!"
"Are you hungry?"
The black cat gave him a look that clearly said, *You idiot.*
"Meow!"
It then turned and vanished into the night.
Lin Ran stood there, dumbfounded.
That cat had just insulted him, but he had no proof.
Shaking his head, Lin Ran chuckled at his own thoughts and slowly walked into the villa.
Inside, Uncle Fu, the butler, greeted him.
"Young Master Lin, please rest in your bedroom."

chapters.title: Chapter 50
chapters.content:
Lin Ran: "Let's eat something before going in. I only had a few pieces of cake at the banquet tonight."
Uncle Fu arranged for someone to prepare a late-night snack. Lin Ran noticed that Uncle Fu's expression seemed a bit off, but he didn't think much of it.
Lin Ran didn't notice that as soon as he entered, Uncle Fu quietly locked the villa door from the outside.
After having some late-night snacks, Lin Ran finally felt a bit more comfortable, and the acid in his stomach subsided.
Feeling content, he walked back to his bedroom, bringing along the necklace titled "Eternal Love."
He took a shower, went to bed, and thought about his wife.
Lying in bed, Lin Ran sent a message.
[Miss you.]
After waiting for a long time without a reply, Lin Ran sent another message.
[Goodnight.]Still, there was no reply. Lin Ran couldn't help but let his thoughts run wild, wondering if Luo Yao had fallen asleep or if she was still working.
Tossing and turning, he couldn't sleep.
He got up and took out the necklace, admiring it from every angle, imagining how beautiful Luo Yao would look wearing it.
He wondered if he was becoming a bit too love-struck.
"Meow!"
Just as Lin Ran was fantasizing about Luo Yao wearing the necklace, a faint meow came from outside.
Lin Ran got up and went to the window, where he saw a black cat sitting on the windowsill, staring at him.
The cat's blue eyes startled Lin Ran for a moment, but he quickly composed himself and crouched by the window, staring back at the cat through the glass.
"Little guy, are you hungry?"
"Meow!"
Damn, Lin Ran was sure now—this cat was definitely trouble.
Its eyes seemed to be cursing at him.
"Meow!"
"What the hell!"
"Meow!"
"If you don't leave, you won't be a cat anymore!"
"Meow!"
With one last meow, the black cat left.
Lin Ran had no idea why there was a cat or why it kept appearing today.
He decided to ask Luo Yao about it when he got the chance—it must be a cat from the estate.
Back in bed, he checked his phone again, but Luo Yao still hadn't replied.
So, Lin Ran started trying to fall asleep and eventually drifted off.
Outside the bedroom door, the butler sighed and locked the door from the outside.
The young lady had instructed him to lock Lin Ran in and wait for her return.
From her tone, she seemed furious—absolutely livid.
Her voice had carried a murderous edge, and the butler had no idea what Lin Ran had done wrong this time.
Could it have been something that happened while he was escorting the necklace back?
Such a small mistake—would the young lady let it slide?
Lin Ran, why can't you just behave and listen to the young lady?
Isn't it nice being her little songbird?
When you mess up, it's often us old folks who have to deal with the consequences!ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Why make life hard for the elderly?
Late at night, as Lin Ran slept, he kept hearing occasional meows, which annoyed him to no end.
After what felt like an eternity, Lin Ran finally couldn't take it anymore.
He got up, ready to teach the cat a lesson, but as soon as he reached the window, he heard a pitiful meow, and the black cat ran off again.
At that moment, the bedroom door was kicked open with a loud "BANG!"
Lin Ran was startled and turned to see Luo Yao's figure illuminated by the dim light outside the door, her presence chilling.
"Luo Yao? Why are you back so late?"
Luo Yao stepped closer, and as Lin Ran's vision adjusted, he noticed something in her eyes—despair?
Lin Ran felt a chill run down his spine.
That look?
Oh no.
"Yao Yao, listen to me..."
Before Lin Ran could finish, Luo Yao lunged at him, a cold blade in her hand aimed straight at his heart. Her figure loomed larger in his vision.
"Thud!"
Just as the dagger was about to pierce his heart, Luo Yao's hand faltered, and the blade veered off course, sinking into Lin Ran's shoulder instead.
"Ah..."
Lin Ran cried out in pain.
That was close—he almost died.
He wasn't afraid of death, but he wanted to settle his grudges before dying.
He wasn't afraid of Luo Yao, but he was afraid that no one would love her after he was gone.
He was even more afraid that if he died and Luo Yao later realized it was all a misunderstanding, she would be devastated and might follow him in death.
So, in summary: Lin Ran was afraid of dying.
"Yao Yao... you."
Luo Yao roared, "Why did you lie to me? Why can't you just stay by my side and behave?"
Luo Yao burst into tears, her sobs uncontrollable, her entire being consumed by hysteria.
She now understood that Lin Ran's recent obedience had all been an act—he had been deceiving her all along.
She had tried to trust him, so why did he have to betray her?
The feeling of being misled and then betrayed was suffocating.
If not for a lingering sense of resolve, Luo Yao would have killed Lin Ran right then and there, but in the end, she couldn't bring herself to do it.
She hated her own weakness in that moment, and she hated Lin Ran for his deceit.
"Why did you lie to me? Why? Why?"
If she couldn't bring herself to kill him, then she would trap him forever in the gilded cage she had woven for him.
"Ah Ran, you've lost your freedom."
Lin Ran, despite the excruciating pain and difficulty breathing, forced a smile. He didn't want Luo Yao to carry any guilt.
"Yao Yao... I've... always... been good."
Luo Yao: "You still dare to lie to me..."
Suddenly, Luo Yao's words trailed off as she saw Lin Ran raise a necklace in his hand.
"This... is for you... You're tired, rest... rest for a bit."
Luo Yao stood frozen, taking two steps back.
She saw the beautiful sapphire at the center of the necklace and slowly reached out to take it.
The necklace was stained with Lin Ran's blood, but the warmth of the sapphire reminded her that he must have been holding it tightly in his hand.
She immediately recognized it as the "Eternal Love" necklace she had seen in a fashion magazine.
She had once dreamed of the day Lin Ran would give her such a necklace.
But wasn't this necklace meant for Liu Ruxue?
Could it be...?
Luo Yao thought of a possibility. If that were the case...
Then what about her?
Lin Ran held up his phone to Luo Yao.
"This is... the truth... you wanted."
After saying this, Lin Ran collapsed to the floor, breathing heavily.
He knew Luo Yao must have misunderstood. Before leaving, he had specifically asked the hotel for the surveillance footage from the entrance.
That was close—he would have to be more careful in the future to avoid such misunderstandings. They could really cost him his life.
Luo Yao took the phone and watched the edited clips of the surveillance footage.
She saw Lin Jian stealing the valet's keys, Liu Ruxue getting into the car on her own, and Lin Ran's actions.
She also understood why the bodyguard had reported the incident inaccurately.
So, it really was all just a coincidence?
Luo Yao felt her heart ache. She clutched her chest, feeling as if even breathing was wrong.
She had made another mistake.
Her fingers gently touched Lin Ran's wound.
"Does it hurt?"
Lin Ran nodded.
"It hurts, but seeing you like this hurts my heart even more."

chapters.title: Chapter 51
chapters.content:
Luo Yao collapsed on the ground, shaking her head uncontrollably.
"I'm sorry! I made a mistake again. Will you not like Yao Yao anymore?"
Lin Ran regained some strength and slowly reached out his hand, gently wiping away Luo Yao's tears.
"Don't cry. I don't like a tear-streaked Yao Yao. Remember the question you asked me last time after you got me drunk?"
"No matter what you do to me, I won't blame you. That promise will always stand."
Luo Yao held back the tears that kept flowing. She wasn't someone who cried easily, but all her tears were because of Lin Ran.
"I was wrong, I was wrong. Ah Ran, please don't leave me. I beg you."
Lin Ran's wound hurt, but his heart hurt even more. What kind of love was this, so insecure, so humble and extreme? But on second thought, what had Luo Yao really done wrong?
"You didn't do anything wrong. You're just the guardian of our love. Your love is passionate and dangerous, but I hope you never stop."
"Because that's what I want too."Luo Yao felt an inexplicable throbbing in her chest, as if someone were punching her there repeatedly.
"I'll call a doctor for you."
Lin Ran, clutching 'Eternal Love,' said, "Right now, I just want to put it on you myself."
Luo Yao hated herself for losing her temper without understanding the situation, not only hurting herself but also hurting Lin Ran.
Yet Lin Ran didn't hold a grudge against her and was still so good to her.
Luo Yao's tears fell once again, betraying her resolve.
Lin Ran gently, slowly, placed 'Eternal Love' around Luo Yao's neck and forced a faint smile.
"It's beautiful, Miss Luo Yao. Will you take care of me for the rest of my life?"
Luo Yao finally smiled through her tears, which scattered along her eyelashes.
"I will."
Lin Ran laughed, but as he laughed, he fainted.
Luo Yao gently helped Lin Ran onto the bed and called the estate's private doctor.
Soon, the old butler looked at Lin Ran on the bed, sighing repeatedly but not daring to say anything.
Luo Yao: "I misunderstood Ah Ran. I wronged him."
The old butler already knew the whole story and felt sorrowful for his own mistake.
"Miss, it's all my fault. I should have explained things to you more clearly from the start."
Of course, it was his fault. If he hadn't left early, if he had asked Luo Yao the reason for her return as soon as she came back, perhaps none of these misunderstandings would have happened. So he blamed himself deeply.
But the bodyguard kneeling on the floor felt even more guilty, even terrified.
He was the key link in this misunderstanding, having given Luo Yao the wrong information. He was waiting for Luo Yao's punishment.
Seeing Lin Ran's pained expression even in his unconscious state, Luo Yao felt her heart grow heavier, more uncontrollable.
These people had made mistakes, but the one most at fault was herself.
Her gaze began to scatter, then focused again, gradually turning crimson.
"Leave." Luo Yao silently walked out of the bedroom and headed toward the secret room.
The bodyguard got up and followed, unlocking the door to the secret room, his hands trembling.
With a loud "bang," Luo Yao kicked open the door. Inside, in the center of the room, was a transparent glass cage where a man lay, barely alive.
The man had no nose, one eye was missing, and the other was infected but not yet dead. Rats scurried around inside.
The man sensed someone's arrival and slightly opened his mouth, but no sound came out.
Luo Yao walked to a nearby shelf and took out a torture device, one designed to force open a person's mouth.
With a glance, she signaled the bodyguard, who hesitated for a moment before taking the device, putting on a mask and gloves, and opening the cage door.
At that moment, the bodyguard felt immensely relieved that there was still a tool here for Luo Yao to vent her anger on.
Once inside, he fitted the device onto the man and then grabbed a rat, stuffing it into the man's mouth.
Then a second, a third...
"Uh... uh..."
The man struggled, twisted, but it was futile. Tears slowly streamed from the corners of his eyes.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Luo Yao simply watched in silence, saying nothing.
It seemed that only by tormenting the man before her could she release a fraction of her psychological pressure.
After a while, Luo Yao slowly walked to the side and took out a glass jar, placing something inside.
Inside were two eyeballs.
She poured some liquid into the jar to prevent the eyeballs from rotting.
She placed the jar in clear view of the man being tortured, waiting until he had eaten his fill.
"The old man's eyes. This is the price for spying on Ah Ran."
The man in the cage twitched slightly, no longer sure how many rats he had eaten. He no longer had the strength to speak.
But hearing Luo Yao's words, his remaining pupil dilated slightly in disbelief.
With another glance from Luo Yao, the bodyguard immediately taped the man's mouth shut without a word.
All that remained was a slow, painful death.
Luo Yao dismissed the bodyguard and sat alone in silence, then took out a dagger and stabbed it toward her own shoulder.
Just as the dagger was about to pierce through, Luo Yao suddenly stopped.
"Ah Ran said I shouldn't hurt myself. He would be heartbroken."
Her hand touched the necklace around her neck, still stained with Lin Ran's dried blood. After a long while, she finally walked out of the secret room.
When she returned to the bedroom, Lin Ran's shoulder wound had been bandaged, but he was still unconscious.
Luo Yao's cold gaze fell on the doctor, who hadn't left yet. The doctor shivered and quickly explained.
"Mr. Lin is only temporarily unconscious due to blood loss and pain. There's nothing seriously wrong with his body. He'll wake up soon."
Luo Yao's eyes were blank.
Ah Ran... is it painful?
"Get out!"
Everyone scrambled out of the bedroom. Luo Yao slowly grasped Lin Ran's hand.
"Ah Ran, are you in pain?"
Lin Ran didn't answer.
"Ah Ran, look at me, please. Do you still like Yao Yao?"
Lin Ran still didn't answer.
"Ah Ran, should I let you go?"
"Uh... no! Don't!"
Luo Yao was startled, wondering if she had imagined it. She looked down and saw Lin Ran slowly opening his eyes.
"If you don't want me, no one else will."
For the first time, Luo Yao understood what excitement felt like as she saw Lin Ran's familiar smile return.
She nodded heavily. "Of course. I was lying earlier. I would never let you go. You belong only to me."
Lin Ran stretched out his hand, and Luo Yao, puzzled, obediently rested her chin on his palm.
Lin Ran: "You look like a little kitten right now."
Luo Yao: "Then I'll be your kitten. As long as you don't leave me, I'll be anything you want."
A kitten?
Lin Ran thought of that foul-mouthed cat.
The next time he saw it, he would definitely catch it and give it a good petting.
"It's almost dawn. You should sleep too, or you won't have energy during the day."
Luo Yao shook her head. "I'm not going to work. I'll stay with you."

chapters.title: Chapter 52
chapters.content:
Although Lin Ran was injured, it didn't stop him from sharing a bed with Luo Yao.
Luo Yao climbed onto the bed, lying on the sheets stained with Lin Ran's blood. The two of them resembled lovers bound together in death, their fates intertwined.
By dawn, Lin Ran experienced the luxury of being waited on hand and foot.
Luo Yao personally helped Lin Ran freshen up.
Returning to the bedroom, Lin Ran saw the kneeling bodyguard and Uncle Fu, who stood with his head bowed in silence.
Lin Ran immediately understood the situation and quickly spoke up.
"Uncle Fu, I'm hungry. Could you prepare something to eat?"
"And to this gentleman here, thank you for your hard work protecting me recently."
Lin Ran knew Luo Yao would have someone monitoring him, and today he finally met the person behind the surveillance.
Uncle Fu promptly replied, "Of course, I'll have someone prepare it right away."Lin Ran's seemingly casual remark was actually a way to give Uncle Fu an out, and the shrewd old man understood it perfectly.
The bodyguard took a deep breath and kowtowed to Lin Ran. Lin Ran hesitated, wanting to help him up but stopping himself.
"Get up! This is modern China; we don't follow feudal hierarchies. What's your name?"
The bodyguard stood up and said, "My name is Wang Bao. I'm sorry, Young Master Lin. It was my mistake in reporting that led to your injury."
Lin Ran smiled and said, "Good. From now on, you'll stay by my side openly, not in the shadows. That way, such mistakes won't happen again."
Wang Bao looked up, shocked. "I can still stay by your side?"
After all, the most lucrative job in the entire security system was monitoring Lin Ran.
Lin Ran nodded. "Of course. Right, Yao Yao?"
Wang Bao glanced at Luo Yao, who was inwardly delighted. Lin Ran's words made it clear she could monitor him openly in real-time.
"Since A-Ran doesn't want to punish you, I'll agree. But remember, protect A-Ran well. If he loses even a single hair, I'll hold you accountable."
Wang Bao nodded solemnly. "Don't worry, Miss. If Young Master Lin loses even a strand of hair, I'll take my own life as atonement."
He then bowed deeply to Lin Ran again. "Young Master Lin, I'm not good with words, but I can never repay your kindness. Just watch my actions from now on."
After the bodyguard left, Lin Ran asked Luo Yao, "You're not upset with how I handled that, are you?"
Luo Yao replied, "Of course not. You're A-Ran. You have the final say in household matters. Whatever you decide is right."
Lin Ran said, "Alright then. But I haven't punished you yet!"
Luo Yao suddenly felt a pang of guilt. "I'm sorry!"
Lin Ran quickly interrupted, "No, no, I'm not blaming you. I just want to punish you. That's not too much, is it?"
Luo Yao looked up at him with her big, watery eyes. "Okay, A-Ran. Punish me then."
Lin Ran said, "Fine. Wait until I recover. I won't let you off, you little temptress."
Injured and with a perfectly valid excuse, Lin Ran didn't have to go to school or work.
Luo Yao also skipped work, and her assistant team was "invited" to work at the estate.
Luo Yao stayed in the bedroom with Lin Ran. At mealtime, she fed him bite by bite. When it was time for him to use the restroom, she helped him. And during work hours, she told everyone to scram.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Liu Meng couldn't help but shake her head and sigh.
Lin Ran was undoubtedly a man who could bring ruin to kingdoms and cities.
She tried to handle most of Luo Yao's work, but there was one crucial document that only Luo Yao could deal with.
When she entered the bedroom again, she saw her usually icy boss feeding Lin Ran spoonful by spoonful.
Liu Meng was utterly dumbfounded.
Lin Ran said, "Assistant Liu has work for you. Handle it first. Don't get too carried away."
Luo Yao replied, "You are my drive and my distraction."
But since Lin Ran had spoken, Luo Yao went ahead and dealt with the document, leaving Liu Meng's worldview in shambles.
Alright, so this is how they're playing it?
Would it be more convenient to just report important matters directly to Lin Ran in the future?
Liu Meng was startled by her own thoughts, but upon further reflection, she realized it wasn't feasible.
If she got too close to Lin Ran, she might as well be signing her own death warrant.
Still, she could always turn to Lin Ran for help in critical moments.
Three days passed like this, with the assistant team stuck at the estate the entire time.
Now, the entire team was chanting, "The king has abandoned his court."
Today, Luo Yao finally returned to the company with her assistant team, only to be met with a mountain of work.
After several days of unexplained absence, there were countless backlogged meetings and negotiations to handle.
Lin Ran, now mostly recovered, decided to visit the company and then go find Luo Yao.
Since his injury wasn't completely healed, a driver took him out, with Wang Bao openly following him.
At the company, Lin Ran was surprised to see Wu Zhishang there. The company had also hired a few new staff members, including a janitor.
"Aren't you supposed to be in class today?"
Wu Zhishang looked at Lin Ran like he was an idiot. "Bro! We're seniors now. We should focus on our careers. I've got enough credits, and I'm not planning to go to grad school. Why bother with classes?"
Lin Ran could only marvel at his logic.
"What about Zhang Xiaolong?"
Wu Zhishang said, "I can't reach him."
"What?"
Wu Zhishang then explained the situation.
Zhang Xiaolong had been unreachable since yesterday. As a result, their recently thriving live stream had to be paused for a day. If Zhang Xiaolong didn't show up today, Wu Zhishang planned to take over the stream himself.
Lin Ran dug out Zhang Xiaolong's employment records and called his sister, but no one answered.
After some thought, he called Zhang Xiaolong's father.
The call connected, and the voice on the other end was gruff.
"Who is this?"
Lin Ran said, "I'm looking for Zhang Xiaolong."
The man on the other end shouted, "I don't know any Zhang Xiaolong. You've got the wrong number."
Before the call could be disconnected, Lin Ran heard faint cries for help.
"Please... help... my sister..."
Lin Ran sensed something was wrong.
He tried calling again, but the call was rejected. Lin Ran was stunned.
Zhang Xiaolong was now his employee, and he wasn't sure if his rebirth had altered Zhang Xiaolong's original fate.
Without hesitation, he took out his phone and called Luo Yao.
Luo Yao answered, "What is it? Did you miss me, A-Ran?"
Lin Ran said urgently, "I did, but I need your help right now. I need to find someone—my employee."
Luo Yao's voice turned cautious. "Is it a man or a woman?"
"A man. His name is Zhang Xiaolong."
There was a brief silence on the other end before Luo Yao asked, "You've been spending a lot of time with Wu Zhishang lately, and now it's Zhang Xiaolong. A-Ran, you're not into men, are you?"
Lin Ran was taken aback and quickly retorted, "You know exactly who I'm into."
Luo Yao agreed to help Lin Ran locate Zhang Xiaolong. A short while later, she sent him a message.
"38 Jiaodong Road, Lane 2. If you want to see your employee again, you'd better hurry."

chapters.title: Chapter 53
chapters.content:
Lin Ran took Wu Zhishang with him without a second thought and got into the Rolls-Royce.
Wu Zhishang sighed in admiration.
"Brother Lin, you're really something. You change luxury cars like they're toys."
Lin Ran replied, "If you can handle Chen Qingtian, you can do the same. She earns enough from one acting gig to buy several of these."
Wu Zhishang blushed but still retorted, "What are you talking about? I would never betray my girlfriend. Besides, who am I to someone like Chen Qingtian? She’d never look at me twice."
Lin Ran smirked, "You never know. I never thought I’d have a day like this either."
Wu Zhishang: "..."
The car soon arrived at Jiaodong Road, a place far from the city's glamour. It was a dirty, chaotic old alley, home to migrant workers from all over the country.
Number 38 was located in a very narrow alley. Lin Ran and Wu Zhishang walked ahead, followed by Wang Bao.
When they reached the door of number 38, they found a small, warehouse-like structure with no yard and windows so dirty that nothing inside could be seen.Just as Lin Ran was about to knock, he heard noises from inside.
"Dad! Please, don’t give my sister away. I’ll work hard to get you the money you need."
Inside, Zhang Dahai slapped Zhang Xiaolong to the ground.
"Damn it! How did I end up with such worthless kids? My leg’s broken, and you two didn’t even come back to see me. I had to send someone to bring you here."
"Boss Wang will be here soon. That girl is leaving today, no matter what."
Amidst the faint sound of a girl crying, there was also an eerie laughter.
Without hesitation, Lin Ran kicked the door.
With a loud "bang," the door didn’t budge.
Lin Ran awkwardly scratched his head and looked at Wang Bao, who was trying hard not to laugh.
"Mr. Lin, let me handle this," Wang Bao said.
Lin Ran nodded, and with one kick, Wang Bao sent the door flying open.
Inside, a man in a wheelchair glared furiously at the broken door and shouted, "Who the hell dares to kick my door?"
Then he saw two young men and a burly man entering the room.
As soon as they stepped inside, Lin Ran, Wu Zhishang, and Wang Bao were all stunned.
Lin Ran realized he had underestimated human depravity—and the madness of a scumbag.
He hadn’t understood before why Zhang Xiaolong, a young man, could be controlled by his father. Now he saw it clearly.
There were four people in the room.
Zhang Dahai in the wheelchair.
Wait, Lin Ran recognized him.
Wasn’t he the guy who got his leg broken at Brother Dao’s gambling den last time?
In his past life, it was also this man who betrayed Wei Xiang, leading to Wu Zhishang losing his legs. What a coincidence.
Besides Zhang Dahai, there was Zhang Xiaolong, kneeling on the floor.
When Zhang Xiaolong saw Lin Ran, he was shocked but then relief washed over his face. He knew he was saved.
Apart from them, there was a middle-aged woman with sunken eyes and a skeletal frame, chained to an iron pipe. She was squatting on the ground, inhaling something and giggling foolishly.
Lastly, there was a frail-looking girl, about four or five years younger than Lin Ran, with delicate features. She was also chained to the same iron pipe, her eyes hollow and filled with despair. It was hard to imagine such a youthful, pretty face bearing such a lifeless expression.
The two women looked like slaves.
Zhang Dahai clearly recognized Lin Ran too. Last time, Lin Ran had been with Brother Dao, likely a guest of his.
Pointing at Lin Ran, Zhang Dahai stammered, "You... you... you..." but couldn’t finish his sentence.
Zhang Xiaolong immediately turned to Lin Ran and kowtowed.
"Boss, please save my sister. I’ll do anything to repay you, even if it means being your servant for life."
Zhang Dahai laughed.
"So you’re a boss, huh? Well, that makes things easier. If you can outbid Boss Wang, the girl is yours."
Lin Ran narrowed his eyes and took a deep breath.
In his mind, Zhang Dahai was no different from Lin Tianba.
Both were scumbag fathers.
And now he wanted to sell his daughter?
"Where’s the key?"
Zhang Dahai smirked.
"Show me the money, and I’ll give you the key."
Without another word, Lin Ran kicked Zhang Dahai, sending him and his wheelchair crashing to the ground.
If he couldn’t kick open the door, he could at least kick down a cripple.
"Kid, I don’t care who you are, but you’ve messed with the wrong person," Zhang Dahai growled.Googlᴇ search Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
At that moment, a pot-bellied middle-aged man appeared at the door, flanked by two thugs.
"Zhang Dahai, what’s going on here? I thought you had the goods ready for me."
Zhang Dahai quickly said, "Boss Wang, don’t misunderstand. I don’t know where these guys came from. Just give me the money, and the girl is yours."
Boss Wang glanced at the girl in the room and grinned lecherously. He had been eyeing Zhang Xiaonuan for a long time, manipulating Zhang Dahai to get his chance.
Boss Wang walked into the room, tossing a black plastic bag filled with money at Zhang Dahai’s feet. He then slowly approached Zhang Xiaonuan, completely ignoring Lin Ran and the others.
Zhang Dahai, still on the ground, didn’t bother getting up and started counting the money from the bag.
Boss Wang cooed, "Oh, Xiaonuan, what’s wrong? Come with Uncle Wang. I’ll take good care of you. My bed is big and warm."
Zhang Xiaonuan’s eyes were filled with despair. She had already decided to kill herself at the first opportunity rather than be humiliated.
"Do you really think you can ignore me like I’m nothing?"
Lin Ran’s voice echoed coldly.
Both Boss Wang and Zhang Dahai turned to look at him. Zhang Dahai couldn’t help but laugh.
"Haha! Kid, do you even know who Boss Wang is? He’s the king of Jiaodong Road."
Boss Wang looked at Lin Ran and the two young men, along with the burly man behind them, and sneered.
"Get rid of them."
At his command, the two thugs moved forward. They were professional enforcers, working for Boss Wang and doing all sorts of evil deeds over the years. The neighbors were too afraid to speak out.
Lin Ran thought to himself, "This old bastard has some nerve, playing these twisted games."
Lin Ran stepped outside, lit a cigarette, and took a deep drag.
"Wang Bao, I’m just going to smoke this one cigarette."
Wang Bao understood. Mr. Lin was giving him the time it took to finish one cigarette to deal with everyone inside.
Wang Bao blocked the two thugs, and soon the sound of fists hitting flesh filled the room—thud after thud.
Lin Ran leaned against the wall and took another drag.
"Cough! Cough! Cough!"
Wu Zhishang teased, "Brother Lin, if you can’t smoke, why pretend?"
Lin Ran chuckled, "You know I’m faking it, and yet you still call me out?"
Wu Zhishang asked, "Brother, is the guy you brought really capable?"
Lin Ran put a finger to his lips and said, "Listen. Do you hear any more noise from inside?"
Wu Zhishang was stunned.
"That fast?"

chapters.title: Chapter 54
chapters.content:
As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Bao's voice came through.
"Mr. Lin, it's done."
Lin Ran walked into the room in surprise and saw that, except for two women and Zhang Xiaolong, everyone else was lying on the ground.
Lin Ran smiled and said, "Not bad, Brother Wang."
Wang Bao scratched his head. "You flatter me, Mr. Lin."
Wu Zhishang, while looking at Wang Bao with admiration, went to help Zhang Xiaolong up. Zhang Xiaolong had been beaten pretty badly by his father.
Lin Ran threw away the remaining half of his cigarette and walked over to help Zhang Xiaonuan up. As for the woman who was giggling foolishly, no one paid her any attention.
Zhang Xiaonuan looked at Lin Ran in shock. She had imagined many scenarios but never thought someone would come to rescue them.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Zhang Xiaolong stood up and grabbed Lin Ran's hand, saying, "Thank you, boss. Thank you. I will never forget your kindness. I don’t know how to repay you."
Lin Ran thought to himself that this line sounded oddly familiar.Zhang Xiaolong asked, "What about them? We beat them up like this. Will we get into trouble? Boss Wang has a lot of influence around here."
Lin Ran smiled. "Don’t worry. When it comes to influence, I’m not afraid."
With that, he sent a message to Luo Yao. Soon, Luo Yao sent over some professionals.
First to arrive was Xu Kai with two assistants. Upon learning the situation, they were outraged and vowed to seek justice for Zhang Xiaolong and his sister.
A little later, the police arrived and took away Zhang Dahai and Boss Wang. However, the woman was still locked up, and since Zhang Dahai was unconscious, no one knew where the key was.
Zhang Xiaolong fell silent for a moment. "Even if he knew, he wouldn’t hand it over. I know him. If he realizes he’s been caught, he’ll fight to the bitter end. Otherwise, I would’ve already taken him down and forced him to give up the key."
Lin Ran patted Zhang Xiaolong on the shoulder. "No problem. Leave it to me."
After giving Wu Zhishang some instructions, Wu Zhishang soon returned with a locksmith.
The locksmith was startled when he saw the situation but didn’t say much, especially since the police were present.
After examining the two locks, he found them quite challenging—they weren’t ordinary locks.
After some thought, he carefully used his tools to physically dismantle them.
The first lock to be removed was Zhang Xiaonuan’s. She had been in her university dorm when someone told her that her family was looking for her. She thought it was her brother, but it turned out to be her father in a wheelchair and two thugs.
Zhang Xiaonuan resisted going with her father, so he had the thugs knock her out. They had come fully prepared.
When she woke up and found herself imprisoned, Zhang Xiaonuan felt like her world had collapsed. She knew her life was over.
But just as she was about to be sold off, a man descended like a savior, riding on a rainbow of light, and rescued her in a matter of moments.
Now, Zhang Xiaonuan threw herself into Zhang Xiaolong’s arms, sobbing. Zhang Xiaolong gently patted her back to comfort her.
After crying for a while, Zhang Xiaonuan glanced at Lin Ran and, after some hesitation, walked up to him.
"Thank you, Senior Lin Ran."
Lin Ran and Wu Zhishang were taken aback. Lin Ran asked, "You’re from Jingda University?"
Lin Ran only knew that Zhang Xiaonuan had started university this year but didn’t know she was at Jingda University.
He thought to himself that he could recruit her to the company to develop alongside her brother.
But then he reconsidered—studies should come first.
Zhang Xiaonuan nodded. "Yes, thank you for saving me."
Wu Zhishang chimed in, "We all helped rescue you, but you’re only thanking one person?"
Zhang Xiaonuan quickly shook her head nervously. "No, no, I’m thankful to all of you. Thank you, and thank you, sir. If it weren’t for you, my life would have been ruined."
The lock on Zhang Xiaolong’s mother was also opened, and the police took her away, along with the two thugs on the ground.
Given the seriousness of the situation, Zhang Xiaolong and Zhang Xiaonuan were also taken in for questioning.
Finally, Xu Kai assured Lin Ran that he wouldn’t rest until those people were locked up for life.
With the matter resolved, Lin Ran felt quite pleased.
Helping Zhang Xiaolong was one thing, but more importantly, he had dealt with Zhang Dahai, avenging Wu Zhishang from their past life.
Back at the company, Wu Zhishang invited Lin Ran to his home over the weekend.
Lin Ran initially didn’t want to go, but after hearing the reason, he agreed.
This busy schedule caused him to miss picking up Luo Yao, so he had to head straight back to the estate.
At the estate, Luo Yao’s expression was less than pleased because Lin Ran had promised to pick her up but had broken his promise.
Although Lin Ran had explained over the phone, she was still upset. It wasn’t until she saw Lin Ran walk into the villa that a faint smile appeared on her face.
Luo Yao’s love for Lin Ran wasn’t just about possession. She wanted to be with him at all times, clinging to him as if she could hang off him.
She wanted Lin Ran’s eyes to be only on her, with no room for anyone else—not even other men.
So, compared to her usual self, Luo Yao had been relatively restrained in her interactions with Lin Ran.
The doctor changed Lin Ran’s bandages and advised him to rest more, saying the wound had healed and that he just needed to disinfect and apply medicine regularly over the next few days.
Lin Ran thought to himself that he was recovering quickly—his physical condition must be pretty good.
After the doctor left, it was time for Lin Ran and Luo Yao’s favorite part of the day: their private time together.
In the villa, or even the entire estate, nothing else mattered to Luo Yao. Only Lin Ran was alive and vivid in her eyes.
If Luo Yao wanted, she could have him anywhere.
That was Luo Yao.
After dinner, the two went to the rooftop garden to talk.
...
After exercising, a man tends to get thirsty. Lin Ran slowly sipped a glass of water.
Luo Yao asked, "A’Ran, was that Zhang Xiaonuan pretty?"
Lin Ran spat out the water he had just sipped.
"No, not at all. Compared to Yao Yao, she’s nothing."
Luo Yao pressed, "So you did look at her?"
Lin Ran was taken aback. "No, I didn’t."
"Then how do you know she’s not as pretty as me?"
"Because in this world, no one could ever be as beautiful as my Yao Yao."
Luo Yao was somewhat satisfied with this answer.
"A’Ran, remember this: don’t think about other women, or I’ll make you regret it."
Lin Ran pulled Luo Yao into his arms. "I’ll only think about you. I’m right here with you. What are you worried about?"
Luo Yao leaned comfortably against Lin Ran’s chest, one hand holding his, the other resting on his leg.
Lin Ran gazed up at the stars, feeling the beauty of the world and the warmth of the woman in his arms.
Slowly, they moved together.
A connection that touched the soul.
A long time passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 55
chapters.content:
Lin Ran: "Did you do it again?"
Luo Yao nodded.
Lin Ran was shocked by Luo Yao's actions, but his inner satisfaction screamed wildly.
"Because only this way can I feel like you truly belong to me."
"Alright, as long as you're happy."
"Ran, do you like children?"
Lin Ran: "Not really, but if it's with you, then I do."
Luo Yao: "If we had a child, would they take away your love?"
Lin Ran paused for a moment before answering seriously, "I can't answer that, but my love for you will only grow stronger in the future."
Luo Yao also fell silent for a while before regaining her composure.She had made up her mind—no children, at least not now.
Because a child would take away Ran's love.
The two of them quietly gazed at the stars when Lin Ran suddenly seemed to remember something.
"Do you know where the black cat in our estate is?"
Luo Yao: "No idea. It might be a stray from somewhere."
Lin Ran thought Luo Yao knew, but it turned out she didn't. He wondered if he'd ever get to see the black cat again.
He always felt there was something off about that black cat.
Not only could it curse, but it also mocked people and even gave warnings, giving off a mysterious vibe.
The next day, Lin Ran finally decided to make an appearance at school.
A luxurious Rolls-Royce slowly drove into the campus, taking Lin Ran all the way to his destination.
When Lin Ran appeared in the classroom, all eyes were on him.
Lin Ran casually found a seat and sat down. Not long after, Wu Zhishang arrived.
Wu Zhishang was also delighted to see Lin Ran, especially since Lin Ran had gifted him a Ferrari LaFerrari.
However, Wu Zhishang wasn't one to show off, so he didn't drive the car to campus but kept it at home.
Following Lin Ran's advice, he kept his wealth low-key and didn't even mention it to his girlfriend.
Today, Lin Ran was here to help Wu Zhishang with a small issue and to check out the school.
Last time, when Wu Zhishang drove the car home, his parents were shocked. Despite his explanations, they remained skeptical.
So, Wu Zhishang decided to ask Lin Ran to come over and explain, or else his parents would always think he'd done something shady.
Originally, they planned to do this over the weekend, but Lin Ran's request was denied by Luo Yao.
Choosing to spend the weekend with a friend instead of his wife? Luo Yao was already being kind by not killing Wu Zhishang.
The instructor also knew about Lin Ran's return to school but didn't bother him, perhaps due to some instructions from the principal.
Student entrepreneurship was something the school should support, after all.
During the professor's lecture, the absence of Liu Ruxue made the class atmosphere quite harmonious. After class, many students asked Lin Ran where he'd been lately, but he simply told them they'd find out in a few days.
After class in the afternoon, Lin Ran accompanied Wu Zhishang to his home.
Wu Zhishang was also a local, but his family lived quite far from the school—over an hour's drive.
The Wu family was an ordinary household, living in a modest home, but Lin Ran didn't show any disdain.
When they arrived, Wu Zhishang's parents warmly welcomed Lin Ran. Having known them since childhood, Lin Ran was no stranger to them.
It wasn't until Lin Ran explained the whole situation that Wu Zhishang's parents began to believe it.
Wu's mother looked worried.
"Mom, didn't Brother Lin explain everything? Why do you still look like this?"
Wu's mother: "Of course, I believe Xiao Lin. But you said he's married, and I still can't believe it. From what you've said, that woman is very wealthy. Could she just be playing with Xiao Lin's feelings?"
Lin Ran felt touched. In such a materialistic society, genuine concern for others was rare.
Even his own family hadn't given him this kind of warmth, but today, he experienced it at Wu's home.
"Uncle, Aunt, don't worry. My wife and I have known each other for a long time. We love each other, and it's not as complicated as you think."
Hearing this, Wu's parents finally felt reassured and even gave Lin Ran a red envelope, which he accepted without hesitation.
Lin Ran exchanged a glance with Wu Zhishang and mentioned their joint business venture, which was already showing some progress and would soon collaborate with the school.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
The parents listened with smiles on their faces.
Finally, Lin Ran suggested that Wu's father quit his job, but Wu's father hesitated.
Some things were hard to say outright, so Lin Ran advised Wu's father to stay cautious. Wu's father wasn't foolish and immediately sensed there was more to Lin Ran's words.
"Xiao Ran, do you know something?"
Lin Ran couldn't say it directly, as he wasn't entirely sure himself. He just knew something was up.
After some thought, he gave Wu's father a few suggestions. Seeing how serious Lin Ran was, Wu's father took it to heart and eventually agreed with Lin Ran's advice.
When Lin Ran was about to leave, Wu's parents insisted he stay for dinner, but Lin Ran excused himself, citing work commitments.
Wu's father: "This kid, why is he in such a hurry?"
Wu's mother: "What do you know, old man? He's rushing home to see his wife, of course."
On the way back to school, Wu Zhishang looked puzzled.
"Brother Lin, why did you say those things to my dad? Do you know something?"
Lin Ran: "Do you trust me?"
Wu Zhishang immediately patted his chest: "Of course, I trust you, Brother."
Lin Ran: "Then make sure your dad pays attention to what I said. It'd be best if he quits his job. I can find him a better one later."
Wu Zhishang: "Got it."
The Rolls-Royce stopped right in front of the dormitory, drawing countless curious glances.
Wu Zhishang went upstairs, and just then, the person Lin Ran least wanted to see showed up.
Liu Ruxue and Huo Haini blocked Lin Ran's car door. Liu Ruxue's eyes were red, while Huo Haini appeared indignant on the surface, though his true thoughts were unclear.
Liu Ruxue: "Brother Lin Ran, you're finally back at school."
Lin Ran: "Get lost!"
Last time, it was because of Liu Ruxue that Lin Ran got injured, and he hadn't fully recovered yet.
And now she was back?
Wang Bao and the driver got out of the car. The moment they saw Liu Ruxue, their alarm bells went off.
Last time, it was his reporting mistake that led to Lin Ran's injury. If it weren't for Lin Ran's plea, he might have been severely punished.
This time, he was determined to protect Lin Ran no matter what.
Lin Ran gave a subtle signal, and Wang Bao stopped in his tracks.
Liu Ruxue: "Brother Lin Ran, someone came asking me for money today, saying I owed them a million. I couldn't find you."
Lin Ran nodded: "That's right. I've transferred the debt."
Liu Ruxue couldn't believe it.
"Why? Why would you do this to me? Do you know how terrifying that person is? It felt like he'd kill me if I didn't pay."
Lin Ran found it amusing but kept his tone sharp.
"Liu Ruxue, the money is what you owe. And don't come looking for me anymore. Whether you live or die has nothing to do with me."
"Let me make it clear—I'd rather see you destroyed."
Liu Ruxue took a step back, tears streaming down her face like broken pearls. Her pitiful sobs stirred up indignation among countless underclassmen.
So what if you're rich? Does that give you the right to hurt such a lovely and beautiful senior?
They couldn't hear the conversation between Liu Ruxue and Lin Ran, but they could see their actions.
From a visual perspective, Lin Ran truly resembled a scumbag who mistreated women.

chapters.title: Chapter 56
chapters.content:
Huo Haini said, "Yes, Ruxue, since you were the one who damaged the car, you really should pay for it. Brother Lin Ran is determined to make you pay, and even if it goes to court, you won't win. You should figure out a way to come up with the money."
After speaking, she sneakily glanced at Lin Ran, her eyes full of implication.
Liu Ruxue was utterly shocked, and even Lin Ran was taken aback by Huo Haini's words.
Who was Huo Haini? She had always looked down on Lin Ran, either mocking him with sarcastic remarks or outright cursing him. This time, she was actually speaking in Lin Ran's favor. Could you believe it?Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
However, Lin Ran didn’t care about her thoughts. All he wanted was to find an opportunity to completely ruin Liu Ruxue.
Brother Dao had already started demanding payment, and Liu Ruxue couldn’t come up with the money. The next period of time was going to be extremely difficult for her.
You don’t want to pay? Fine, don’t pay. But by then, the interest will keep piling up, and when you can’t bear it anymore, let’s see how smug you’ll be then.
Tears streamed down Liu Ruxue’s face as she pleaded, "Brother Lin Ran, I know you’re still angry. I was wrong, okay? Don’t let one million ruin the relationship between us. I still love you."
Lin Ran was utterly dumbfounded by her words.
"Liu Ruxue, what makes you think you’re worth one million? In my eyes, you’re not even worth a hundred bucks. Don’t come looking for me again, and don’t even mention the word ‘love.’ It disgusts me."With that, he ignored Liu Ruxue and got into his car.
Liu Ruxue was stopped by Wang Bao, who shouted from behind, "I know you’re still angry. It’s fine if you don’t forgive me, but just like you chased me for so many years, I can do the same."
"And even if you don’t want to talk to me for now, you should still go home and visit your uncle and aunt. They miss you."
Lin Ran was startled. He didn’t want Liu Ruxue constantly appearing in front of him.
"Are you fucking done yet? What does the Lin family have to do with me? If you come looking for me again, I’ll have someone beat you so badly you’ll see stars day and night."
"Damn, this is so unlucky."
Lin Ran really felt unlucky. How did he end up entangled with Liu Ruxue? This was only going to make Luo Yao angry.
The car started moving slowly, and Liu Ruxue tried to grab Lin Ran, but the driver quickly rolled up the window. Liu Ruxue was thrown to the ground by the car’s momentum.
Huo Haini helped Liu Ruxue up, saying, "Ruxue, let’s go back."
Liu Ruxue asked, "Why did you say that earlier?"
Huo Haini replied, "Ruxue, I can see now that Lin Ran really doesn’t care about you anymore."
Liu Ruxue said, "But last time you said he was just playing hard to get."
Huo Haini shook her head, "I was wrong last time. Now I’m sure he’s given up on you. So, Ruxue, don’t be delusional anymore. The Lin Ran now is no longer your lapdog."
Liu Ruxue cried, her sobs heart-wrenching.
"But I’ve realized I’ve fallen in love with him. What should I do?"
"I want to be with him, not for his money. I just want to mend our relationship."
Huo Haini looked at her with disdain.
When he was poor, you looked down on him and kept him hanging.
Now that he’s rich, you say you love him and claim it’s not about the money.
Then what is it about? Love?
Lin Ran didn’t notice that in the girls’ dormitory, someone was silently watching him, her eyes filled with determination.
Lin Ran didn’t return to the estate but went straight to the company. Since he was out, he decided to check on things and then pick up Luo Yao from work.
At the company, Zhang Xiaolong was in the middle of his fourth live stream of the day. After being released from the police station, Zhang Xiaolong was immensely grateful to Lin Ran and was determined to repay him through hard work.
So he pushed himself, increasing his daily live streams from three to six.
His fan base was growing steadily, and Lin Ran advised him not to overwork himself. Effort was part of the process, but it wasn’t the only path to success.
What Zhang Xiaolong needed now was a breakthrough, and that opportunity was in his own hands. All Lin Ran had to do was wait.
As for Zhang Xiaolong’s parents, one was under investigation, awaiting imprisonment, while the other had been sent to a rehab center, facing torment.
Boss Wang was also awaiting trial for human trafficking.
Xu Kai handled things, and Lin Ran had complete trust in him.
There wasn’t much going on at the company, so Lin Ran took a quick look around and prepared to leave. As the elevator doors opened, he ran into Zhang Xiaonuan, who had come to visit her brother.
Zhang Xiaonuan, due to long-term malnutrition, was very thin and somewhat introverted because of her family situation.
When she saw Lin Ran, she avoided eye contact at first but timidly greeted him, "Hello, senior."
Lin Ran stepped into the elevator, smiled, and said, "Hello. Are you here to see your brother? Go ahead. You have a great brother."
Zhang Xiaonuan nodded, "Yes, my brother has always been my only hope. I love him dearly."
After speaking, she looked up and noticed the elevator doors had already closed. She stood still for a moment, then softly added,
"Thank you, Senior Lin Ran. You are also my hope."
At the Luo Corporation office building, Lin Ran entered the lobby, and a security guard approached him.
"Sir, here to see President Luo?"
Lin Ran immediately recognized the guard as the one who had been quite responsible before. He smiled and nodded at him.
Lin Ran scanned his fingerprint, and the guard quickly pressed the elevator button for him.
On the 88th floor, members of the assistant team kept peeking out into the hallway.
They had been working at the estate for several days and had already gotten to know Lin Ran. Although they hadn’t spoken much, they all knew he was Luo Yao’s man.
They just weren’t sure if he was her boyfriend or her kept boy toy.
At that moment, Luo Yao was on the phone in her office. Hearing a knock, she said, "Come in," and saw Lin Ran walk in.
Luo Yao’s eyes lit up with joy. Without even hanging up the phone, she rushed into Lin Ran’s arms.
"Why are you here?"
"To pick up my wife from work," Lin Ran replied.
Luo Yao smiled and nodded, "Alright, wait for me a moment."
She then picked up the phone again, gave a few instructions, and hung up.
Snuggling back into Lin Ran’s arms, Luo Yao was filled with happiness.
"Aran, it’s still early. Let’s play the boss and secretary game for a while, okay?"
Lin Ran looked at her with affection, "Are you that horny? Every time you see me, you want to do that? Don’t you know I’m still recovering?"
Luo Yao pouted, "But yesterday in the garden, you didn’t seem like a patient at all!"
"Aran!"
"Hubby!"
"Please?"
"Can we?"
Lin Ran looked at her in shock. Since when had this little devil become so good at acting cute?
"Alright, alright! Fine, I’ll give in."
Luo Yao handed Lin Ran a pair of bracelets.
Lin Ran: ???
What kind of role reversal is this?
…

chapters.title: Chapter 57
chapters.content:
While Lin Ran and Luo Yao were role-playing, lawyer Xu Kai, acting on behalf of Lin Ran, convened a shareholders' meeting of the Suran Group. Chairman Lin Tianba attended despite his illness.
There was no way around it. Even if Lin Tianba wanted to avoid the meeting, it wouldn’t have mattered.
