chapters.title: Chapter 351
chapters.content:
Liu Meng held the documents in her hand. "The Wang Family Head is indeed perceptive—far more so than certain others."
Wang Xiaolin's heart was eerily calm, devoid of even the slightest ripple.
It was as if he had long accepted this outcome.
"Assistant Liu's methods are remarkable. Truly worthy of being President Luo's right hand. I'm impressed. I'm relieved that the doomed corporation found a helmsman like President Luo."
Just as he spoke, Chen Qingtian arrived. The moment she saw Wang Xiaolin, she was stunned.
"President Wang! It's me, Chen Qingtian. I didn’t expect to run into you here."
Of course, Wang Xiaolin knew Chen Qingtian. As the owner of a media subsidiary under the doomed corporation, how could he not recognize a top-tier actress?
Chen Qingtian had single-handedly pulled in massive box office numbers for the doomed cinema chain.
But audiences weren’t exactly flocking for her acting skills. The most common praise she received was, "Her beauty is unmatched."
No one ever really talked about her performances.Wang Xiaolin smiled and extended his hand. "Hello, it's a pleasure to meet you. I'm here to discuss matters with President Luo."
Chen Qingtian wasn’t the least bit intimidated. After all, she wasn’t just a star—she was also the heiress of the Chen family, accustomed to rubbing shoulders with tycoons.
"Oh? Aren’t you... currently competing for the Tech City bid?"
Though the results of the Tech City project hadn’t been announced yet, rumors were swirling. Most believed it was already a sure win for Luo Corporation.
"Indeed. But there’s no need for competition anymore—because from now on, the doomed corporation will bear the Luo name."
"Huh?"
Chen Qingtian looked utterly bewildered. Liu Meng cut straight to the explanation.
"The doomed corporation has been acquired by us."
Chen Qingtian... (Disclaimer: Not based on reality. The novel's doomed corporation has no foreign investors.)
"I—what the hell—just kill me already! Here I was, dreaming of becoming a boss, and now my little sister-in-law is out here acquiring whole corporations—AAAAAH—"
Liu Meng nearly laughed. She actually quite liked Chen Qingtian’s personality.
"Miss Chen, Young Master Lin is currently inside with President Luo. It’s best if you don’t disturb them for now."
Chen Qingtian blinked in confusion. "Why?"
Liu Meng lowered her voice. "For the sake of survival."
Chen Qingtian nodded. "Oh—"
But Liu Meng had a feeling she hadn’t understood at all.
Wang Xiaolin was eager to return and finalize the next steps.
"Assistant Liu, since the acquisition is complete, I’ll take my leave now. We’ll issue a statement as soon as possible."
Liu Meng gave Chen Qingtian an apologetic glance.
"I’ll escort President Wang out first. Please wait a moment." With that, she led Wang Xiaolin’s team away, leaving a puzzled Chen Qingtian behind.
Staring at the closed doors of the meeting area, Chen Qingtian rubbed her chin thoughtfully.
"Are they...?"
Time ticked by. When the doors finally opened again, Lin Ran was the first to step out.
After concluding discussions with Wang Xiaolin’s team, Luo Yao had instructed Liu Meng to see them off while she and Lin Ran discussed... other matters. They had completely forgotten about Chen Qingtian.
Lin Ran stretched, feeling like his body was about to fall apart.
"Assistant Liu, Yao Yao wants to see you."
"Understood."
Liu Meng took the documents and entered the meeting room, leaving Lin Ran outside.
"Cousin, did you need something?"
Chen Qingtian had been waiting for a while. Through Liu Meng, she’d pieced together what Lin Ran and Luo Yao had been up to inside.
So she’d wandered around on her own, keeping herself entertained.
When she saw Lin Ran emerge, her gaze held a mix of resentment and envy.
Glancing at the assistants moving about, Chen Qingtian lowered her voice.
"Can you ask them to step away? This is something I can only tell you."
Lin Ran found Chen Qingtian’s behavior odd.
Inside the meeting room...
"How much usable funds do we have left?"
"President Luo, there really isn’t much this time."
Luo Yao nodded. It had been a long time since she’d worried about money.
"Then we won’t wait any longer. Once Wang Xiaolin announces the takeover, find an opportunity to cash out."
Liu Meng agreed.
How ruthless was capital?
Using Luo Corporation’s funds, Liu Meng had helped Luo Yao personally dive into the doomed corporation’s stock market, stabilizing its plummeting shares amid continuous scandals.
Once the doomed corporation announced its acquisition by Luo Yao, its stock would skyrocket. In essence, Luo Yao was using the profits she’d made from the doomed corporation to buy it outright—a brutal display of financial dominance.
Of course, pulling this off required massive capital.
It also helped that the doomed corporation was already on its last legs, making it an easy target.
A company like Samsung would never be this vulnerable—no matter how dire its situation, it would always keep emergency funds.
That’s why crushing the three major families was far simpler than taking down Samsung.
To put it bluntly: despite prolonged attacks, Samsung had held firm, even transferring cooperative funds to the corporate account.
If Samsung lost the bid, those funds would return to them, buying them a brief respite.
But it would only be a delay—not enough to stop Luo Yao from orchestrating their decline, or even their downfall.
"Ah Ran, what secrets are you two whispering about?"
The moment Luo Yao stepped out, she saw Chen Qingtian speaking mysteriously to Lin Ran.
Chen Qingtian felt a sudden chill—though she wasn’t sure if it was just her imagination.
"Little sister-in-law, listen—I’ve uncovered a huge secret."
"You know Uncle Fu, right? He might be a mole. And Jiang Feihua—she could be one too. At least one of them is shady. Maybe both."
"Hmm."
Chen Qingtian blinked. "Hmm? That’s it?"
"What else? You’ve said your piece."
"No, no—I’m not done! Jiang Feihua—do you know how strong she is? Yesterday, she almost @#�0�6%..."
She went on to recount last night’s events, but Luo Yao and Lin Ran remained expressionless.
"You guys already knew, didn’t you...? Fine, seems you’re aware there are snakes in the house. I’ll head out first."
After Chen Qingtian left, Lin Ran and Luo Yao exchanged glances.
"Shouldn’t it be ‘black sheep’?"
Luo Yao replied coldly, "Bird or sheep—it makes no difference to me."ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NoveI★Fire.net
"What do you mean?"
"Both can be crushed effortlessly."
"That’s my wife—always dominant, no matter the situation."
Luo Yao arched a brow. "You and Chen Qingtian seem quite close."
A faint, lethal aura seeped into the air. Lin Ran was acutely sensitive to it.
"Yao Yao, she’s kind of cute, honestly."
Chen Qingtian didn’t deserve death. Besides, Lin Ran had a feeling Luo Yao didn’t entirely despise her... probably.
"Cute? Compared to me?"
Was this even a question?

chapters.title: Chapter 352
chapters.content:
"How can she compare to you? She doesn't stand a chance at all. She's just cute, but you—you're not only cute, you're also my love."
Only then did Luo Yao retract her icy demeanor.
"President Luo, Lu Youqi has personally driven to the estate to invite you to the Lu Family residence. Will you see him?"
Lin Ran and Luo Yao exchanged glances, both wearing expressions that said, "Just as expected."
"Ah Ran, it seems he’s truly desperate."
Last time, Luo Yao had made it clear that if he wanted a meeting, he’d have to come in person. Later, Chen Buhui arrived, and today, Wang Xiaolin showed up.
Finally, though belatedly, Lu Youqi made his appearance.
"Then let’s go meet the so-called 'first family of Shanghai.'"
"Fine. Tell him to wait in the villa’s living room."
By the time they returned to the villa, Lu Youqi had already been waiting for quite some time.He was chatting idly with Chen Qingtian.
"Qingtian is a rising star in the entertainment industry, her acting skills are nothing short of mesmerizing—even an old man like me gets lost in admiration."
Chen Qingtian rolled her eyes. She had no interest in entertaining this old man’s small talk.
The moment Lu Youqi walked in and saw her playing games on the sofa, he had started rambling incessantly.
"My acting is as laughable as a pig’s, yet you call it mesmerizing? Patriarch Lu, you really are something—a true master of verbal flattery, you sly old fox."
Chen Qingtian didn’t even glance up from her gaming device as she replied.
Lu Youqi maintained a refined smile, but his irritation was simmering beneath the surface.
Chen Qingtian was just a junior from the Chen Family. Sure, the Chen Family had political influence, but the Lu Family wasn’t to be trifled with either.
Why was everyone connected to Lin Ran so blunt? None of them knew how to respect their elders.
Even if Chen Qingtian’s grandfather, Chen Xiao, were here, he wouldn’t dare speak to him like this.
"Qingtian is quite spirited. I like that. I won’t hold it against you—"
Finally, Chen Qingtian set down her device, took a deep breath, and prepared to unleash her verbal barrage.
"Who said you could ‘not hold it against me’? Go ahead, hold it against me! I’d love to know what exactly you plan to hold against me. That you disturbed my gaming? Or that you tried to butter me up? ‘Qingtian this, Qingtian that’—since when are we so close?"
"If you want to flatter someone, go find my sister-in-law. Don’t waste your efforts on the wrong person. I don’t have any money to tip you."
Lu Youqi’s smile stiffened, his anger teetering on the edge of eruption.
Why were young people nowadays so disrespectful and reckless?
He was eighty years old—old enough to be her grandfather—yet she dared speak to him with such insolence?
Just as Lu Youqi was about to teach Chen Qingtian a lesson, Lin Ran’s voice cut in.Original content can be found at novel✦fire.net
"Patriarch Lu, I’d advise you to talk less with my cousin. Her tongue is even sharper than mine."
Lin Ran and Luo Yao walked into the villa just in time to witness the exchange between Lu Youqi and Chen Qingtian.
"Haha, President Luo, Young Master Lin! This old man came unannounced—please forgive the intrusion."
"If you knew it was an intrusion, why come at all?" Luo Yao’s voice was frosty.
Lu Youqi choked back his frustration. These youngsters had no sense of respect, and their words cut deep.
"President Luo, you misunderstand. After all, we are business partners. Today, I’ve prepared a grand banquet at the Lu Family residence, and I sincerely hope you’ll honor us with your presence."
Luo Yao and Lin Ran exchanged another glance before Lin Ran spoke.
"You invite us… and we’re just supposed to go? What about our dignity?"
Lu Youqi smiled confidently. "Young Master Lin, President Luo, I’ve prepared a generous gift for you at the Lu Family residence—one that will surely satisfy you. And my unfilial son is waiting there to offer you both a sincere apology."
Lu Youqi had always assumed his relationship with Luo Yao was purely competitive, with only minor clashes during their last two encounters.
Besides, at the Li Family banquet, Luo Yao had been the one to strike first.
Even after learning his granddaughter Lu Xiangting had her tongue cut out, he hadn’t made a fuss.
If anything, Luo Yao should owe him a favor for that.
So why was he here? Two reasons: First, he was afraid and wanted to end the feud.
Second, his youngest granddaughter, Lu Xiangshi—an avid shipper of Lin Ran and Luo Yao—had analyzed Luo Yao’s hostility and personality for him.
Only then did Lu Youqi realize: Luo Yao was a full-blown yandere.
Lu Xiangshi, well-versed in fandom culture, had explained the concept in detail.
After understanding, Lu Youqi was stunned—he’d truly lived long enough to see everything.
No wonder Luo Yao had reacted so violently to Lu Xiangting’s provocations. It all boiled down to Lu Xiangting saying the wrong things.
Thus, Lu Youqi immediately ordered Lu Lutong to prepare at the Lu Family residence while he personally came to invite Luo Yao—both to apologize and negotiate a truce.
"An apology?"
"Indeed. I’ve instructed my worthless son to await your arrival so he can offer his sincerest regrets."
Originally, Lu Youqi had considered dragging his son over by force, but he worried about gossip if outsiders saw. So, he decided to host the apology at the Lu Family residence.
More importantly, it was the only way to get Luo Yao to come.
Once, he had looked down on her. Now, he wouldn’t dare.
Luo Yao saw right through his little scheme. She turned to Lin Ran.
"Ah Ran, do you want to go?"
Lin Ran smirked. "Last time, your two grandsons offended me too."
Lu Youqi didn’t hesitate. "Lu Lutong, Lu Xiangdai, Lu Xiangji, Lu Xiangting—even Lu Ludu—are all there. Once you arrive, handle them as you see fit. I won’t utter a single word of protest."
Lu Ludu hadn’t provoked Luo Yao during this trip to Shanghai, but he had in the past.
Though Luo Yao had already broken his bones as punishment back then, Lu Youqi had no qualms about sacrificing him again to appease her.
After all, Lu Ludu was the family’s designated scapegoat. Might as well make himself useful before taking the fall.
"Really? We can do whatever we want?"
Lu Youqi nodded solemnly. "Even if you cut out all their tongues, I won’t say ‘no.’ I, Lu Youqi, swear on this. If I break my word, may my entire family die horribly."
Huh?
Lin Ran thought, "Isn’t that my line?"
Suddenly, Lin Ran was intrigued. But he still deferred to Luo Yao, who responded with her usual domineering flair.
"Since Patriarch Lu has extended such a sincere invitation, I’ll grant you this face. Let’s see what kind of scheme the Lu Family is brewing."
Lu Youqi’s eye twitched, but he swallowed his anger and kept his composure.
Chen Qingtian suddenly raised her hand. "Me! Me! Take me with you! I want to see the Lu Family residence too. May I, Patriarch Lu?"
Lu Youqi, ever the diplomat, acted as if their earlier clash never happened.
"Of course. You’re Young Master Lin’s cousin—you’re more than welcome to join."

chapters.title: Chapter 353
chapters.content:
As they walked out, a meaningful glint flashed in Lu Youqi's eyes as he spoke up.
"I saw the Wang family's car on my way here earlier. I wonder..."
Luo Yao replied flatly, "The Doomed Group has been acquired by us."
"What?"
Lu Youqi stood frozen, stunned that his business partner had been silently absorbed without a word.
So what the hell had he been doing all this time?
Of the three great families, one had been taken down, another absorbed, and now only his remained—struggling under official investigation, barely holding on.
Damn it, so after all this, we're just completely wiped out?
As the top family in Shanghai, are we just destined to get stabbed in the back?
Ridiculous.How did it come to this? Could Luo Yao really be this formidable?
No way. Absolutely no way.
"President Luo's methods are truly masterful. Had I known earlier, I wouldn’t have competed with you, making things so difficult for everyone."
Luo Yao walked expressionlessly toward her convoy in the estate. "I'm not the one suffering. You are."
Well, Lu Youqi suddenly felt like some character from a foreign movie.
Little did they know, the Lu family had already undergone a complete upheaval at that very moment...
Lin Ran and Luo Yao rode in one car, driven by Wang Bao, with Little Tong in the passenger seat, assistant Liu Meng, cousin Chen Qingtian, and a team of bodyguards following behind.
Chen Qingtian thought of herself as the life of the party, hoping to build a good relationship with Luo Yao to pave her way to riches.
But she gradually realized she’d boarded the wrong car.
"Yao Yao, do you think the people at the Lu estate will bully us?"
"No one can bully me. If they bully you, I’ll just eliminate them all."
Chen Qingtian: "..."
"Once we arrive, what identity should I present myself with?"
"As the husband of Luo Corporation’s CEO. If you don’t like that, you can go as the Lu family’s undertaker."
Lin Ran: "???"
Chen Qingtian: "..."
Luo Yao suddenly flashed a meaningful smile.
"Ah Ran, I know you love drama, so I arranged a special show for you at the Lu estate. You’ll see it soon."
For some reason, Chen Qingtian felt her mental fortitude was on the verge of collapse.
Lin Ran, however, perked up with interest, wearing a blissful smile.
"Having such a wonderful wife is truly my blessing. Sometimes I wonder if this is all a dream, but every real sensation tells me it’s all true."
After saying this, Lin Ran sighed from the depths of his heart.
"I’m so happy, looking back to see you still by my side."
Luo Yao: "I’ll always stay by Ah Ran’s side, loving Ah Ran."Thɪs updatᴇd by novel⟡fire.net
Chen Qingtian: "..."
She glanced at Liu Meng, who sat with her head lowered, expression calm—except her lips kept trembling.
"Do you have Parkinson’s?"
Liu Meng: "Huh? No."
"Then why are your lips shaking?"
"Oh, I’m reciting scripture."
"What scripture?"
"The Heart-Cleansing Mantra."
Chen Qingtian began questioning her life choices.
Was her emotional resistance really this weak?
Luo Yao shot them a glance, and Lin Ran also felt a little embarrassed—he hadn’t meant to flaunt their affection.
"Yao Yao, I wasn’t with you during your lowest moments, yet here I am sharing your peak. Isn’t that a bit selfish?"
"No. I’ll bring the highest summit to you so you can stand atop it, because you’re Ah Ran—you deserve the best."
Pfft!
Chen Qingtian finally snapped, feeling her entire body break out in goosebumps.
"You two... are too much! Ugh, I need to find someone to whisper sweet nothings to me every day too!"
Lin Ran raised an eyebrow.
"I think there’s someone perfect for you."
"Who?"
"Wang Dacong. You two—a playboy and a gold-digger—are a match made in heaven. Except he’s actually had his fill, while you haven’t even taken a bite."
You son of a— Stay calm, stay calm. If I rage, who benefits? I’m celebrity Chen Qingtian, I must be poised, not irritable.
Watching Chen Qingtian start reciting mantras too, Lin Ran sighed helplessly and looked at Luo Yao beside him.
Suddenly, he noticed something—Luo Yao didn’t actually seem to dislike Chen Qingtian that much.
He wasn’t wrong. Luo Yao indeed didn’t resent Chen Qingtian anymore.
First, Chen Qingtian was fundamentally different from other women—she was Lin Ran’s cousin, came from a politically influential family, and wasn’t likely to compete for Ah Ran’s attention.
Second, Luo Yao had investigated and confirmed Chen Qingtian’s sexual orientation was normal, so no risk of her falling for Luo Yao either.
Moreover, Luo Yao had noticed something subtle—this woman, who seemed carefree on the surface, was actually quite perceptive.
For instance, she always greeted Luo Yao first whenever they met. Beyond her money-making motives, it was also a deliberate act to show she wasn’t overly attached to Lin Ran—a performance meant for Luo Yao.
She was signaling that, as family, she wouldn’t divert Lin Ran’s focus. Chen Qingtian never said it outright, but Luo Yao could sense it.
Once or twice might be coincidence, but consistently? That was intentional.
Who could say such a woman wasn’t sharp?
She knew her boundaries, was bold yet meticulous, and understood what she wanted.
Her carefree nature was her personality; her attentiveness was her essence—two traits that rarely coexisted seamlessly in one person.
Her only flaw was being a bit promiscuous—but upon closer inspection, her "promiscuity" was all talk. She hadn’t actually been with a single man.
Luo Yao had said she hated players, but Chen Qingtian didn’t know that.
And she wasn’t really a player—at least not in action.
At most, she was just... mentally adventurous.
"Ah Ran, I heard the guys in Capital University’s sports department are quite something. Since cousin here loves men so much, why not arrange a whole platoon for her?"
Chen Qingtian: "Huh?"
Lin Ran: "A whole platoon?"
Could Chen Qingtian’s petite frame even handle that?
And did Luo Yao just call her "cousin"?
"Wang Xiaolin just went public," Liu Meng suddenly cut in, handing Luo Yao a tablet. Lin Ran leaned over to look.
The official statement from Doomed Group’s account was simple: From today onward, Doomed Group belonged to Luo Yao Holdings.

[FollowMeToProsperity]: Doomed Group is Luo Yao’s now? Right after Luo Corp took down the Li family, they swallowed the Wangs too. Is she trying to single-handedly dismantle Shanghai’s three great families? That’s... so damn cool.
[DevastatinglyHot]: Holy crap, no wonder everyone’s talking about buying stocks next market opening. Old Wang’s move was genius—using Luo Corp’s clout to bail himself out.

chapters.title: Chapter 354
chapters.content:
【Hemorrhoid Enthusiast】: Don’t you guys know? The three major families of Demon City are competing with Luo Yao for the official project. I suspect this was a predestined outcome. Luo Yao is no ordinary person. Those old-money families think they’re untouchable, but they can’t even see how powerful the new generation has become. And have you noticed? It was Luo Yao who acquired the Doomed Group, not Luo Corporation.
【Tomatoes Are Red】: When it comes to real brutality, our top chaebol heiress takes the crown. The sheer bloodiness is chilling. And if I remember correctly, the former members of the Luo family seem to have vanished. Where did they all go? Did Luo Yao have them locked up? (This message was instantly deleted, and the user was banned.)
The acquisition case sparked nationwide debate, even catching the attention of Lu Youqi, who was leading the way earlier, as he stared at the news in deep thought.
Under the official account of Doomed Group, comments were piling up.
【Human Relations】: Luo Yao’s acquisition is hands down the most explosive deal of the year. And did you notice? Within just ten minutes of the news breaking, all the negative buzz around Doomed Group vanished—like the internet just forgot.
【Losing Money to Spoil the Fam】: Doesn’t anyone else think Luo Yao is way too ruthless? And what about Wang Dacong’s scandal? We can’t just let Doomed Group off the hook, nor let capital run this wild. (This message was instantly deleted, and the user was banned.)
【Birds of a Feather】: Every day, I envy Lin Ran. Who wouldn’t want a wife this capable? Who wouldn’t want to live that cushy life?
【Shameless Troll】: Watch your mouth, buddy, unless you want a lawsuit.
Lin Ran stared at the flood of comments with a wry smile.
Whether in his past life or now, Luo Yao had made sure the entire nation knew her name.“Heh, the netizens are talking about you way more than me these days.”
Luo Yao nodded. “They’re just not used to hearing about acquisitions this big. If you want the spotlight, I can hand Luo Corporation over to you. Guaranteed to—”
“Shh! I don’t want the attention, and I don’t want to manage some massive conglomerate. I just want to be a useless bum.”
Chen Qingtian’s eyes widened in disbelief. She couldn’t fathom what kind of love would drive someone to give so much.
She knew Luo Yao had yandere tendencies—she’d even googled “Do yanderes make better money?”
But she couldn’t wrap her head around what kind of love would make someone break their own bones to make soup for their man.
Chen Qingtian’s worldview finally shattered.
As the car entered Lu Manor, the group quickly understood why the Lu family was considered a major dynasty.
Lu Manor was a place of antique elegance and staggering luxury—not a countryside estate, but something closer to a high-end villa district.
After driving deeper into the grounds, they arrived before a palatial structure.
Stepping out, they realized even the outdoor flooring was made of premium hardwood. Lin Ran was seeing the place in a whole new light.
When they reached the main hall, even Lin Ran was stunned.
This wasn’t just a hall—it was more dazzling than the lobby of a seven-star hotel.
Compared to the ancestral hall at the Luo family’s old residence, the difference was night and day.
His gaze drifted to the wall behind the main seat.
Good.
No ancestral tablets.
If this place had followed the Luo family’s style, how many memorial plaques would they have needed?
“President Luo, Young Master Lin, this is the Lu family’s—” Lu Youqi suddenly frowned, sensing something off as he scanned the empty hall.
Logically, as the family head, his return should’ve been met with a grand welcome.
But not only was it eerily quiet outside—there wasn’t a soul inside either.
Something was very, very wrong.
Even Lu Lutong and his sons, whom he’d left in charge, were nowhere to be seen.
“Where is everyone? Don’t they know I’m back?”
“Someone!”
“Someone!”
Lu Youqi’s face darkened with embarrassment.
Just then, a servant rushed in.
“Family Head.”
“Compose yourself!” Lu Youqi snapped. If this servant weren’t somewhat special, he’d have banished him on the spot.
Meanwhile, Luo Yao narrowed her eyes.
The servant kept his head low as he reported, “Oh—Lu—Lu—tong—Young—Master—”
“Can you speak faster?” Lu Youqi was genuinely furious now, already plotting the servant’s punishment.
“Young Master Lu Lutong secretly released Young Master Lu Ludu. Now they’ve rallied much of the family to overthrow you as head.”
“What? Why wasn’t I called?” Lu Youqi was floored.
Lin Ran patted his pockets but found nothing, suddenly feeling uneasy.
“Ah-Ran, looking for this?”
Lin Ran stared at the handful of sunflower seeds in Luo Yao’s palm, baffled.
“Where’d you get these?”
“I had Liu Meng prepare them in advance.”
Lin Ran was starting to think he didn’t understand Luo Yao at all.
Lu Youqi, seething, waved his hand. “Someone!”
“Someone!”
No response.
“Some—”
“Family Head, I’m afraid Young Master Lu Ludu has taken control of the entire Lu Manor,” the servant cut in.
“What? And you just let it happen?” Lu Youqi couldn’t believe it.
The servant blinked innocently. “I’m not part of the main family. How could I stop them?”
Lu Youqi’s eyes narrowed. He knew full well this man could’ve intervened if he’d wanted.
Liu Meng smirked. “Family Head Lu, is this the show you invited us to see? Quite the spectacle. So, where do we sit?”
At her mocking tone, Lu Youqi’s expression turned stormy.
Then he caught Luo Yao’s derisive gaze—and suddenly understood.
“President Luo, must we be at each other’s throats like this?”
“That depends on your sincerity.” Luo Yao casually took the seat of honor, while Lin Ran settled into the other.
Lu Youqi closed his eyes and sighed.
He knew that once Luo Yao made her move, victory was certain.
Just like with the Li and Wang families.
Right then, the sound of hurried footsteps filled the air as dozens of Lu family members poured into the hall.
Outside, the grounds buzzed with activity as more clansmen gathered.
Leading the security team was a man in his seventies.
Lin Ran marveled at the sheer size of the Lu family—their numbers were staggering.
At the front, Lu Lutong pushed a wheelchair carrying the injured Lu Ludu.
“You traitor! Who told you to release him? And all of you—what do you think you’re doing?”
Lu Lutong smirked.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ novel⁂fire.net
“Old man, you’ve been head for way too long. We, your sons, aren’t happy. Why do you get to sit high while we’re just tools for your schemes?”
“So you’re rallying them to dethrone me and take my place?”
Lu Lutong shook his head, patting the wheelchair. Inside, Lu Ludu sat perfectly calm.
"My abilities are limited, and I don't believe I'm fit for the position of family head. But the Eighth Brother is capable—today, I nominate him as the new head. If you know what's good for you, I'll let you retire peacefully at Lu Manor. But if you refuse to cooperate..."
"Then I'll have to make you cooperate."

chapters.title: Chapter 355
chapters.content:
Lu Youqi narrowed his eyes as he looked at his eight sons.
"You’re all such filial children—laughing your father to death."
Seated in his wheelchair, Lu Ludu glanced at Luo Yao and nodded before addressing Lu Youqi.
"Don’t act so indignant. Born into a great family like ours, what choice do we have but to fight? Take you, for instance—didn’t you seize power by eliminating your own brother?"
"Nonsense!" Lu Youqi denied immediately. Lu Ludu smirked in disdain.
"You think you covered your tracks well, but I’ve got irrefutable proof. Otherwise, why do you think everyone here is standing behind me?"
Seeing Lu Youqi’s face twitch, Lu Ludu’s grin widened.
"Honestly, there’s no point denying it. It’s the truth—one of the tragedies of great families. Even the Head of the Li Family, already taken away by the authorities—how many of the major families in this city, aside from the Wang Family, have gained their positions cleanly?"
"If you could do it, why can’t we?"
After years of patience, Lu Ludu finally let loose."Old man, stop struggling. Look around—do you see even one of your sons standing with you? You know exactly how we’ve lived all these years. ‘Young masters of a wealthy family’ sounds nice, but in reality, we were just your tools. Which one of us wasn’t abused growing up?"
The room fell silent. No one could refute Lu Ludu’s words.
To the outside world, Lu Youqi was refined and amiable, but within the Lu Family, he was a notorious tyrant—violent and cruel to his own kin.
Lu Youqi felt his heart turn cold. He had anticipated this day might come, but never imagined it would be such a complete betrayal.
"Where’s Luxin?" he asked, referring to his favorite ninth son.
"Ah, Ninth Brother. Right—the only one you never laid a hand on. But you won’t be seeing him."
"What do you mean?"
Lu Ludu feigned sorrow.
"You accused me of drug trafficking, but it wasn’t me—it was Ninth Brother. I’ve already handed him over to the authorities. After all, for a crime this big, someone from the main Lu Family line has to take the fall. Don’t you agree, Lu Youqi?"
The sorrow vanished, replaced by a chilling grin. Lu Youqi’s scalp prickled.
He understood now—Lu Ludu was framing Lu Luxin for this.
Just as he had once tried to force Lu Ludu to confess, except Lu Ludu was actually guilty, while Lu Luxin, at least in this case, was innocent.
"You unfilial wretch! Have you no shred of familial love?"
Lu Ludu scoffed. "Familial love? ‘Royal families are the cruelest.’ We may not be royalty, but our infighting is just as vicious. If love meant anything, so many wouldn’t have died."
"If you truly care about your son, why not take the blame yourself? Do one last thing for the Lu Family."
"Though I have to say, Ninth Brother really was the most filial. When I told him his father would die unless he took the blame, he actually went. Hilarious! And you pinned your hopes on this fool? How could he possibly lead the Lu Family forward?"
Lu Ludu paused, eyes burning with hatred.
"Too bad he doesn’t know what’ll happen to his dear father after he confesses. Even I can’t predict how ugly it’ll get."
Lu Youqi took a deep breath, stunned by Lu Ludu’s ruthlessness.
This was his own flesh and blood.
"So now you’re staging a coup?"
"A coup? You really think you’re an emperor? I’m just following your example. How you came to power—need I remind you? I’m doing this for the Lu Family’s future."
Lu Youqi felt the bitter irony of his life.
Yes, he had seized power unjustly, but at least he’d done it quietly.
Now these traitorous sons of his had outdone him in cruelty.
"You really think I’m some pushover? Fine. If this is how it is, I won’t hold back."
Lu Youqi saw the full picture now. He wouldn’t wait for death—if he acted fast, he might still save Lu Luxin.
"Lu Youhu, seize these traitors!"
Lu Youhu, Lu Youqi’s cousin, oversaw the Lu Family’s entire security force.
"Brother, my apologies. I prefer your sons. You’re old—time to step down."
Shock. Disbelief. Numbness.
"What? What did that wretch promise you?"Thɪs Nove1Fire.net
Lu Youhu showed no shame. "Nothing much. Just double what you gave me. And let’s not forget—you did the same to our eldest brother. What goes around comes around. You should’ve known this was coming."
Rage burned in Lu Youqi’s eyes.
"Fine. Fine! My own dear brother. Don’t blame me for cutting ties. You think I’ve no cards left?"
"Ah San, it’s up to you now. Take down Lu Ludu."
Ah San—the seemingly unreliable servant. To outsiders, he was just another underling. Only Lu Youqi knew the truth: this man was a top-three assassin on the dark web.
For years, he’d stayed by Lu Youqi’s side—loyalty bought with money, his servant identity just a cover.
Lu Youqi had absolute confidence in him. Crushing Lu Youhu and subduing Lu Ludu would be effortless.
"Patriarch, my apologies. I now serve Young Master Ludu."
Lu Youqi nearly spat blood.
"Then why the hell did you report to me earlier? Just walk over to their side!"
Ah San wore an aggrieved expression. "I had to be steady."

Ah San sighed. "Patriarch, steady."
Steady?
"Steady your mother—"
The outburst left Lu Youqi lightheaded. Then he remembered one last hope.
He turned to Luo Yao.
"President Luo, help me."
Lu Ludu sneered. "Old man, President Luo is my ally. Why would she help you?"
Lu Youqi was floored. How had this bastard Lu Ludu pulled this off?

"Beg."
"What?"
"Beg."
Without hesitation, Lu Youqi dropped to his knees, knocking his forehead against the floor.
"President Luo, I beg you—save me! The Lu Family will submit to you!"
Luo Yao looked down in contempt. This was the man who’d dared oppose her?
"You had such an air of authority before. What happened? Done pretending?"
Lu Youqi shook his head like a rattle-drum. "No more pretending. Never again."
At last, the old dog groveled at her feet. Luo Yao felt like a victorious general.
Years ago, Lu Youqi had sent his sons to harass her while squeezing Luo Corporation in business.
If not for her ruthlessness and decisiveness, she’d never have made it this far.
Today, it all ended.
The Lu Family’s fate was sealed.

"You’re all such filial children—laughing your father to death."
Seated in his wheelchair, Lu Ludu glanced at Luo Yao and nodded before addressing Lu Youqi.
"Don’t act so indignant. Born into a great family like ours, what choice do we have but to fight? Take you, for instance—didn’t you seize power by eliminating your own brother?"
"Nonsense!" Lu Youqi denied immediately. Lu Ludu smirked in disdain.
"You think you covered your tracks well, but I’ve got irrefutable proof. Otherwise, why do you think everyone here is standing behind me?"
Seeing Lu Youqi’s face twitch, Lu Ludu’s grin widened.
"Honestly, there’s no point denying it. It’s the truth—one of the tragedies of great families. Even the Head of the Li Family, already taken away by the authorities—how many of the major families in this city, aside from the Wang Family, have gained their positions cleanly?"
"If you could do it, why can’t we?"
After years of patience, Lu Ludu finally let loose."Old man, stop struggling. Look around—do you see even one of your sons standing with you? You know exactly how we’ve lived all these years. ‘Young masters of a wealthy family’ sounds nice, but in reality, we were just your tools. Which one of us wasn’t abused growing up?"
The room fell silent. No one could refute Lu Ludu’s words.
To the outside world, Lu Youqi was refined and amiable, but within the Lu Family, he was a notorious tyrant—violent and cruel to his own kin.
Lu Youqi felt his heart turn cold. He had anticipated this day might come, but never imagined it would be such a complete betrayal.
"Where’s Luxin?" he asked, referring to his favorite ninth son.
"Ah, Ninth Brother. Right—the only one you never laid a hand on. But you won’t be seeing him."
"What do you mean?"
Lu Ludu feigned sorrow.
"You accused me of drug trafficking, but it wasn’t me—it was Ninth Brother. I’ve already handed him over to the authorities. After all, for a crime this big, someone from the main Lu Family line has to take the fall. Don’t you agree, Lu Youqi?"
The sorrow vanished, replaced by a chilling grin. Lu Youqi’s scalp prickled.
He understood now—Lu Ludu was framing Lu Luxin for this.
Just as he had once tried to force Lu Ludu to confess, except Lu Ludu was actually guilty, while Lu Luxin, at least in this case, was innocent.
"You unfilial wretch! Have you no shred of familial love?"
Lu Ludu scoffed. "Familial love? ‘Royal families are the cruelest.’ We may not be royalty, but our infighting is just as vicious. If love meant anything, so many wouldn’t have died."
"If you truly care about your son, why not take the blame yourself? Do one last thing for the Lu Family."
"Though I have to say, Ninth Brother really was the most filial. When I told him his father would die unless he took the blame, he actually went. Hilarious! And you pinned your hopes on this fool? How could he possibly lead the Lu Family forward?"

"Too bad he doesn’t know what’ll happen to his dear father after he confesses. Even I can’t predict how ugly it’ll get."

This was his own flesh and blood.
